domains.name: customer
domains.description: Single source of truth for all client and counterparty identities across retail, corporate, institutional, and government segments. Owns KYC/CDD onboarding, customer lifecycle management, beneficial ownership, relationship hierarchies, customer segmentation, NPS tracking, and CLTV scoring. Supports CRM integration and serves as the FK reference for all other domains requiring party identification.

products.name: party
products.description: Golden master record for every legal entity or natural person the bank interacts with — retail clients, corporate borrowers, institutional counterparties, government entities, and internal legal entities. Stores canonical identity attributes: full legal name, date of birth / incorporation date, entity type (individual, corporation, partnership, trust, government), domicile country, residency status, citizenship, and lifecycle status (prospect, active, dormant, deceased, closed). Also captures: universal operational preferences (preferred language, preferred branch, statement delivery method, currency preference, time zone, accessibility requirements); external and internal identifiers (TIN, EIN, SSN, LEI, SWIFT BIC, DUNS, CIF number, passport number, national ID, Bloomberg BUID, Reuters PERM ID, legacy system IDs) with identifier type, issuing authority, effective/expiry dates, and is_primary flag per type; and lifecycle event audit log (prior status, new status, event type such as onboarded/activated/dormancy-flagged/reactivated/relationship-exited/deceased/merged/deduped, event timestamp, triggering system, initiating employee_id, approval employee_id, event notes). SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for party identity, party identifiers, and party lifecycle events — no separate identifier or lifecycle event tables exist. Serves as the authoritative FK anchor for all other domains requiring party identification. Sourced from Core Banking System (Temenos T24 / FIS Profile — Customer Master).

products.name: kyc_record

Review event history (time-series): review trigger type (periodic, risk-triggered, regulatory, client-initiated), review date, prior and new risk ratings, review outcome (no change, upgraded, downgraded, escalated to EDD, relationship exited), EDD required flag, EDD completion date, reviewer and approver employee_ids, and next review due date. SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for AML/financial-crime risk rating and KYC review events — no separate review event or AML risk rating tables exist. Credit risk and operational risk ratings are owned by the risk domain. Provides the complete audit trail required for regulatory examination. Sourced from AML/Financial Crime System (NICE Actimize / Oracle Financial Crime).

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: The date on which this relationship ends or is scheduled to terminate. Null for open-ended or ongoing relationships. Used for relationship lifecycle management and automated alerts for relationship renewals or reviews.

attributes.description: The depth or tier of this relationship within a hierarchical tree structure. Level 1 represents the top-most parent or ultimate controlling entity. attributes.name: kyc_next_review_date

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp

attributes.name: notes

attributes.name: relationship_direction

attributes.name: risk_rating

products.name: risk_rating
products.description: AML/BSA customer risk rating assigned to a customer, counterparty, or beneficial owner based on their composite risk profile encompassing customer type, product/service usage, geographic risk (country, jurisdiction), transaction behavior, and adverse information. Drives CDD/EDD requirements, transaction monitoring rule intensity, and KYC review frequency. Distinct from credit risk ratings (risk domain) and fraud risk scores (fraud domain).

products.name: account_holder
products.description: This association product represents the ownership and signing authority relationship between parties and deposit accounts. It captures the legal and operational relationship that defines who owns, controls, and has authority over deposit accounts. Each record links one party to one deposit account with attributes that define the nature of ownership (primary owner, joint owner, authorized signer), ownership percentage for joint accounts, signing authority levels and limits, beneficiary designations, and the temporal validity of the relationship. This is the canonical banking M:N pattern that enables joint accounts, corporate accounts with multiple signatories, and accounts with authorized representatives.. Existence Justification: In banking operations, parties and deposit accounts have a true many-to-many relationship. One party (customer) can own or have authority over multiple deposit accounts (checking, savings, money market, CDs), and one deposit account can have multiple parties associated with it (joint account owners, authorized signers, corporate signatories, beneficiaries, trustees). This relationship is actively managed by banking operations teams who add/remove account holders, modify signing authority, update beneficiary designations, and track ownership percentages.

Includes embedded child record sets for: (1) overdraft facility configuration — approved limit, linked protection source, transfer fee, opt-in/opt-out status per Reg E, utilization tracking; (2) account-level operational limits — daily withdrawal, transfer, ATM, wire, ACH debit limits with approval authority and override flags; (3) dormancy and escheatment tracking — last activity date, dormancy classification date, dormancy period, state escheatment threshold, outreach log, escheatment filing date, amount escheated, jurisdiction; (4) document registry — signature cards, account agreements, beneficial ownership certifications, W-9/W-8BEN, POA, court orders with version, status, and storage reference; (5) immutable status transition history — previous/new status, effective datetime, reason code, initiating channel, authorizing officer. Interest accrual method, compounding frequency, statement cycle, and regulatory classification round out the record. Core system-of-record entity aligned with Temenos T24 ACCOUNT.ARRANGEMENT / FIS Profile deposit module.

products.name: holder
products.description: Association entity linking customers (individuals or legal entities from the customer domain) to deposit, CD, and custodial accounts with role-based ownership, beneficiary, and fiduciary semantics. Captures ownership role (primary owner, joint owner, authorized signer, power of attorney, trustee), ownership percentage for joint accounts, signing authority level, effective date, expiry date, and designation/revocation dates. Includes embedded beneficiary designation records for payable-on-death (POD) and transfer-on-death (TOD) roles: beneficiary type (individual, trust, estate, charity), allocation percentage, designation date, revocation date, and supporting documentation reference. Beneficiary roles are legally distinct from ownership roles — beneficiaries have no access rights during the account holder's lifetime but receive proceeds upon death, governed by state law and FDIC insurance rules. Enables multi-party account ownership modeling required for KYC, AML, estate processing, FDIC insurance coverage calculation across ownership categories, and probate/succession workflows. Single source of truth for all account-to-person associations including both ownership and beneficiary designations.

attributes.description: The portion of the account balance that has been pledged as collateral for loans, letters of credit, or other obligations, reducing the available balance for withdrawal.

attributes.name: collected_balance
attributes.description: The portion of the ledger balance that has cleared and is available for reserve requirement calculation. Excludes float and uncollected funds from deposited checks or transfers still in clearing.
attributes.references: Federal Reserve Regulation D - Reserve Requirements

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this balance snapshot record was first created in the data lakehouse silver layer. Used for data lineage and audit trail purposes.

attributes.name: data_quality_score
attributes.description: A calculated score (0-100) representing the completeness, accuracy, and consistency of the balance record based on automated data quality rules. Used for data governance and issue identification.

attributes.name: days_in_period
attributes.description: The number of calendar days in the current statement period, used as the denominator for average daily balance calculation.
attributes.references: Truth in Savings Act (TISA) - Regulation DD

attributes.name: escheatment_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator that is true if the account balance is eligible for escheatment to the state due to dormancy or abandonment under applicable unclaimed property laws.
attributes.references: State Unclaimed Property Laws - Uniform Unclaimed Property Act

attributes.name: fdic_insured_amount
attributes.business_glossary_term: Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation (FDIC) Insured Amount
attributes.description: The portion of the account balance that is covered by FDIC deposit insurance, up to the standard maximum deposit insurance amount per depositor, per insured bank, for each account ownership category.

attributes.name: float_balance
attributes.description: The amount of funds in transit or pending collection, representing deposits that have been credited to the ledger balance but have not yet cleared through the payment system.
attributes.references: Federal Reserve Regulation CC - Expedited Funds Availability Act

attributes.name: hold_balance
attributes.description: The total amount of funds subject to holds, restrictions, or encumbrances that reduce the available balance. Includes administrative holds, legal holds, and collateral pledges.
attributes.references: Uniform Commercial Code (UCC) Article 4A - Funds Transfers

attributes.name: interest_bearing_balance
attributes.description: The portion of the account balance that is eligible for interest accrual based on the account type and interest calculation method. May differ from ledger balance due to minimum balance requirements or tiered rate structures.
attributes.references: Federal Reserve Regulation D - Interest on Deposits

attributes.name: last_transaction_date
attributes.description: The date of the most recent customer-initiated transaction on the account. Used to determine dormancy status and escheatment eligibility.
attributes.references: State Unclaimed Property Laws - Uniform Unclaimed Property Act

attributes.name: ledger_balance
attributes.description: The book balance of the account including all posted transactions as of the balance date. Represents the official accounting balance before adjustments for holds, floats, or uncollected funds.
attributes.references: Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP) - FASB ASC 310

attributes.name: maximum_balance
attributes.description: The highest ledger balance recorded during the statement period or month-to-date. Used for FDIC insurance limit monitoring and liquidity analysis.
attributes.references: Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation (FDIC) - Deposit Insurance Coverage

attributes.name: minimum_balance
attributes.description: The lowest ledger balance recorded during the statement period or month-to-date. Used to determine minimum balance threshold breach and fee assessment.
attributes.references: Truth in Savings Act (TISA) - Regulation DD

attributes.name: minimum_balance_threshold_breach_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator that is true if the account balance fell below the contractual minimum balance threshold during the period, triggering potential fee assessment or service charge.
attributes.references: Truth in Savings Act (TISA) - Regulation DD

attributes.name: overdraft_balance
attributes.description: The amount by which the account is overdrawn if the ledger balance is negative. Zero if the account has a positive balance. Used for overdraft fee calculation and credit risk monitoring.
attributes.references: Consumer Financial Protection Bureau (CFPB) - Overdraft Rules

attributes.name: overdraft_limit
attributes.description: The maximum negative balance allowed for the account under the overdraft protection program or line of credit. Zero if no overdraft facility is available.
attributes.references: Consumer Financial Protection Bureau (CFPB) - Overdraft Rules

attributes.name: pending_credits
attributes.description: The total amount of incoming transactions that have been authorized but not yet posted to the ledger balance. Includes pending deposits, transfers, and reversals.
attributes.references: Federal Reserve Regulation CC - Funds Availability

attributes.name: pending_debits
attributes.description: The total amount of outgoing transactions that have been authorized but not yet posted to the ledger balance. Includes pending withdrawals, payments, and fees.
attributes.references: Federal Reserve Regulation CC - Funds Availability

attributes.name: reconciliation_status
attributes.description: The status of the balance reconciliation process between the core banking system and the general ledger. Reconciled indicates successful matching; pending indicates awaiting reconciliation; exception indicates discrepancy requiring investigation; override indicates manual adjustment applied.

attributes.name: reserve_requirement_balance
attributes.description: The portion of the account balance subject to Federal Reserve reserve requirements under Regulation D. Used for Asset-Liability Management (ALM) and reserve calculation.
attributes.references: Federal Reserve Regulation D - Reserve Requirements

attributes.name: snapshot_timestamp
attributes.description: The exact date and time when this balance snapshot was captured from the core banking system, typically during the end-of-day batch processing cycle.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The core banking system from which this balance snapshot was extracted. Identifies the system of record for data lineage and reconciliation purposes.

attributes.name: uninsured_amount
attributes.description: The portion of the account balance that exceeds FDIC insurance limits and is therefore at risk in the event of bank failure. Used for depositor risk disclosure and liquidity stress testing.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this balance snapshot record was last modified in the data lakehouse silver layer. Used for change tracking and audit trail purposes.

products.name: account_transaction
products.description: Granular record of every debit and credit posting to a deposit account. Captures transaction date, value date, posting date, transaction type code, channel (branch, ATM, ACH, wire, card, online), amount, currency, running balance after posting, reference number, counterparty account, narrative/memo, reversal flag, and originating payment system reference. Primary audit trail for account activity; feeds statement generation, AML transaction monitoring, and GL subledger reconciliation.
products.reference: Account Posting / Ledger Entry — T24 Transaction History

attributes.name: account_transaction_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the account transaction record. Primary key for the account transaction entity.

attributes.name: channel_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to channel.channel. Business justification: Every transaction occurs through a specific channel for fraud detection, AML monitoring (CTR/SAR reporting), channel analytics, and customer behavior analysis. Essential for BSA/AML compliance and ope

attributes.name: corporate_action_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to security.corporate_action. Business justification: Corporate actions (dividends, mergers, rights issues) generate cash credits/debits in deposit accounts. Operations teams require this link for corporate action cash settlement reconciliation, client e

attributes.name: counterparty_bic_directory_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.bic_directory. Business justification: Wire transfers and cross-border payments require counterparty bank BIC validation against the SWIFT BIC directory for routing, correspondent banking identification, and AML screening. The counterparty

attributes.name: counterparty_party_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.party. Business justification: Internal transfers between customer accounts require counterparty identification for AML transaction monitoring, related-party transaction detection, and regulatory reporting (CTR, SAR). When counterp

attributes.name: ctr_filing_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.ctr_filing. Business justification: BSA/CTR compliance requires linking specific cash transactions over $10,000 to the CTR filing submitted to FinCEN. The ctr_reportable_flag on account_transaction signals this relationship. Compliance

attributes.name: currency_id
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code representing the currency in which the transaction amount is denominated.

attributes.name: deposit_account_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the deposit or transactional account to which this transaction was posted. Links to the authoritative account registry.

attributes.name: disbursement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to loan.disbursement. Business justification: Loan disbursements settle as credit transactions on the destination deposit account. Payment operations must link the account credit posting to the specific disbursement record for settlement confirma

attributes.name: drawdown_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to loan.drawdown. Business justification: A loan drawdown credits the borrower's deposit account, generating an account_transaction. Operations and treasury teams reconcile the credit posting to the specific drawdown event for funding confirm

attributes.name: exchange_rate_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.exchange_rate. Business justification: Multi-currency transactions require traceability to the specific exchange rate record used for audit, regulatory reporting, and GL revaluation. The plain exchange_rate column is a denormalized rate va

attributes.name: fx_transaction_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to payment.fx_transaction. Business justification: Cross-currency account postings originate from FX transactions. FX P&L reporting, regulatory FX transaction reporting, and reconciliation of cross-currency entries require linking the account posting

attributes.name: instruction_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to payment.instruction. Business justification: Payment instruction execution (wire, ACH, SWIFT) generates the account debit/credit posting. Reconciliation, SWIFT gpi audit trails, and AML transaction monitoring require joining account postings to

attributes.name: instrument_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to security.instrument. Business justification: Securities settlement generates cash-leg account transactions (bond purchase debits, coupon credits, dividend payments). Banking operations require linking the cash account transaction to the security

attributes.name: nostro_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to treasury.nostro_account. Business justification: Cross-border wire payments and SWIFT transactions recorded in account_transaction are settled through a specific nostro account. Operations and reconciliation teams must link each international transa

attributes.name: originating_session_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to channel.session. Business justification: Digital fraud investigation and Reg E dispute resolution require linking a transaction to the authenticated session that initiated it (device fingerprint, IP, auth level). AML transaction monitoring u

attributes.name: payment_transaction_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to payment.payment_transaction. Business justification: Account posting and payment network execution are two sides of the same event. Reg E error resolution, operations reconciliation, and settlement reporting require directly joining the account ledger e

attributes.name: repayment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to loan.repayment. Business justification: Loan repayments generate debit transactions on the borrower's deposit account. Payment operations and reconciliation teams must match each account debit to the specific loan repayment record for excep

attributes.name: reversed_transaction_account_transaction_id
attributes.description: Reference to the original account transaction ID that this transaction reverses. Null if this is not a reversal transaction.

attributes.name: sanctions_screening_event_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.sanctions_screening_event. Business justification: Wire transfers and ACH transactions are screened against OFAC/sanctions lists at execution. The specific sanctions screening event for a transaction must be traceable for regulatory examination and bl

attributes.name: settlement_instruction_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to trade.settlement_instruction. Business justification: An account debit/credit transaction is the cash leg of a trade settlement instruction. Linking account_transaction to settlement_instruction enables CSDR settlement reconciliation, fail reporting, and

attributes.name: standing_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to account.standing_order. Business justification: Recurring payment executions driven by standing orders generate account_transaction records. Linking account_transaction.standing_order_id → standing_order.standing_order_id allows tracing each transa

attributes.name: subledger_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to ledger.subledger. Business justification: Account transactions are the source documents feeding the deposit subledger. Banking subledger architecture requires transactions to reference their subledger for transaction-level reconciliation, aud

attributes.name: ach_trace_number
attributes.description: 15-digit trace number assigned to ACH transactions for tracking and reconciliation purposes. Null for non-ACH transactions.

attributes.name: aml_alert_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator specifying whether this transaction triggered an AML alert requiring investigation. True if alert generated, False otherwise.

attributes.name: aml_risk_score
attributes.description: Numeric risk score assigned by the AML transaction monitoring system indicating the likelihood of money laundering or suspicious activity. Higher scores trigger enhanced review.

attributes.name: amount
attributes.description: The monetary value of the transaction in the account's base currency. Positive for credits, negative for debits per accounting convention.

attributes.name: balance_after_transaction
attributes.description: The running account balance immediately after this transaction was posted. Used for statement generation and overdraft detection.

attributes.name: branch_code
attributes.description: The code of the branch or business unit where the transaction was initiated or processed. Used for profitability analysis and operational reporting.

attributes.name: card_authorization_code
attributes.description: Authorization code returned by the card network for approved card transactions. Null for non-card transactions.

attributes.name: counterparty_account_number
attributes.description: The account number of the counterparty (originator or beneficiary) involved in the transaction. May be an internal account, external IBAN, or card number depending on transaction type.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this transaction record was first created in the core banking system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: ctr_reportable_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator specifying whether this transaction meets the threshold for Currency Transaction Report filing with FinCEN (typically cash transactions over $10,000).

attributes.name: fee_amount
attributes.description: The amount of any fee charged in association with this transaction (e.g., overdraft fee, wire transfer fee, ATM surcharge). Zero if no fee applies.
attributes.references: Regulation E, Truth in Savings Act

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: The general ledger account code to which this transaction posts for financial accounting and regulatory reporting purposes.

attributes.name: hold_amount
attributes.description: The amount of funds placed on hold or reserved as a result of this transaction (e.g., check hold, card authorization hold). Null if no hold applies.

attributes.name: hold_release_date
attributes.description: The date on which any hold placed by this transaction will be released and funds will become available. Null if no hold applies.

attributes.name: interest_amount
attributes.description: The amount of interest credited or debited as part of this transaction. Applicable for interest accrual postings on deposit accounts. Zero if not an interest transaction.
attributes.references: Truth in Savings Act, Regulation D

attributes.name: merchant_category_code
attributes.description: Four-digit ISO 18245 code classifying the type of merchant or service provider for card transactions. Used for spend analytics and rewards program eligibility.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this transaction record was last modified or updated. Used for change tracking and audit purposes.

attributes.name: narrative
attributes.description: Free-text description or memo field providing additional context about the transaction purpose, merchant name, or customer-entered notes. Appears on account statements.

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: The date on which the transaction was actually posted to the account ledger in the core banking system. Used for GL reconciliation and regulatory reporting cutoff.

attributes.name: posting_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise timestamp when the transaction was committed to the account ledger, including time zone. Critical for intraday liquidity monitoring and real-time balance calculations.

attributes.name: reference_number
attributes.description: Externally visible unique reference number assigned to this transaction for customer inquiries, statement reconciliation, and audit trail purposes.

attributes.name: reversal_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator specifying whether this transaction is a reversal of a previously posted transaction. True if reversal, False otherwise.

attributes.name: settlement_date
attributes.description: The date on which the transaction settled through the payment system or clearing house. May differ from posting date for multi-day clearing cycles.

attributes.name: transaction_date
attributes.description: The business date on which the transaction was initiated or authorized by the customer or originating system. This is the date visible to the customer on statements.

attributes.name: transaction_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the transaction indicating whether it is pending settlement, successfully posted to the ledger, reversed, failed, or cancelled.

attributes.name: type_code
attributes.description: Classification of the transaction indicating whether it is a debit, credit, fee charge, interest accrual, adjustment, or reversal posting.

attributes.name: value_date
attributes.description: The date on which funds become available or are debited for interest calculation purposes. May differ from transaction date due to clearing cycles or holds.

attributes.name: wire_imad
attributes.description: Input Message Accountability Data assigned to incoming wire transfers by the Federal Reserve or CHIPS. Null for non-wire transactions.

attributes.name: wire_omad
attributes.description: Output Message Accountability Data assigned to outgoing wire transfers by the Federal Reserve or CHIPS. Null for non-wire transactions.

products.name: statement
products.description: Periodic account statement record representing a formally generated statement cycle for a deposit account. Captures statement period start and end dates, statement date, opening balance, closing balance, total credits, total debits, interest earned, fees charged, statement delivery channel (paper, e-statement, secure message), delivery status, and regulatory disclosure flags (Reg E, Reg DD). Distinct from individual transactions — represents the aggregated billing document sent to the account holder.
products.reference: Periodic Statement — Reg E / Reg DD Compliance

attributes.name: statement_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the account statement record. Primary key for the account statement entity.

attributes.name: accounting_period_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to ledger.accounting_period. Business justification: Account statements are generated for specific accounting periods and must align with fiscal calendar for regulatory reporting (call reports), financial close, and period-end balance verification.

attributes.name: currency_id
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code representing the currency in which the statement balances and amounts are denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: delivery_channel_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to channel.channel. Business justification: Statement delivery channel tracking is required for regulatory proof of delivery (Reg E, Reg DD), customer preference management, and cost optimization. Links to channel for delivery method analytics

attributes.name: deposit_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the deposit account for which this statement was generated. Links to the core account master record in the Core Banking System (Temenos T24 / FIS Profile).

attributes.name: interest_rate_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to account.interest_rate. Business justification: A periodic account statement captures the interest rate in effect during the statement cycle. Adding interest_rate_id FK links the statement to the authoritative interest_rate record, normalizing the

attributes.name: annual_percentage_yield
attributes.description: The annualized rate of return on the account, expressed as a percentage, reflecting the effect of compounding interest. Disclosed per Regulation DD requirements.

attributes.name: archival_date
attributes.description: The date when the statement was moved to archival storage or purged, if applicable. Used for compliance with record retention policies.

attributes.name: archival_status
attributes.description: Indicates the current archival state of the statement record. Active statements are readily accessible; archived statements are moved to long-term storage; purged statements have been deleted per retention policy.

attributes.name: average_daily_balance
attributes.description: The average of the account's daily ending balances throughout the statement period. Used for interest calculation and minimum balance requirements.

attributes.name: bic
attributes.description: The Bank Identifier Code (also known as SWIFT code) for the financial institution holding the account. Used for international wire transfers and SWIFT messaging.

attributes.name: closing_balance
attributes.description: The account balance at the end of the statement period (as of statement_period_end_date). Represents the final ledger balance after all transactions in this cycle.

attributes.name: cycle_code
attributes.description: Internal code representing the statement cycle configuration (e.g., monthly on the 1st, quarterly on the 15th). Used for batch processing and scheduling.

attributes.name: delivery_status
attributes.description: Current status of the statement delivery process. Tracks whether the statement has been successfully delivered to the customer and, for electronic statements, whether it has been accessed.

attributes.name: delivery_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the statement was successfully delivered or made available to the account holder through the specified delivery channel.

attributes.name: escheatment_warning_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this statement includes a warning that the account is approaching dormancy and may be subject to escheatment (transfer to state unclaimed property). Required in certain jurisdictions.

attributes.name: fees_charged
attributes.description: The total fees and service charges assessed against the account during the statement period, including maintenance fees, overdraft fees, and transaction fees.

attributes.name: format
attributes.description: The file format or medium in which the statement is generated and delivered. PDF is standard for electronic statements; paper indicates physical print.

attributes.name: generated_by_system
attributes.description: The name or identifier of the core banking system or statement generation platform that produced this statement (e.g., Temenos T24, FIS Profile).

attributes.name: generated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the statement record was generated by the core banking system. Represents the system event time for audit and reconciliation.

attributes.name: iban
attributes.description: The International Bank Account Number for the account, if applicable. Used for international transactions and regulatory reporting in jurisdictions that require IBAN.

attributes.name: interest_earned
attributes.description: The total interest accrued and credited to the account during the statement period. Calculated based on the account's interest rate and daily balance.

attributes.name: language
attributes.description: Two-letter ISO 639-1 language code indicating the language in which the statement is generated (e.g., en for English, es for Spanish, fr for French).

attributes.name: maximum_balance
attributes.description: The highest account balance recorded during the statement period. Provides insight into peak liquidity and deposit patterns.

attributes.name: minimum_balance
attributes.description: The lowest account balance recorded during the statement period. Used to determine compliance with minimum balance requirements and fee waivers.

attributes.name: notice_of_change_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this statement includes a notice of change to account terms, fees, or interest rates. Required for regulatory compliance and customer notification.

attributes.name: opening_balance
attributes.description: The account balance at the beginning of the statement period (as of statement_period_start_date). Represents the starting ledger balance before any transactions in this cycle.

attributes.name: overdraft_count
attributes.description: The number of times the account balance went negative (overdraft) during the statement period. Used for fee assessment and risk monitoring.

attributes.name: overdraft_fees
attributes.description: The total overdraft and non-sufficient funds (NSF) fees charged during the statement period. Subset of total fees_charged, broken out for regulatory disclosure.

attributes.name: period_end_date
attributes.description: The last date of the statement cycle period. Represents the end of the transaction window covered by this statement.

attributes.name: period_start_date
attributes.description: The first date of the statement cycle period. Represents the beginning of the transaction window covered by this statement.

attributes.name: reg_dd_disclosure_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether Regulation DD disclosures (Truth in Savings Act - interest rates, fees, terms) are included on this statement. Required for deposit accounts.

attributes.name: reg_e_disclosure_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether Regulation E disclosures (electronic fund transfer rights and liabilities) are included on this statement. Required for accounts with EFT activity.

attributes.name: statement_date
attributes.description: The official date on which the statement was generated and made available to the account holder. This is the date printed on the statement document.

attributes.name: statement_number
attributes.description: Externally visible unique statement number assigned by the core banking system for customer reference and audit purposes. Typically follows a sequential or date-based numbering scheme.

attributes.name: statement_type
attributes.description: Classification of the statement based on its frequency or purpose. Monthly and quarterly are standard cycles; interim may be generated on demand; final indicates account closure.

attributes.name: suppression_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether statement generation was suppressed for this cycle due to customer preference, account inactivity, or regulatory exemption.

attributes.name: suppression_reason
attributes.description: The reason why statement generation was suppressed, if suppression_flag is true. Provides audit trail for non-delivery.

attributes.name: total_credits
attributes.description: The sum of all credit transactions (deposits, interest credits, reversals) posted to the account during the statement period.

attributes.name: total_debits
attributes.description: The sum of all debit transactions (withdrawals, fees, charges, payments) posted to the account during the statement period.

attributes.name: transaction_count
attributes.description: The total number of transactions (both credits and debits) posted to the account during the statement period. Used for summary reporting and fee calculation.

attributes.name: viewed_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the account holder first accessed or viewed the electronic statement. Null for paper statements or if not yet viewed.

products.name: interest_accrual
products.description: Daily interest accrual record for interest-bearing deposit accounts. Tracks accrual date, accrual basis (ACT/360, ACT/365, 30/360), applicable interest rate tier, accrued interest amount, cumulative accrued interest for the period, interest posting frequency, next interest payment date, and withholding tax amount for applicable accounts (FATCA/CRS). Supports NII (Net Interest Income) reporting, ALCO analytics, and regulatory interest disclosure under Reg DD.
products.reference: Interest Accrual — Reg DD / NII Reporting

attributes.name: interest_accrual_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the daily interest accrual record. Primary key for the account interest accrual entity.

attributes.name: accounting_period_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to ledger.accounting_period. Business justification: Interest accruals are calculated and posted by accounting period for month-end close, interest expense reporting, and tax reporting (1099-INT). Essential for period-based financial reporting.

attributes.name: benchmark_rate_fixing_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.benchmark_rate_fixing. Business justification: Variable-rate deposit accruals (SOFR-linked, post-IBOR transition) must trace the specific daily benchmark fixing used in each calculation for audit, IBOR transition compliance (ISDA protocols), and r

attributes.name: currency_id
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the account and all monetary amounts in this accrual record (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). All amounts are denominated in this currency.

attributes.name: deposit_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the deposit account for which interest is being accrued. Links to the core account master registry.
attributes.references: Core Banking System - Temenos T24 Account Master

attributes.name: ftp_rate_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to treasury.ftp_rate. Business justification: Interest accrual calculations for deposit accounts require the applicable FTP rate to compute NIM contribution and transfer pricing charges. ALCO and finance teams use the accrual-level FTP rate refer

attributes.name: interest_income_gl_account_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Interest Income Gl Account Id (Foreign Key)
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to ledger.gl_account. Business justification: IFRS/GAAP interest income recognition requires direct mapping of accruals to the income GL account. Banking accrual accounting and regulatory income reporting (FINREP, Call Report) depend on this GL a

attributes.name: interest_rate_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to account.interest_rate. Business justification: Each daily interest accrual record is computed using a specific interest rate configuration defined in interest_rate. Adding interest_rate_id FK normalizes the denormalized applicable_interest_rate an

attributes.name: party_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer who owns the account. Used for customer-level interest income reporting, tax reporting, and regulatory disclosures.
attributes.references: Core Banking System - Temenos T24 Customer Master, KYC (Know Your Customer) Standards

attributes.name: subledger_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to ledger.subledger. Business justification: Interest accruals feed the interest income/expense subledger. Banking month-end close requires accrual-to-subledger reconciliation to validate that all accrued interest is captured in the subledger be

attributes.name: accrual_basis_code
attributes.description: Day count convention used to calculate interest accrual. Determines how days are counted in the numerator and denominator of the interest calculation formula. ACT/360 is common for money market accounts, ACT/365 for savings, 30/360 for certain time deposits.
attributes.references: ISDA Day Count Conventions, Basel III Interest Rate Risk Framework

attributes.name: accrual_date
attributes.description: The business date on which this interest accrual calculation was performed. Represents the principal business event timestamp for this daily accrual record.
attributes.references: Core Banking System - Temenos T24 Interest Module

attributes.name: accrual_method
attributes.description: The mathematical method used to calculate interest accrual. Simple interest is calculated on principal only; compound interest includes previously accrued interest in the calculation base; continuous uses exponential compounding.
attributes.references: Core Banking System - Temenos T24 Product Configuration, FASB ASC 835 Interest

attributes.name: accrual_reversal_reason
attributes.description: Code or description explaining why this accrual was reversed, if applicable. Common reasons include account closure, rate correction, system error, or NPL (Non-Performing Loan) classification requiring accrual suspension.
attributes.references: Core Banking System - Temenos T24 Interest Module, Basel III Non-Performing Loan (NPL) Guidelines

attributes.name: accrual_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this accrual record. Calculated indicates daily accrual computed but not yet posted; posted indicates interest has been capitalized to account; reversed indicates accrual was backed out; suspended indicates accrual is on hold (e.g., for NPL accounts).
attributes.references: Core Banking System - Temenos T24 Interest Module, Basel III Non-Performing Loan (NPL) Guidelines

attributes.name: accrued_interest_amount
attributes.description: The interest amount accrued for this specific accrual date, calculated as (principal_balance × applicable_interest_rate × days) / day_count_basis. This is the daily interest increment.
attributes.references: Core Banking System - Temenos T24 Interest Module, FASB ASC 835 Interest, IFRS 9 Financial Instruments

attributes.name: branch_code
attributes.description: The branch or business unit code responsible for this account and its interest accrual. Used for profitability analysis, FTP (Funds Transfer Pricing), and management reporting.
attributes.references: Core Banking System - Temenos T24 Branch Master, ALCO (Asset-Liability Committee) Reporting

attributes.name: calculation_timestamp
attributes.description: The system timestamp when this interest accrual calculation was performed. Used for audit trail and to distinguish between batch calculation runs.
attributes.references: Core Banking System - Temenos T24 Audit Trail, SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act) Compliance

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this accrual record was first created in the system. Represents the record audit trail creation point.
attributes.references: Core Banking System - Temenos T24 Audit Trail, SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act) Compliance

attributes.name: cumulative_accrued_interest
attributes.description: The total interest accrued from the last interest posting date through the current accrual date. Represents the running total of unpaid accrued interest for the current interest period.
attributes.references: Core Banking System - Temenos T24 Interest Module, ALCO (Asset-Liability Committee) Reporting

attributes.name: days_in_period
attributes.description: The number of days used in the numerator of the interest calculation for this accrual date. Typically 1 for daily accrual, but may vary based on accrual basis and calendar adjustments.
attributes.references: ISDA Day Count Conventions, Core Banking System - Temenos T24 Interest Module

attributes.name: interest_payable_gl_account
attributes.business_glossary_term: Interest Payable General Ledger (GL) Account Code
attributes.description: The general ledger account code for the accrued interest payable liability. Represents the contra-account for the interest expense accrual until interest is posted to the customer account.
attributes.references: General Ledger System - Oracle Financials / SAP S4HANA, FASB ASC 835 Interest, IFRS 9 Financial Instruments

attributes.name: interest_posting_frequency
attributes.description: The frequency at which accrued interest is capitalized and posted to the account balance. Defines the cadence of interest payment or compounding per the account product terms. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: daily|weekly|monthly|quarterly|semi-annually|annually|at_maturity — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Core Banking System - Temenos T24 Product Configuration, Regulation DD Truth in Savings

attributes.name: last_interest_payment_date
attributes.description: The most recent date on which interest was posted or paid to the account. Marks the beginning of the current accrual period.
attributes.references: Core Banking System - Temenos T24 Interest Module

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this accrual record was last updated. Used for audit trail and change tracking.
attributes.references: Core Banking System - Temenos T24 Audit Trail, SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act) Compliance

attributes.name: net_interest_amount
attributes.description: The net interest amount after withholding tax deduction, calculated as accrued_interest_amount minus withholding_tax_amount. Represents the interest amount that will be credited to the customer.
attributes.references: Core Banking System - Temenos T24 Interest Module, FASB ASC 835 Interest

attributes.name: next_interest_payment_date
attributes.description: The scheduled date on which the cumulative accrued interest will be posted to the account or paid to the customer. Used for interest payment planning and customer disclosure.
attributes.references: Core Banking System - Temenos T24 Interest Module, Regulation DD Truth in Savings

attributes.name: posted_timestamp
attributes.description: The system timestamp when the accrued interest was posted to the customer account or general ledger. Null if accrual status is calculated or pending_review.
attributes.references: Core Banking System - Temenos T24 Audit Trail, SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act) Compliance

attributes.name: principal_balance
attributes.description: The account balance amount on which interest is calculated for this accrual date. Represents the principal subject to interest computation, typically the end-of-day ledger balance.
attributes.references: Core Banking System - Temenos T24 Balance Module, FASB ASC 310 Receivables

attributes.name: product_code
attributes.description: The deposit product code or account type code for the account earning this interest. Used to segment interest expense by product line for NII analysis and product profitability.
attributes.references: Core Banking System - Temenos T24 Product Master, ALCO (Asset-Liability Committee) Reporting

attributes.name: regulatory_reporting_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this accrual must be included in regulatory capital or liquidity reporting (e.g., Basel III LCR, NSFR calculations). True if regulatory reporting is required, False otherwise.
attributes.references: Basel III Liquidity Coverage Ratio (LCR), Net Stable Funding Ratio (NSFR), Federal Reserve FR Y-9C

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the source system that generated this accrual record (e.g., T24, FIS_PROFILE, CUSTOM_ACCRUAL_ENGINE). Used for data lineage and reconciliation in multi-system environments.
attributes.references: Enterprise Data Management Standards, Data Governance Framework

attributes.name: tax_reporting_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this interest accrual must be included in tax reporting (e.g., 1099-INT for US customers, FATCA/CRS reporting for foreign accounts). True if tax reporting is required, False otherwise.
attributes.references: IRS Form 1099-INT, FATCA (Foreign Account Tax Compliance Act), CRS (Common Reporting Standard)

attributes.name: withholding_tax_amount
attributes.description: The tax amount withheld from the accrued interest for this accrual date, calculated as accrued_interest_amount × withholding_tax_rate. Represents the portion of interest income remitted to tax authorities.
attributes.references: FATCA (Foreign Account Tax Compliance Act), CRS (Common Reporting Standard), IRS Publication 515

attributes.name: withholding_tax_rate
attributes.description: The tax rate applied to withhold tax on interest income for applicable accounts, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.300000 for 30%). Applies to accounts subject to FATCA, CRS, or domestic tax withholding requirements.
attributes.references: FATCA (Foreign Account Tax Compliance Act), CRS (Common Reporting Standard), IRS Publication 515

attributes.name: year_basis_days
attributes.description: The number of days used in the denominator of the interest calculation (e.g., 360, 365, or actual days in year). Determined by the accrual_basis_code and used to annualize the interest rate.
attributes.references: ISDA Day Count Conventions, Core Banking System - Temenos T24 Interest Module

products.name: account_fee
products.description: Record of fees assessed against deposit accounts including monthly maintenance fees, overdraft fees (NSF), wire transfer fees, ATM surcharge fees, early account closure fees, and dormancy fees. Captures fee type, assessed amount, waiver flag, waiver reason, waiver authority, assessment date, billing cycle, and regulatory disclosure requirement. Supports fee income reporting, CFPB compliance monitoring, and customer profitability analysis.
products.reference: Account Fee Assessment — CFPB / Reg DD Fee Disclosure

attributes.name: account_fee_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the account fee record. Primary key for the account fee entity.

attributes.name: account_transaction_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to account.account_transaction. Business justification: Fees assessed against deposit accounts (overdraft fees, NSF fees, etc.) are typically triggered by or directly associated with a specific account_transaction. Adding account_transaction_id FK links th

attributes.name: accounting_period_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to ledger.accounting_period. Business justification: Fee assessments are tied to accounting periods for revenue recognition, financial reporting, and regulatory compliance. This supports period-based revenue accounting and financial close processes.

attributes.name: currency_id
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the fee amount. Typically matches the account's base currency.

attributes.name: deposit_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the deposit account against which this fee was assessed. Links to the core banking account master.
attributes.references: Core Banking System - Temenos T24 Account Master

attributes.name: dispute_case_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer dispute case or complaint ticket associated with this fee, if applicable. Used for tracking dispute resolution.

attributes.name: journal_entry_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to ledger.journal_entry. Business justification: Fee assessments generate journal entries for revenue recognition (DR Fee Receivable/Account, CR Fee Revenue). This links the fee subledger to GL for financial reporting and revenue accounting.

attributes.name: subledger_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to ledger.subledger. Business justification: Fee income feeds the fee revenue subledger. Banking revenue recognition (ASC 606) and period-end close require fee records to be traceable to their subledger for completeness testing, revenue reconcil

attributes.name: waiver_channel_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to channel.channel. Business justification: Fee waiver requests are processed through specific channels for audit trails, customer service quality monitoring, and fraud prevention. Required for compliance reviews and dispute resolution. No exis

attributes.name: assessed_amount
attributes.description: The gross amount of the fee assessed against the account before any waivers or adjustments, denominated in the account's base currency (typically USD for US operations).

attributes.name: assessment_date
attributes.description: The business date on which the fee was assessed and posted to the account. This is the effective date for accounting and regulatory reporting purposes.

attributes.name: assessment_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time when the fee was assessed and recorded in the core banking system. Used for audit trail and transaction sequencing.

attributes.name: billing_cycle
attributes.description: The billing cycle or statement period during which the fee was assessed. Typically formatted as YYYYMM or a cycle sequence number.
attributes.references: Core Banking System - Statement Generation Module

attributes.name: branch_code
attributes.description: The branch or service center code where the account is domiciled or where the fee-triggering transaction occurred. Used for profitability analysis and branch performance reporting.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The system timestamp when this fee record was first created in the data warehouse. Used for data lineage and audit trail.

attributes.name: customer_notification_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether the customer was notified of this fee assessment through statement, email, SMS, or other communication channel.

attributes.name: disclosure_statement_text
attributes.description: The standardized disclosure text that must be provided to the customer for this fee type, as required by CFPB Regulation DD or other applicable regulations.
attributes.references: CFPB Regulation DD - Fee Disclosure Requirements

attributes.name: dispute_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether the customer has disputed this fee charge. True if a dispute case has been opened, False otherwise.

attributes.name: fee_description
attributes.description: Detailed textual description of the fee assessed, including the reason and context for the charge. Used for customer statement generation and dispute resolution.
attributes.references: CFPB Regulation DD - Fee Disclosure Requirements

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: The general ledger account code to which the fee income is posted. Used for financial accounting and revenue recognition.

attributes.name: line_of_business
attributes.description: The business segment or line of business to which this fee is attributed. RETAIL=Retail Banking, COMMERCIAL=Commercial Banking, WEALTH=Wealth Management, PRIVATE=Private Banking.

attributes.name: net_fee_amount
attributes.description: The net fee amount charged to the account after waivers and adjustments (assessed_amount minus waived_amount). This is the amount that impacts the account balance and fee income.

attributes.name: notification_channel
attributes.description: The communication channel through which the customer was notified of the fee. STATEMENT=Account Statement, EMAIL=Email Notification, SMS=Text Message, MOBILE=Mobile App Push Notification, BRANCH=In-Branch Notification.

attributes.name: product_code
attributes.description: The product code or account type code of the deposit account against which the fee was assessed. Used for product profitability analysis.

attributes.name: regulatory_disclosure_required_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether this fee type requires specific regulatory disclosure to the customer under CFPB Regulation DD or other consumer protection regulations.
attributes.references: CFPB Regulation DD - Truth in Savings

attributes.name: revenue_recognition_date
attributes.description: The accounting date on which the fee revenue is recognized in the general ledger. May differ from assessment_date due to revenue recognition policies.

attributes.name: reversal_date
attributes.description: The business date on which the fee was reversed and credited back to the account. Null if no reversal has occurred.
attributes.references: Core Banking System - Transaction Processing Module

attributes.name: reversal_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether this fee has been fully reversed. True if the entire net_fee_amount has been credited back to the account.
attributes.references: Core Banking System - Transaction Processing Module

attributes.name: reversal_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the reason for fee reversal. ERROR=System or Processing Error, DISPUTE=Customer Dispute Resolution, GOODWILL=Customer Service Goodwill, REGULATORY=Regulatory Compliance Requirement, FRAUD=Fraudulent Activity. Null if no reversal occurred.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the source operational system from which this fee record originated (e.g., T24, FIS_PROFILE). Used for data lineage and reconciliation.

attributes.name: type_code
attributes.description: Classification code identifying the type of fee assessed. MAINT=Monthly Maintenance Fee, OD=Overdraft Fee, NSF=Non-Sufficient Funds Fee, WIRE=Wire Transfer Fee, ATM=Automated Teller Machine (ATM) Surcharge Fee, CLOSE=Early Account Closure Fee, DORM=Dormancy/Inactivity Fee. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: MAINT|OD|NSF|WIRE|ATM|CLOSE|DORM — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: CFPB Truth in Savings Act (Regulation DD)

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The system timestamp when this fee record was last modified in the data warehouse. Used for change tracking and audit trail.

attributes.name: waived_amount
attributes.description: The portion of the assessed fee that was waived or reversed, denominated in the account's base currency. Zero if no waiver was applied.

attributes.name: waiver_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether any portion of the fee was waived. True if waived_amount is greater than zero, False otherwise.

attributes.name: waiver_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the reason for fee waiver. CUST_REQ=Customer Request/Goodwill, SVC_FAIL=Service Failure, PROMO=Promotional Waiver, REL_MGMT=Relationship Management, REG_COMP=Regulatory Compliance, ERROR=System or Processing Error. Null if no waiver applied.

attributes.name: waiver_reason_description
attributes.description: Free-text explanation providing additional context for the fee waiver decision. Used for audit and customer service documentation.

attributes.name: waiver_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the fee waiver was authorized and processed. Null if no waiver was applied.

products.name: hold
products.description: Record of funds holds and restrictions placed on deposit account balances. Captures hold type (check hold, legal hold, administrative hold, garnishment, levy, fraud hold), hold amount, hold currency, placement date, expected release date, actual release date, placing authority (branch, legal, compliance, court order), hold reason narrative, and regulatory basis (Reg CC for check holds). Critical for available balance calculation and legal/compliance workflows.
products.reference: Funds Hold / Balance Restriction — Reg CC

attributes.name: hold_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the account hold record. Primary key.

attributes.name: account_transaction_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to account.account_transaction. Business justification: Funds holds are frequently placed in response to a specific account transaction (e.g., a check deposit triggers a Regulation CC hold, a wire receipt triggers a compliance hold). Linking hold.account_t

attributes.name: alert_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fraud.fraud_alert. Business justification: Account holds are frequently placed automatically or manually in response to a fraud alert (e.g., card compromise, suspicious transaction). Reg E compliance and fraud operations audit trails require t

attributes.name: currency_id
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the hold amount. Must match the account base currency in most cases, but may differ for foreign exchange holds or multi-currency accounts.

attributes.name: deposit_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the deposit account on which the hold is placed. Links to the core banking system account master.

attributes.name: fraud_case_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fraud.case. Business justification: Legal and investigative holds are placed on accounts as a direct result of an active fraud case (e.g., court-ordered freeze, investigative hold). Fraud case management and legal hold tracking require

attributes.name: instruction_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to payment.instruction. Business justification: Large-value or cross-border payment instructions trigger compliance and settlement holds on deposit accounts pending OFAC screening or settlement confirmation. Hold management workflows and sanctions

attributes.name: loan_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to loan.loan_account. Business justification: When a borrower defaults or breaches covenants, the bank places a hold on their deposit account linked to the defaulted loan account. Collections and workout teams require this link to manage set-off

attributes.name: placing_channel_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to channel.channel. Business justification: Legal and regulatory holds are placed through specific channels for compliance audit trails, dispute resolution, and fraud investigation documentation. Required for regulatory examinations and litigat

attributes.name: pledge_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to collateral.collateral_pledge. Business justification: Pledge-driven account holds: when a deposit account is pledged as collateral, a hold is placed on the account for the pledged amount. The hold record must reference the collateral_pledge to enforce th

attributes.name: actual_release_date
attributes.description: The business date on which the hold was actually released or cancelled. Null for active holds. May differ from expected release date if manually released early or extended.
attributes.references: Core Banking System Hold Release Process

attributes.name: actual_release_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the hold was released, including timezone offset. Used for audit and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: amount
attributes.description: Monetary value of funds restricted by this hold, denominated in the account currency. This amount is unavailable for withdrawal or payment processing.

attributes.name: beneficiary_name
attributes.description: The name of the party entitled to receive the held funds, if applicable. Used for garnishments (e.g., creditor name), levies (e.g., IRS), or child support orders. Null for holds without a designated beneficiary.

attributes.name: beneficiary_reference
attributes.description: External reference number or account identifier for the beneficiary, such as a creditor account number or tax identification number. Null if not applicable.

attributes.name: check_amount
attributes.description: The face value of the check that triggered the hold, if applicable. May differ from hold_amount if only a portion of the check is held. Null for non-check holds.

attributes.name: check_serial_number
attributes.description: The serial number of the deposited check that triggered the hold, if applicable. Used for Reg CC check holds and exception case tracking. Null for non-check holds.

attributes.name: court_case_number
attributes.description: The docket or case number from the court order authorizing the hold, if applicable. Used for garnishments, levies, and legal holds. Null for non-legal holds.

attributes.name: court_jurisdiction
attributes.description: The name of the court or legal jurisdiction that issued the order, if applicable. Examples: 'Superior Court of California, County of Los Angeles', 'U.S. District Court, Southern District of New York'. Null for non-legal holds.

attributes.name: customer_notification_sent
attributes.description: Indicates whether the account holder has been notified of the hold placement, as required by Reg CC for check holds and consumer protection regulations for other hold types.
attributes.references: Regulation CC (12 CFR Part 229.13), Consumer Financial Protection Bureau (CFPB) Guidelines

attributes.name: dispute_date
attributes.description: The date on which the customer filed a dispute regarding this hold. Null if no dispute has been filed.
attributes.references: Consumer Financial Protection Bureau (CFPB) Complaint Handling

attributes.name: dispute_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer has disputed the hold. True if a formal dispute or complaint has been filed; false otherwise. Triggers compliance review workflow.
attributes.references: Consumer Financial Protection Bureau (CFPB) Complaint Handling

attributes.name: dispute_resolution_date
attributes.description: The date on which the dispute was resolved. Null if the dispute is still open or no dispute was filed.
attributes.references: Consumer Financial Protection Bureau (CFPB) Complaint Handling

attributes.name: expected_release_date
attributes.description: The anticipated business date on which the hold will be automatically released, based on regulatory timelines (e.g., Reg CC hold periods) or court order expiration. Nullable for indefinite holds.

attributes.name: expiration_action
attributes.description: The action to be taken when the hold reaches its expected release date. Auto-release holds are lifted automatically; manual review holds require operations approval; extend holds are renewed for another period; escalate holds trigger compliance or legal review.

attributes.name: hold_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the hold. Active holds reduce available balance; released holds have been lifted; expired holds passed their release date; cancelled holds were removed before maturity; partial release indicates a portion of the hold amount has been freed.

attributes.name: hold_type
attributes.description: Classification of the hold based on its origin and purpose. Check holds are governed by Reg CC; legal holds include garnishments, levies, and court orders; fraud holds are placed by compliance or fraud teams; administrative holds are internal operational restrictions. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: check_hold|legal_hold|administrative_hold|garnishment|levy|fraud_hold|regulatory_hold|collateral_hold — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Regulation CC (12 CFR Part 229), Bank Secrecy Act (BSA)

attributes.name: internal_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for internal operational notes, case management updates, and audit trail commentary. Not visible to customers. Used by operations, compliance, and legal teams for case tracking.

attributes.name: is_current_record
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is the current active version of the hold record. True for the latest version; false for historical versions. Used for SCD Type 2 queries.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this hold record was last updated in the source system or lakehouse. Used for incremental data processing and audit trails.

attributes.name: notification_date
attributes.description: The date on which the customer notification was sent or delivered. Null if no notification has been sent. Used for regulatory compliance tracking.

attributes.name: notification_method
attributes.description: The channel through which the customer was notified of the hold. Null if no notification has been sent. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: mail|email|sms|phone|in_person|online_banking|mobile_app — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: partial_release_allowed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the hold can be partially released before full maturity. True for holds that support incremental release (e.g., large check holds under Reg CC); false for all-or-nothing holds (e.g., fraud holds, court orders).

attributes.name: placement_date
attributes.description: The business date on which the hold was placed on the account. This is the effective date from which the funds became unavailable.

attributes.name: placement_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the hold was created in the system, including timezone offset. Used for audit trails and sequence resolution.

attributes.name: placing_authority
attributes.description: The organizational unit or external entity that initiated the hold. Court orders and external agencies (e.g., IRS, child support enforcement) are captured separately from internal departments. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: branch|legal_department|compliance|court_order|fraud_team|operations|automated_system|external_agency — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Bank Secrecy Act (BSA), Anti-Money Laundering (AML) Procedures

attributes.name: priority
attributes.description: Numeric priority ranking for this hold when multiple holds exist on the same account. Lower numbers indicate higher priority. Used to determine order of fund allocation when account balance is insufficient to cover all holds. Legal holds typically have higher priority than administrative holds.

attributes.name: reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized internal code representing the specific reason for the hold. Maps to regulatory categories (e.g., Reg CC exception holds) and internal operational codes.
attributes.references: Core Banking System Hold Reason Reference Data

attributes.name: reason_narrative
attributes.description: Free-text description providing additional context for the hold. May include check number, court case number, fraud case ID, or other supporting details for operational and customer service use.

attributes.name: record_effective_date
attributes.description: The business date from which this version of the hold record is effective. Used for slowly changing dimension (SCD) Type 2 historization in the lakehouse.

attributes.name: record_end_date
attributes.description: The business date on which this version of the hold record ceased to be effective. Null for the current active version. Used for slowly changing dimension (SCD) Type 2 historization.

attributes.name: reference_number
attributes.description: Externally visible unique reference number for the hold, used for customer inquiries and audit trails.

attributes.name: regulatory_basis
attributes.description: The primary regulatory or legal framework under which the hold is placed. Reg CC governs check holds; BSA/AML/OFAC govern compliance holds; court orders and tax levies are legal holds. 'None' indicates an internal administrative hold. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: reg_cc|bsa|aml|ofac|court_order|garnishment_order|tax_levy|none — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Regulation CC (12 CFR Part 229), Bank Secrecy Act (BSA), Office of Foreign Assets Control (OFAC)

attributes.name: released_amount
attributes.description: The cumulative amount of funds that have been released from this hold through partial releases. Zero for holds that have not been partially released. Equals hold_amount when the hold is fully released.
attributes.references: Core Banking System Hold Release Tracking

attributes.name: remaining_hold_amount
attributes.description: The current amount still held after any partial releases. Calculated as hold_amount minus released_amount. Used for real-time available balance calculation.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The name or identifier of the upstream system that originated this hold record. Examples: 'Temenos T24', 'FIS Profile', 'Fraud Detection System', 'Legal Case Management'. Used for data lineage and reconciliation.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: The unique identifier for this hold record in the source system. Used for traceability and reconciliation with upstream operational systems.

products.name: overdraft_facility
products.description: Master record defining the overdraft protection arrangement attached to a deposit account. Captures approved overdraft limit, linked protection source (savings account, line of credit, credit card), transfer fee per use, interest rate on overdraft balance, opt-in/opt-out status per Reg E, effective date, expiry date, and utilization tracking. Distinct from the loan domain's revolving credit — this is the deposit-side overdraft configuration owned by the account domain.
products.reference: Overdraft Protection — Reg E Opt-In / T24 OD Facility

attributes.name: overdraft_facility_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the overdraft facility arrangement. Primary key for the overdraft facility record.

attributes.name: collateral_asset_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to collateral.collateral_asset. Business justification: Overdraft facilities are often secured by collateral (CDs, securities, cash deposits) to mitigate credit risk. Banks track collateral securing overdraft lines for LTV monitoring, margin calls, regulat

attributes.name: currency_id

attributes.name: facility_id

attributes.name: origination_channel_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to channel.channel. Business justification: Fair lending and channel profitability reporting require knowing which channel originated an overdraft facility. Regulators (CFPB, OCC) analyze whether overdraft opt-in rates differ by channel. Produc

attributes.name: party_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.party. Business justification: Credit risk and Basel regulatory capital: overdraft facilities are credit exposures requiring direct obligor (party) identification for single-counterparty exposure limits, credit risk reporting, and

attributes.name: primary_overdraft_deposit_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the deposit account (DDA, savings, money market) to which this overdraft facility is attached.

attributes.name: product_type_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.product_type. Business justification: Overdraft facilities are distinct credit products with specific Basel RWA treatment, CECL portfolio segment classification, and fee schedule types defined in product_type. Regulatory capital reporting

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to risk.risk_limit. Business justification: Overdraft facility approved_limit_amount must not exceed the governing risk limit. Credit governance requires each facility to reference its authorizing risk limit for breach monitoring, limit utiliza

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to collateral.collateral_pledge. Business justification: Secured overdraft facilities: an overdraft line secured by a formal pledge agreement requires the facility to reference the specific collateral_pledge (legal instrument), distinct from the collateral_

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date the overdraft facility was approved by the bank. Used for audit trail and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: approved_limit_amount
attributes.description: Maximum overdraft amount approved by the bank for this facility. Represents the ceiling for negative balance coverage.

attributes.name: auto_repayment_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether automatic repayment of overdraft balance is enabled. True if incoming deposits automatically reduce the overdraft balance. False if manual repayment is required.

attributes.name: cancellation_date
attributes.description: Date the overdraft facility was cancelled and ceased to be available. Null if facility is not cancelled.

attributes.name: cancellation_reason
attributes.description: Reason the overdraft facility was cancelled: customer request, account closure, adverse credit review, regulatory requirement, fraud detection, or other. Null if facility is not cancelled.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the overdraft facility record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: current_utilization_amount
attributes.description: Current outstanding overdraft balance being utilized by the customer. Represents the negative balance covered by the facility. Zero if account is not overdrawn.

attributes.name: daily_fee_cap_amount
attributes.description: Maximum total overdraft fees that can be charged in a single day. Used to limit customer exposure to excessive fees. Null if no daily cap applies.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date the overdraft facility becomes active and available for use. Marks the start of the facility lifecycle.

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date the overdraft facility expires and is no longer available for use. Null for open-ended facilities with no predetermined end date.

attributes.name: facility_type

attributes.name: grace_period_days
attributes.description: Number of days the customer has to repay the overdraft balance before fees or interest are applied. Zero if no grace period applies.

attributes.name: interest_calculation_method

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp

attributes.name: last_usage_date

attributes.name: lifetime_usage_count
