attributes.name: minimum_transfer_amount
attributes.description: Minimum amount that must be transferred from the linked protection source to cover an overdraft. Used to avoid multiple small transfers. Zero if no minimum applies.

attributes.name: monthly_fee_cap_amount
attributes.description: Maximum total overdraft fees that can be charged in a calendar month. Used to limit customer exposure to excessive fees. Null if no monthly cap applies.
attributes.references: Consumer Financial Protection Bureau (CFPB) - Fee Disclosure

attributes.name: notification_preference
attributes.description: Customer preferred channel for receiving overdraft usage notifications: email, SMS text message, mobile app push notification, postal mail, or none.

attributes.name: opt_in_date
attributes.description: Date the customer provided opt-in consent for overdraft coverage per Regulation E. Null if customer has not opted in or opt-in is not applicable.

attributes.name: opt_in_status
attributes.description: Customer opt-in status for overdraft coverage on ATM and one-time debit card transactions per Federal Reserve Regulation E. Opted in indicates customer consented. Opted out indicates customer declined. Pending indicates awaiting customer decision. Not applicable for non-Reg E overdraft types.

attributes.name: opt_out_date
attributes.description: Date the customer revoked opt-in consent and opted out of overdraft coverage. Null if customer has not opted out.

attributes.name: overdraft_facility_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the overdraft facility. Active indicates the facility is operational and available for use. Suspended indicates temporary hold. Cancelled indicates customer or bank terminated the arrangement. Expired indicates the facility reached its end date. Pending activation indicates awaiting customer opt-in or bank approval.

attributes.name: overdraft_fee_amount
attributes.description: Standard fee charged per overdraft occurrence when the account balance goes negative and bank coverage is used. Zero if no overdraft fee applies.
attributes.references: Consumer Financial Protection Bureau (CFPB) - Fee Disclosure

attributes.name: protection_source_type
attributes.description: Identifies the source of funds used to cover overdrafts: bank coverage (bank absorbs with fee), linked savings account, linked line of credit, linked credit card, or none (no protection).

attributes.name: review_date
attributes.description: Next scheduled date for bank review of the overdraft facility terms, limit, and customer eligibility. Used for periodic reassessment.

attributes.name: risk_rating
attributes.description: Bank internal risk assessment of the overdraft facility based on customer credit profile, usage patterns, and repayment history. Used for credit risk management and limit adjustments.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the operational system of record that originated this overdraft facility record: T24 (Temenos T24), FIS_PROFILE (FIS Profile), MANUAL (manual entry), MIGRATION (data migration).

attributes.name: transfer_fee_amount
attributes.description: Fee charged per overdraft transfer event when funds are moved from the linked protection source to cover a negative balance. Zero if no per-transfer fee applies.
attributes.references: Consumer Financial Protection Bureau (CFPB) - Fee Disclosure

attributes.name: transfer_increment_amount
attributes.description: Fixed increment amount for transfers from linked protection source (e.g., transfers occur in multiples of 50.00). Null if transfers match exact overdraft amount.

attributes.name: utilization_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of the approved limit currently utilized, calculated as (current_utilization_amount / approved_limit_amount) * 100. Used for credit risk monitoring.

products.name: account_limit
products.description: Configurable account-level operational limits governing transaction behavior. Captures limit type (daily withdrawal limit, daily transfer limit, ATM cash limit, wire transfer limit, ACH debit limit, minimum balance requirement), limit amount, currency, effective date, expiry date, approval authority, and override flag. Supports risk controls, fraud prevention, and regulatory compliance for consumer protection.
products.reference: Account Transaction Limits — T24 Limit Framework

attributes.name: account_limit_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the account limit record. Primary key for the account limit entity.

attributes.name: currency_id
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code in which the limit amount is denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).
attributes.references: ISO 4217 - Currency and Funds Code List

attributes.name: deposit_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the deposit or transactional account to which this limit applies. Links to the account master registry.
attributes.references: Core Banking System - Temenos T24 Account Master

attributes.name: obligation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.obligation. Business justification: Account limits (transaction limits, withdrawal limits) are often mandated by specific regulatory obligations (e.g., CFPB rules, BSA thresholds). The account_limit.regulatory_mandate_code is a denormal

attributes.name: risk_limit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to risk.risk_limit. Business justification: Operational account limits (daily withdrawal, transfer caps) are cascaded from risk appetite framework risk limits. Linking account_limit to its governing risk_limit enables limit hierarchy traceabili

attributes.name: setting_channel_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to channel.channel. Business justification: Fraud investigation and audit trails require knowing which channel set or last modified an account limit (ATM withdrawal cap, transfer limit). When a limit override precedes a fraud event, investigato

attributes.name: aml_threshold_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this limit is configured to support Anti-Money Laundering (AML) monitoring and Currency Transaction Report (CTR) thresholds. True if AML-related, False otherwise.
attributes.references: Bank Secrecy Act (BSA), Financial Crimes Enforcement Network (FinCEN)

attributes.name: amount
attributes.description: The monetary threshold or minimum balance requirement for this limit. Expressed in the currency specified in the currency_code field.

attributes.name: approval_authority
attributes.description: The role, department, or individual authorized to approve this limit configuration. May reference a user ID, role code, or department name.
attributes.references: Basel Committee on Banking Supervision - Internal Controls Framework

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this limit was approved. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: breach_action_code
attributes.description: Action to be taken when a transaction would breach this limit. Values: BLOCK (reject transaction), WARN (alert but allow), ALLOW_WITH_FEE (permit with penalty charge), ESCALATE (require manual approval).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this limit record was first created in the system. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: customer_requested_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this limit was requested by the customer (e.g., self-imposed spending limit) rather than being bank-mandated. True if customer-initiated, False if bank-imposed.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date from which this account limit becomes active and enforceable. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: The date on which this account limit ceases to be active. Nullable for limits with no predetermined end date. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: fraud_prevention_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this limit is primarily configured for fraud prevention purposes. True if the limit is part of fraud controls, False otherwise.
attributes.references: Financial Crimes Enforcement Network (FinCEN) - Anti-Money Laundering Guidelines

attributes.name: last_reset_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the utilization counters were last reset. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: last_utilization_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time of the most recent transaction that utilized this limit. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: limit_description
attributes.description: Free-text description providing additional context or business rationale for this limit configuration.
attributes.references: Core Banking System - Temenos T24 Limit Management

attributes.name: limit_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the account limit. Values: ACTIVE (limit is currently enforced), SUSPENDED (temporarily not enforced), EXPIRED (past expiry date), PENDING (awaiting approval or activation), CANCELLED (permanently deactivated).
attributes.references: Core Banking System - Temenos T24 Limit Management

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: Identifier of the user or system that last modified this limit record. May be a user ID, employee number, or system identifier.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this limit record was last modified. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: notification_channel
attributes.description: Preferred communication channel for limit-related notifications. Values: EMAIL (email notification), SMS (text message), MOBILE_APP (push notification), PHONE (voice call), NONE (no notification).
attributes.references: Core Banking System - Temenos T24 Customer Communication

attributes.name: notification_threshold_amount
attributes.description: The utilization amount at which the customer or bank should be notified (e.g., alert when 80% of limit is reached). Nullable if no notification threshold is configured.
attributes.references: Core Banking System - Temenos T24 Alert Management

attributes.name: override_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this limit can be overridden by authorized personnel during transaction processing. True if override is permitted, False otherwise.
attributes.references: Basel Committee on Banking Supervision - Operational Risk Management

attributes.name: override_reason
attributes.description: Business justification or reason code for allowing limit overrides. Populated when override_flag is True.
attributes.references: Consumer Financial Protection Bureau (CFPB) - Consumer Protection Guidelines

attributes.name: reset_frequency_code
attributes.description: Frequency at which the utilization counters are reset to zero. Values: DAILY (reset at start of each day), WEEKLY (reset weekly), MONTHLY (reset monthly), QUARTERLY (reset quarterly), ANNUAL (reset annually), NONE (no automatic reset).
attributes.references: Core Banking System - Temenos T24 Limit Management

attributes.name: risk_category
attributes.description: Risk classification of the account or customer for which this limit is configured. Used to determine appropriate limit thresholds. Values: LOW (minimal risk), MEDIUM (moderate risk), HIGH (elevated risk), CRITICAL (highest risk requiring strictest controls).
attributes.references: Basel Committee on Banking Supervision - Risk Management Principles

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the operational system from which this limit record originated (e.g., T24, FIS_PROFILE, ONLINE_BANKING).
attributes.references: Core Banking System - Temenos T24 System Integration

attributes.name: type_code
attributes.description: Classification of the operational limit governing transaction behavior. Values: DAILY_WITHDRAWAL (daily withdrawal limit), DAILY_TRANSFER (daily transfer limit), ATM_CASH (ATM cash limit), WIRE_TRANSFER (wire transfer limit), ACH_DEBIT (Automated Clearing House debit limit), MIN_BALANCE (minimum balance requirement).
attributes.references: Basel Committee on Banking Supervision - Operational Risk Management

attributes.name: utilization_amount
attributes.description: Current cumulative amount utilized against this limit within the applicable time period (e.g., daily, monthly). Reset frequency depends on limit type.
attributes.references: Core Banking System - Temenos T24 Limit Tracking

attributes.name: utilization_count
attributes.description: Number of transactions that have been applied against this limit within the current period. Used for frequency-based limits.
attributes.references: Core Banking System - Temenos T24 Limit Tracking

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Version number of this limit record, incremented with each modification. Used for optimistic locking and audit trail.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: Identifier of the user or system that created this limit record. May be a user ID, employee number, or system identifier.

products.name: status_history
products.description: Immutable audit log of all account lifecycle status transitions for deposit accounts. Captures previous status, new status, effective date and time, reason code, initiating channel, authorizing officer, and supporting documentation reference. Status transitions include: pending activation → active → dormant → reactivated → closed → written off. Required for regulatory examination, AML dormancy monitoring, and FDIC insurance claim processing.

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.kyc_record. Business justification: AML/compliance audit trail: account status changes (freeze, restriction, dormancy) triggered by KYC findings must be traceable to the specific KYC record that caused the action. Regulators and examine

attributes.name: aml_review_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this status transition triggers mandatory AML review procedures (e.g., dormant to active reactivation, sudden closure after large deposits). True if AML review is required, False otherwise.
attributes.references: Bank Secrecy Act (BSA) - AML Program Requirements

attributes.name: authorizing_officer_name
attributes.description: Full name of the bank officer who authorized the status change. Provides human-readable audit trail for regulatory examination.

attributes.name: balance_at_transition
attributes.description: The account balance at the moment of status transition. Critical for FDIC insurance claim processing, escheatment reporting, and write-off calculations. Expressed in the account currency.

attributes.name: currency_code

attributes.name: customer_notification_sent_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the account holder was notified of the status change via the registered communication channels. True if notification was sent, False otherwise. Required for consumer protection compliance.

attributes.name: dormancy_period_days
attributes.description: Number of days the account remained inactive before transitioning to dormant status. Populated only for transitions to dormant status. Used for escheatment timeline calculations and regulatory dormancy reporting.

attributes.name: effective_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time when the new status became effective for the account. This is the business event timestamp, distinct from the record creation timestamp. Critical for regulatory timeline reconstruction and FDIC insurance claim processing.

attributes.name: hold_authority

attributes.name: hold_reference_number

attributes.references: OFAC Sanctions Compliance - Account Blocking Procedures

attributes.name: last_transaction_date
attributes.description: The date of the most recent customer-initiated transaction before the status change. Used to calculate dormancy periods and support escheatment compliance. Null for newly opened accounts.
attributes.references: State Escheatment Laws - Activity Tracking Requirements

attributes.name: new_status

attributes.name: previous_status

Used for root cause analysis, compliance reporting, and operational metrics. attributes.name: reversal_flag

attributes.name: supporting_document_reference

products.name: interest_rate
products.description: Effective interest rate configuration and complete tiered rate structure applied to deposit accounts and products. Captures base rate type (fixed, variable, tiered), benchmark index (SOFR, Fed Funds, Prime), spread over benchmark in BPS, effective date, expiry date, promotional rate flag, and promotional expiry date. Includes embedded tier-level detail: tier sequence number, minimum and maximum balance thresholds, annual percentage yield (APY), annual percentage rate (APR), and product applicability per tier. Tiered structures enable the bank to offer higher rates for larger balances on savings and money market accounts. Single source of truth for ALL rate configuration including tiered breakpoints — no separate rate tier reference table exists. Supports NIM reporting, ALCO rate sensitivity analysis, Reg DD APY disclosure requirements, and product pricing governance.
products.reference: Deposit Rate Configuration — Reg DD APY / ALCO Rate Management

attributes.name: rate_benchmark_id
attributes.description: The market benchmark index to which variable rates are tied. SOFR (Secured Overnight Financing Rate), FED_FUNDS (Federal Funds Rate), PRIME (Prime Rate), LIBOR (London Interbank Offered Rate - legacy), TREASURY (US Treasury Rate), or NONE for fixed rates.
attributes.references: Federal Reserve System (Fed) / SOFR Transition Guidelines

attributes.name: superseded_by_rate_interest_rate_id
attributes.description: Reference to the account_interest_rate_id that supersedes this rate configuration. Used to maintain rate change history and audit trail.
attributes.references: Core Banking System (Temenos T24 / FIS Profile) Rate Management

attributes.name: yield_curve_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to security.yield_curve. Business justification: Deposit interest rates and FTP rates are derived from yield curves for ALM, transfer pricing, and IRRBB regulatory capital calculations. A banking domain expert expects interest_rate.yield_curve_id →

attributes.name: accrual_method
attributes.description: The day-count convention used for interest accrual calculation. Actual/360 (actual days over 360-day year), Actual/365 (actual days over 365-day year), or 30/360 (assumes 30-day months).
attributes.references: International Swaps and Derivatives Association (ISDA) Day Count Conventions

attributes.name: base_rate
attributes.description: The base annual interest rate expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.025000 for 2.5%). For fixed rates, this is the final rate. For variable rates, this is the starting point before spread adjustment.
attributes.references: Federal Reserve System (Fed) Interest Rate Standards

attributes.name: compounding_frequency
attributes.description: The frequency at which interest is compounded and added to the principal balance. Daily compounding is most common for deposit accounts.

attributes.name: created_by_user
attributes.description: The user ID or system identifier of the person or process that created this interest rate configuration record. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date from which this interest rate configuration becomes active and begins accruing interest on applicable accounts.

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: The date on which this interest rate configuration expires and is no longer applicable. Null indicates an open-ended rate configuration.

attributes.name: ftp_rate
attributes.description: The internal Funds Transfer Pricing rate used to allocate funding costs or credits between business lines. Expressed as a decimal. Used for management accounting and profitability attribution.
attributes.references: Asset-Liability Committee (ALCO) / Funds Transfer Pricing (FTP) Framework

attributes.name: interest_payment_frequency
attributes.description: The frequency at which accrued interest is credited to the customer's account or paid out. Most deposit accounts credit interest monthly.
attributes.references: Consumer Financial Protection Bureau (CFPB) Regulation DD

attributes.name: is_promotional
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is a promotional interest rate offered as part of a marketing campaign or customer acquisition strategy. True if promotional, False if standard rate.
attributes.references: Consumer Financial Protection Bureau (CFPB) Regulation DD

attributes.name: is_tax_advantaged
attributes.description: Indicates whether this rate applies to a tax-advantaged account type (e.g., IRA, HSA, 529 plan) where interest may be tax-deferred or tax-exempt. True if tax-advantaged, False otherwise.

attributes.name: maximum_balance_cap
attributes.description: The maximum account balance on which interest is paid at this rate. Balances exceeding this cap may earn a different rate or no additional interest.
attributes.references: Consumer Financial Protection Bureau (CFPB) Regulation DD

attributes.name: minimum_balance_requirement
attributes.description: The minimum account balance required to earn the stated interest rate. Balances below this threshold may earn a lower rate or no interest.
attributes.references: Consumer Financial Protection Bureau (CFPB) Regulation DD

attributes.name: nim_contribution_bps
attributes.business_glossary_term: Net Interest Margin (NIM) Contribution in Basis Points (BPS)
attributes.description: The estimated contribution of this rate configuration to the bank's Net Interest Margin (NIM), expressed in basis points. Used for profitability analysis and ALCO reporting.
attributes.references: Asset-Liability Committee (ALCO) / Net Interest Margin (NIM) Reporting Framework

attributes.name: product_code
attributes.description: The deposit product code (e.g., DDA, SAV, MMA, CD) to which this rate structure applies. Used for product-level rate configuration.

attributes.name: promotional_expiry_date
attributes.description: The date on which the promotional rate expires and reverts to the standard rate. Only applicable when is_promotional is True.
attributes.references: Consumer Financial Protection Bureau (CFPB) Regulation DD

attributes.name: rate_approval_authority
attributes.description: The governance body or role that approved this interest rate configuration. ALCO (Asset-Liability Committee), TREASURY, PRODUCT_MANAGEMENT, BRANCH_MANAGER, or EXECUTIVE_COMMITTEE.

attributes.name: rate_approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which this interest rate configuration was formally approved by the designated approval authority.

attributes.name: rate_ceiling

attributes.name: rate_change_frequency

attributes.name: rate_floor
attributes.description: The minimum interest rate that can be applied regardless of benchmark index movements. Protects the bank from negative or excessively low rates. Expressed as a decimal.
attributes.references: Asset-Liability Committee (ALCO) Rate Risk Management Framework

attributes.name: rate_status
attributes.description: The current lifecycle status of this interest rate configuration. Active (currently in effect), Pending (approved but not yet effective), Expired (past expiry date), Superseded (replaced by newer rate), or Suspended (temporarily inactive).

attributes.name: rate_type
attributes.description: Classification of the interest rate structure: fixed (constant rate), variable (indexed to benchmark), tiered (rate varies by balance threshold), or promotional (temporary marketing rate).
attributes.references: Basel Committee on Banking Supervision (BCBS) Interest Rate Risk Guidelines

attributes.name: regulatory_disclosure_text
attributes.description: The standardized disclosure text required by Regulation DD for customer communication regarding this interest rate, including APY calculation methodology and any conditions or limitations.

attributes.name: relationship_bonus_bps
attributes.description: Additional basis points added to the base rate for customers meeting relationship pricing criteria. For example, 25 BPS = 0.25% rate bonus.

attributes.name: relationship_pricing_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this rate is eligible for relationship pricing adjustments based on the customer's total Assets Under Management (AUM) or product holdings with the bank. True if eligible, False otherwise.

attributes.name: spread_bps
attributes.description: The spread over the benchmark index expressed in basis points (BPS). One basis point equals 0.01%. For example, 50 BPS = 0.50%. Applied to variable rates only.

attributes.name: tax_withholding_rate
attributes.description: The percentage of interest income subject to tax withholding, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.2400 for 24%). Applicable for certain account types and jurisdictions.

attributes.name: tier_apr
attributes.description: The Annual Percentage Rate for this balance tier, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.024693 for 2.4693% APR). APR is the simple interest rate before compounding effects.

attributes.description: Number of days in the interest accrual period for this installment. Calculated based on the day count convention specified in the loan agreement (e.g., 30/360, Actual/365, Actual/Actual).

attributes.name: accrual_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the interest accrual period for this installment. Typically the due date of this payment. Used to calculate the number of days for interest accrual.

attributes.name: accrual_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the interest accrual period for this installment. Typically the day after the previous payment due date or the loan disbursement date for the first installment.

attributes.name: actual_interest_amount
attributes.description: Actual interest amount applied from the received payment. May differ from scheduled interest due to payment timing, rate changes, or payment allocation rules.

attributes.description: Actual total amount received for this installment. May differ from scheduled amount due to partial payments, prepayments, or payment shortfalls. Null if no payment has been received.

attributes.description: Actual date on which the payment was received and applied to the loan. Null if payment has not yet been received. Used to calculate days past due and assess payment performance.

attributes.description: Actual principal reduction amount applied from the received payment. May differ from scheduled principal due to payment allocation rules, prepayments, or shortfalls.

attributes.name: beginning_balance
attributes.description: Outstanding principal balance at the start of this payment period, before the current installment is applied. Represents the loan balance carried forward from the previous period.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this amortization schedule entry was first created in the system. Represents the audit trail for schedule generation.

attributes.description: Method used to calculate the number of days in the accrual period and the year basis for interest calculations. Standard conventions include 30/360, Actual/365, Actual/360, and Actual/Actual.

attributes.description: Number of days this payment is overdue, calculated as the difference between current date (or actual payment date) and the due date. Zero or null if payment is current or paid on time. Critical metric for delinquency tracking and credit risk assessment.

attributes.name: due_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date on which this installment payment is contractually due. Used for payment processing, delinquency tracking, and cash flow forecasting.

attributes.name: ending_balance
attributes.description: Outstanding principal balance remaining after this scheduled payment is applied. Calculated as beginning balance minus scheduled principal amount. Becomes the beginning balance for the next period.

attributes.name: installment_number
attributes.description: Sequential number of this payment installment within the loan's repayment schedule. Starts at 1 for the first payment and increments for each subsequent scheduled payment.

attributes.name: interest_rate
attributes.description: Annual interest rate in effect for this payment period, expressed as a decimal. May vary across installments for variable-rate loans or after rate resets. Used to calculate the scheduled interest amount.

attributes.name: is_final_payment
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is the final scheduled payment for the loan. True for the last installment that brings the ending balance to zero. Used to identify loan maturity and schedule completion.

attributes.name: is_restructured
attributes.description: Indicates whether this installment is part of a restructured payment schedule. True if the loan has been modified after origination due to borrower hardship, forbearance, or other restructuring events. Critical for regulatory reporting and credit risk classification.

attributes.name: late_fee_amount
attributes.description: Late payment fee assessed for this installment if payment was received after the due date. Calculated according to the loan agreement's late fee provisions. Null if payment was on time or no late fee was assessed.

attributes.name: payment_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which payments are scheduled for this loan. Determines the interval between installments and affects the amortization calculation.

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: Method by which the actual payment was received for this installment. Includes ACH (Automated Clearing House), wire transfer, check, cash, card payment, or internal account transfer. Null if payment has not been received.

attributes.name: payment_status
attributes.description: Current status of this scheduled installment payment. Tracks whether the payment is still scheduled, has been paid in full, partially paid, is overdue, has been waived, or has been deferred to a future date.

attributes.name: prepayment_amount
attributes.description: Additional principal amount paid beyond the scheduled principal for this installment. Represents voluntary prepayments that reduce the outstanding balance faster than scheduled. Null if no prepayment occurred.

attributes.name: restructure_date
attributes.description: Date on which the loan restructuring became effective, if applicable. Null for non-restructured installments. Used to track troubled debt restructuring (TDR) events and assess credit quality.

attributes.name: schedule_generation_date
attributes.description: Date on which this version of the amortization schedule was generated or regenerated. Updated whenever the schedule is recalculated due to loan modifications or rate changes.

attributes.name: schedule_version
attributes.description: Version number of this amortization schedule. Increments each time the schedule is regenerated due to loan modifications, restructuring, rate resets, or payment plan changes. Version 1 is the original schedule at loan origination.

attributes.name: scheduled_fee_amount
attributes.description: Any contractually scheduled fees or charges included in this installment, such as servicing fees, insurance premiums, or other recurring charges.

attributes.name: scheduled_interest_amount
attributes.description: Contractually scheduled interest charge for this payment period. Calculated based on the beginning balance, interest rate, and accrual period. Represents the cost of borrowing for this period.

attributes.name: scheduled_principal_amount
attributes.description: Contractually scheduled principal reduction amount for this installment. This portion of the payment reduces the outstanding loan balance.

attributes.name: total_payment_amount
attributes.description: Total amount due for this installment, calculated as the sum of scheduled principal, interest, and fees. This is the amount the borrower is contractually obligated to pay on the due date.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this amortization schedule entry was last modified. Updated whenever payment status changes, actual payment information is recorded, or schedule adjustments are made.

attributes.name: waived_amount
attributes.description: Total amount of scheduled payment that was waived or forgiven for this installment. May include waived principal, interest, or fees due to loan modifications, hardship programs, or settlement agreements.

products.name: drawdown
products.description: Records each individual drawdown (disbursement) event against a committed credit facility, capturing drawdown date, drawdown amount, currency, applicable interest rate at drawdown, drawdown purpose, funding account, value date, and settlement reference. For revolving facilities, tracks multiple drawdowns and repayments over the facility lifecycle. Key transactional event in Loan IQ's drawdown module.

Ag

attributes.name: amount
attributes.description: The principal amount drawn down by the borrower in this transaction, denominated in the drawdown currency. This amount reduces available facility headroom.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which the drawdown request was approved by the credit officer or automated system. Required for audit trail and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: available_commitment_amount
attributes.description: The remaining undrawn commitment amount available under the facility after this drawdown. Calculated as facility limit minus total outstanding drawdowns.

attributes.name: benchmark_rate
attributes.description: The reference benchmark rate used for floating-rate drawdowns: SOFR (Secured Overnight Financing Rate), LIBOR (legacy), EURIBOR, SONIA, ESTR, PRIME, or BASE rate.

attributes.name: beneficiary_account_number
attributes.description: The borrowers account number or IBAN to which the drawdown funds were credited. May be an internal DDA or an external account at another institution.

attributes.name: commitment_utilization_pct
attributes.description: The percentage of the total facility commitment utilized after this drawdown, calculated as (total outstanding + this drawdown) / facility limit * 100. Used for covenant monitoring.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this drawdown record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: disbursement_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time when the drawdown funds were released from the funding account. Critical for interest accrual calculation and operational reporting.

attributes.name: drawdown_date
attributes.description: The business date on which the borrower requested or executed the drawdown. This is the transaction date for accounting and interest accrual purposes.

attributes.name: drawdown_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the drawdown transaction: pending (awaiting approval), approved (authorized), disbursed (funds sent), settled (funds received), failed (payment failed), cancelled (voided), or reversed (unwound). attributes.name: drawdown_type
attributes.description: Classification of the drawdown event: scheduled (pre-agreed), unscheduled (ad-hoc), revolving (under revolving facility), term (under term loan), swing_line (short-term bridge), or overdraft (emergency).

attributes.name: fee_amount
attributes.description: Any upfront or transaction fee charged to the borrower for this drawdown event. May include commitment fees, utilization fees, or processing fees.

attributes.name: fee_currency
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the fee amount. May differ from drawdown currency in multi-currency facilities.

attributes.name: funding_account_number
attributes.description: The internal general ledger or nostro account number from which the drawdown funds were disbursed. Used for reconciliation and funds transfer pricing (FTP).

attributes.name: gl_posting_date
attributes.description: The accounting date on which this drawdown transaction was posted to the general ledger. Used for financial reporting and period-end close processes.

attributes.name: interest_period_days
attributes.description: The number of days in the interest period for this drawdown (e.g., 30, 90, 180). Determines the frequency of interest rate resets for floating-rate drawdowns.

attributes.name: interest_rate
attributes.description: The all-in interest rate applicable to this drawdown at the time of execution, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0525 for 5.25%). For floating rates, this is the initial rate.

attributes.name: interest_rate_type
attributes.description: Type of interest rate applicable to this drawdown: fixed (locked rate), floating (benchmark + spread), variable (adjustable), or zero (non-interest bearing).

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this drawdown record was last updated. Tracks changes to status, amounts, or other mutable fields for audit purposes.

attributes.name: maturity_date
attributes.description: The date on which this drawdown principal is due for repayment. For revolving facilities, this may be the next scheduled repayment date or facility maturity.

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: The payment rail or mechanism used to disburse the drawdown funds: wire transfer, ACH (Automated Clearing House), RTGS (Real-Time Gross Settlement), SWIFT, internal book transfer, or check.

attributes.name: purpose
attributes.description: Business purpose or use of funds for this drawdown as declared by the borrower. May be required for covenant compliance, regulatory reporting, or trade finance documentation.
attributes.references: UCP 600 (Uniform Customs and Practice for Documentary Credits)

attributes.name: reference_number
attributes.description: Externally visible unique reference number for this drawdown event, used in customer communications, SWIFT messages, and settlement instructions.

attributes.name: regulatory_reporting_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this drawdown must be included in regulatory reports such as CCAR, DFAST, or Basel III capital adequacy filings. True if reportable, false otherwise.

attributes.name: repayment_type
attributes.description: The repayment structure for this drawdown: bullet (single payment at maturity), amortizing (scheduled installments), revolving (flexible repayment and re-draw), or on_demand (callable).

attributes.name: risk_weight_pct
attributes.description: The Basel III risk weight percentage applied to this drawdown exposure for Risk-Weighted Assets (RWA) calculation. Varies by borrower credit rating and collateral.

attributes.name: settlement_date
attributes.description: The date on which the drawdown funds were actually transferred to the borrowers account. Reflects T+0, T+1, or T+2 settlement depending on payment rail.

attributes.name: settlement_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time when the drawdown funds were confirmed as received in the beneficiary account. Used for reconciliation and SLA tracking.

attributes.name: spread_bps
attributes.description: The credit spread over the benchmark rate, expressed in basis points (e.g., 150.00 for 1.50%). This spread reflects the borrowers credit risk premium.

attributes.name: swift_message_reference
attributes.description: The SWIFT MT103 or MT202 message reference number for cross-border or interbank drawdown settlements. Used for payment tracking and reconciliation.

attributes.name: syndication_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this drawdown is part of a syndicated loan facility with multiple lender participants. True if syndicated, false if bilateral.

attributes.name: trade_finance_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the underlying trade finance instrument if this drawdown is linked to a letter of credit, documentary collection, or bill of lading. Used for UCP 600 compliance.

attributes.name: value_date
attributes.description: The effective date on which funds are made available to the borrower and interest accrual begins. May differ from drawdown_date due to settlement cycles.

products.name: repayment
products.description: Records each principal and interest repayment transaction against a loan account, including payment date, payment amount, principal component, interest component, fee component, penalty interest (if any), payment method (ACH, wire, RTGS), payment source account, outstanding balance post-payment, and whether the payment was on-time, early, or late. Feeds NPL classification and delinquency tracking.
products.reference: Finastra Fusion Loan IQ — Payment / Repayment

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to payment.payment_transaction. Business justification: Loan repayments are executed as payment transactions. Banks link repayment to payment_transaction for delinquency monitoring, payment reconciliation, and regulatory reporting (e.g., CRR Article 178 de

attributes.name: source_account_deposit_account_id

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the repayment transaction was approved for processing. Null for automated payments that do not require manual approval.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Identifier of the employee or system user who approved the repayment transaction, particularly for manual or exception-based payments. Used for audit and compliance.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this repayment record was first created in the system. Audit field for data lineage and compliance.

attributes.name: days_past_due
attributes.description: Number of days between the scheduled_payment_date and the actual payment_date. Positive values indicate late payment; negative values indicate early payment. Zero indicates on-time payment.

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: Foreign Exchange (FX) rate applied if the repayment currency differs from the loan currency. Null if no currency conversion occurred.

attributes.name: fee_amount
attributes.description: Portion of the payment allocated to fees such as servicing fees, processing fees, or prepayment fees. Excludes penalty interest.

attributes.name: interest_amount
attributes.description: Portion of the payment allocated to accrued interest charges on the loan. Contributes to Net Interest Income (NII) calculation.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional comments or context about the repayment transaction. Used for customer service, dispute resolution, and audit purposes.

attributes.name: outstanding_balance_after_payment
attributes.description: Remaining principal balance on the loan immediately after this repayment is applied. Critical for Exposure at Default (EAD) and credit risk calculations.

attributes.name: payment_amount
attributes.description: Total amount received in this repayment transaction, including principal, interest, fees, and penalties. Gross payment amount before allocation.

attributes.name: payment_date
attributes.description: The date on which the repayment was received and applied to the loan account. This is the business event date for the repayment transaction.

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: The payment instrument or mechanism used to make the repayment. Includes Automated Clearing House (ACH), wire transfer, Real-Time Gross Settlement (RTGS), check, cash, or direct debit.

attributes.name: payment_processor_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the payment processing system or hub that handled this transaction. References systems such as ACI Worldwide or Volante payment platforms.

attributes.name: payment_reference_number
attributes.description: External payment reference number or transaction identifier provided by the payment system or customer. Used for reconciliation and customer inquiries.

attributes.name: payment_status
attributes.description: Current processing status of the repayment transaction. Tracks lifecycle from receipt through application to the loan account.

attributes.name: payment_timeliness
attributes.description: Classification of whether the payment was received on-time, early, or late relative to the scheduled_payment_date. Critical for Non-Performing Loan (NPL) classification and delinquency tracking.

attributes.name: payment_type
attributes.description: Classification of the repayment transaction type. Scheduled indicates a regular installment; prepayment indicates early principal reduction; partial indicates less than scheduled amount; balloon indicates large lump-sum; final indicates loan payoff.

attributes.name: penalty_interest_amount
attributes.description: Portion of the payment allocated to penalty interest charges for late payment or covenant breach. Tracked separately for regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: The date on which the repayment was posted to the General Ledger (GL) for accounting purposes. May differ from payment_date due to batch processing.

attributes.name: prepayment_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this repayment includes a prepayment component (principal paid ahead of schedule). True if prepayment occurred; false otherwise.

attributes.name: principal_amount
attributes.description: Portion of the payment allocated to reduce the outstanding principal balance of the loan. Core component for amortization tracking.

attributes.name: reversal_date
attributes.description: The date on which the repayment transaction was reversed, if applicable. Null if the transaction has not been reversed.

attributes.name: reversal_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this repayment transaction has been reversed due to insufficient funds, dispute, or error. True if reversed; false otherwise.

attributes.name: reversal_reason
attributes.description: Explanation for why the repayment was reversed, if applicable. Includes reasons such as insufficient funds, customer dispute, or processing error. Null if not reversed.

attributes.name: scheduled_payment_date
attributes.description: The originally scheduled due date for this repayment installment per the loan amortization schedule. Used to determine if payment is on-time, early, or late.

attributes.name: transaction_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the repayment transaction was processed by the payment system. Used for audit trail and reconciliation.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this repayment record was last modified. Audit field for tracking changes and ensuring data integrity.

attributes.name: value_date
attributes.description: The effective date from which the repayment amount is considered for interest calculation purposes. May differ from payment_date due to settlement timing.

attributes.name: waiver_amount
attributes.description: Amount of fees or penalties waived by the bank as part of this repayment transaction. Used for customer relationship management and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: waiver_reason
attributes.description: Business justification for waiving fees or penalties, if applicable. Includes reasons such as customer goodwill, hardship, or error correction. Null if no waiver applied.

products.name: covenant
products.description: Master record of all financial and non-financial covenants attached to credit facilities, including complete periodic compliance test history. Captures covenant type (financial ratio, reporting, affirmative, negative), threshold value or condition, measurement frequency, grace period, waiver flag, and for each test period: test date, actual measured value, compliance status (pass, breach, waiver granted), breach severity, remediation deadline, and analyst notes. Provides complete covenant lifecycle from definition through ongoing monitoring with full audit trail for regulatory examination and credit review.
products.reference: Finastra Fusion Loan IQ — Covenant Master

attributes.name: accounting_period_id

attributes.name: loan_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to loan.loan_account. Business justification: Covenants are primarily attached to facilities (existing FK), but financial covenants (DSCR, leverage ratio) are tested against the specific loan_account's performance metrics. Adding loan_account_id

attributes.name: obligation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.obligation. Business justification: Loan covenants frequently implement or reference specific regulatory compliance obligations (e.g., maintaining capital ratios per Basel, regulatory reporting covenants). Linking covenant to obligation

attributes.name: pledge_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to collateral.pledge. Business justification: Loan covenants frequently include collateral maintenance requirements (minimum coverage ratios, permitted liens, negative pledge clauses) tied to specific pledge agreements. Covenant monitoring system

attributes.name: amendment_count
attributes.description: Number of times this covenant has been amended since origination, tracking the history of modifications to covenant terms.

attributes.name: breach_consequence
attributes.description: Description of the consequences if the covenant is breached, such as event of default, increased interest rate, mandatory prepayment, or requirement for additional collateral.

attributes.name: covenant_category
attributes.description: Detailed sub-classification of the covenant within its type, such as leverage ratio, interest coverage, debt service coverage, capital expenditure limit, dividend restriction, or asset sale restriction.

attributes.name: covenant_description
attributes.description: Detailed textual description of the covenant terms, conditions, and requirements as documented in the credit agreement.

attributes.name: covenant_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name or title of the covenant as stated in the credit agreement documentation.

attributes.name: covenant_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the covenant indicating whether it is actively monitored, temporarily suspended, waived, terminated, in breach, or breach has been cured.
attributes.references: Loan Syndications and Trading Association (LSTA) Standards

attributes.name: covenant_type
attributes.description: Classification of the covenant based on its nature: financial (ratio-based), affirmative (actions required), negative (restrictions), reporting (disclosure obligations), or information (notification requirements).
attributes.references: Loan Syndications and Trading Association (LSTA) Standards

attributes.name: created_by_user
attributes.description: User identifier or system account that created this covenant record, supporting audit trail requirements.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this covenant record was first created in the system, supporting audit trail and data lineage requirements.

attributes.name: cross_default_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a breach of this covenant triggers cross-default provisions in other credit facilities or debt instruments of the borrower.

attributes.name: cure_mechanism
attributes.description: Description of the permitted cure mechanism, such as equity contribution, asset sale proceeds application, or other remediation methods allowed under the credit agreement.

attributes.name: cure_provision_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the credit agreement includes a cure provision allowing the borrower to remedy a covenant breach through equity injection or other specified actions.

attributes.name: data_classification
attributes.description: Classification level of this covenant record based on sensitivity, typically confidential due to commercial lending terms and borrower financial information.

attributes.name: effective_date

attributes.name: expiration_date

attributes.name: financial_statement_source

attributes.name: grace_period_days

attributes.name: last_amendment_date

attributes.name: measurement_basis

attributes.name: measurement_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which covenant compliance must be tested and reported, such as quarterly for financial covenants or event-driven for negative covenants.

attributes.name: modified_by_user

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this covenant record was last modified, tracking changes for audit and compliance purposes.

attributes.name: reference_number
attributes.description: External business identifier for the covenant, typically referenced in loan documentation and credit agreements.

attributes.name: regulatory_framework
attributes.description: Name of the regulatory framework or requirement that mandates this covenant, such as Basel III, CCAR, DFAST, or CECL. Null for commercial covenants.

attributes.name: regulatory_requirement_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this covenant is mandated by regulatory requirements such as Basel III capital adequacy, Dodd-Frank Act stress testing (DFAST), or Comprehensive Capital Analysis and Review (CCAR) rather than being a commercial lending term.

attributes.name: reporting_deadline_days
attributes.description: Number of days after the measurement period end by which the borrower must report covenant compliance results to the lender, typically 30-45 days for quarterly financial covenants.
attributes.references: Loan Syndications and Trading Association (LSTA) Standards

attributes.name: responsible_party
attributes.description: Entity responsible for maintaining compliance with this covenant, which may be the borrower, a guarantor, parent company, or specific subsidiary.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Name of the operational system from which this covenant record originated, such as Finastra Fusion Loan IQ or other loan origination and covenant tracking systems.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier for this covenant in the source operational system, enabling traceability and reconciliation between lakehouse and source systems.

attributes.name: testing_level
attributes.description: Organizational level at which covenant compliance is measured, such as consolidated group, standalone borrower, guarantor group, or restricted subsidiary group.

attributes.name: threshold_operator

products.name: loan_ecl_provision
products.description: Expected Credit Loss (ECL) impairment provisioning records under CECL (ASC 326) and IFRS 9 frameworks. Captures staging classification (Stage 1, 2, 3 under IFRS 9 or lifetime/12-month under CECL), provision amount, ECL model used, PD, LGD, EAD inputs, discount rate, forward-looking macroeconomic overlays, provision movement (new, release, increase), and reporting period. SSOT for loan loss reserve calculations.

attributes.name: loan_ecl_provision_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Loan Expected Credit Loss (ECL) Provision ID
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the expected credit loss provision record.

attributes.name: accounting_period_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to ledger.accounting_period. Business justification: ECL provisions are calculated and reported per accounting period under IFRS 9. The accounting_period_id is essential for period-close provision reporting, FINREP/COREP regulatory submissions, provisio

attributes.name: collateral_valuation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to collateral.collateral_valuation. Business justification: ECL provision calculations under IFRS9/CECL require current collateral valuations to estimate LGD and recovery amounts. Finance teams must link each provision calculation to the specific valuation use

attributes.name: credit_review_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to loan.credit_review. Business justification: ECL stage classifications and provision amounts are frequently updated following credit reviews. Linking loan_ecl_provision to the credit_review_id that triggered the stage migration or provision upda

attributes.name: currency_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.currency. Business justification: ECL provisions calculated in currencies require currency metadata (rounding, minor unit) for consolidation (group reporting currency translation), regulatory reporting (IFRS 9 disclosures), and GL pos

attributes.name: facility_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to loan.facility. Business justification: ECL provisions are calculated at the loan_account level (existing FK), but portfolio-level provisioning and regulatory reporting (IFRS 9 Stage reporting) require facility-level aggregation. Adding fac

attributes.name: fund_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to asset.fund. Business justification: IFRS 9 ECL for fund finance: ECL provisioning on NAV loans requires direct fund reference to assess NAV trends, fund liquidity, and stress-scenario impacts on collateral value. Auditors and regulators

attributes.name: loan_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the loan for which this ECL provision is calculated.

attributes.name: stress_scenario_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to risk.stress_scenario. Business justification: IFRS 9 ECL calculations require forward-looking macroeconomic scenarios for probability-weighted provisioning. Macroeconomic_scenario is a denormalized scenario name that should reference the full str

attributes.name: stress_test_run_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to risk.stress_test_run. Business justification: IFRS 9 requires ECL provisions to incorporate multiple economic scenarios from specific stress test runs (base/upside/downside weighting). Auditors and regulators require traceability from ECL provisi

attributes.name: trading_book_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to trade.trading_book. Business justification: ECL provisions for loans held in trading books must be attributed to the correct trading book for FRTB regulatory capital allocation and banking-book/trading-book boundary reporting. Regulators requir

attributes.name: yield_curve_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to security.yield_curve. Business justification: IFRS 9 ECL calculation requires discounting lifetime expected credit losses using the effective interest rate derived from a specific yield curve. Regulators (PRA, ECB) require disclosure of the curve

attributes.name: accounting_framework
attributes.description: The accounting standard under which this provision is calculated (IFRS 9, CECL/ASC 326, or Local GAAP).

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this provision calculation was approved for financial reporting.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the credit risk officer or committee that approved this provision calculation.

attributes.name: calculation_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this ECL provision calculation was performed.

attributes.name: collateral_coverage_ratio
attributes.description: The ratio of collateral value to exposure at default (collateral_value / EAD), expressed as a decimal.

attributes.name: collateral_value
attributes.description: The current fair value of collateral securing the loan, used in LGD calculation.

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, assumptions, or qualitative factors considered in the provision calculation.

attributes.name: credit_impaired_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the loan is credit-impaired (Stage 3 under IFRS 9 or NPL status).

attributes.name: cumulative_provision_amount
attributes.description: The total accumulated provision balance for this loan as of the reporting date.

attributes.name: days_past_due
attributes.description: The number of days the loan payment is overdue at the reporting date, a key input for stage classification.

attributes.name: discount_rate
attributes.description: The effective interest rate used to discount expected credit losses to present value, typically the loan's original effective interest rate.

attributes.name: ead
attributes.description: The total value of the loan exposure at the time of default, including drawn and undrawn committed amounts.

attributes.name: ecl_model_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the ECL calculation model or methodology used (e.g., PD/LGD/EAD model, vintage analysis, roll-rate model).

attributes.name: forbearance_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the loan is under forbearance or modification due to borrower financial difficulty.

attributes.name: lgd
attributes.description: The estimated percentage of exposure that will be lost if the borrower defaults, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.45 = 45%).

attributes.name: model_version
attributes.description: The version identifier of the ECL model used for this calculation, supporting model governance and audit trails.

attributes.name: override_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the provision amount was manually overridden by credit risk management.

attributes.name: override_reason
attributes.description: Explanation for any manual override of the model-calculated provision amount.

attributes.name: pd
attributes.description: The probability that the borrower will default over the relevant time horizon (12-month or lifetime), expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.025 = 2.5%).

attributes.name: previous_stage_classification
attributes.description: The credit risk stage classification in the prior reporting period, used to track stage migrations.

attributes.name: provision_amount
attributes.description: The calculated expected credit loss provision amount for this loan at the reporting date.

attributes.name: provision_currency
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the provision amount.

attributes.name: provision_movement_amount
attributes.description: The net change in provision amount for this period (positive for increases, negative for releases).

attributes.name: provision_movement_type
attributes.description: The type of movement in the provision balance: New (initial provision), Increase (additional provision), Decrease (partial release), Release (full release), Write-Off (charge-off against provision), Transfer (stage migration).

attributes.name: provision_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the provision record, used for external reporting and audit trails.

attributes.name: recovery_rate
attributes.description: The expected recovery rate in the event of default, expressed as a decimal (1 - LGD).

attributes.name: regulatory_reporting_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this provision record is included in regulatory capital and stress testing reports (Basel III, CCAR, DFAST).

attributes.name: reporting_period_date
attributes.description: The financial reporting period end date for which this ECL provision is calculated (e.g., quarter-end, year-end).

attributes.name: scenario_weight
attributes.description: The probability weight assigned to this macroeconomic scenario in the weighted-average ECL calculation, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.60 = 60%).

attributes.name: significant_increase_indicator
attributes.business_glossary_term: Significant Increase in Credit Risk Indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether there has been a significant increase in credit risk since initial recognition (triggers Stage 2 under IFRS 9).

attributes.name: stage_classification
attributes.description: Credit risk staging under IFRS 9 (Stage 1, 2, 3) or CECL classification (12-Month ECL, Lifetime ECL, Credit-Impaired). Stage 1: performing loans with no significant increase in credit risk. Stage 2: significant increase in credit risk since origination. Stage 3: credit-impaired/non-performing.

attributes.name: stage_migration_date
attributes.description: The date when the loan migrated to the current stage classification, if applicable.

attributes.name: time_to_default_months
attributes.description: The estimated time horizon in months over which the default probability is measured (12 for Stage 1, lifetime for Stage 2/3).

products.name: modification
products.description: Records all material amendments and restructurings to existing loan facilities, including modification type (maturity extension, rate reduction, principal forgiveness, payment deferral, forbearance), modification date, original terms, modified terms, TDR (Troubled Debt Restructuring) classification flag, regulatory reporting flag, approving authority, and modification rationale. Supports NPL workout management and CECL staging reassessment.
products.reference: Finastra Fusion Loan IQ — Loan Amendment / Restructuring

attributes.description: Primary key for modification

attributes.name: capital_plan_id

attributes.name: channel_id

'collateral_adjustment_flag' on modification si

attributes.name: credit_review_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to loan.credit_review. Business justification: Loan modifications (especially TDRs and forbearance agreements) are typically triggered by or follow a credit review. Linking modification to the credit_review_id that recommended or authorized the mo

attributes.name: currency_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.currency. Business justification: Loan modifications with fee amounts in currencies require currency metadata (rounding, minor unit) for fee calculation, GL posting, and regulatory reporting (TDR reporting, CECL modification tracking)

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to loan.facility. Business justification: Loan modifications (restructurings, amendments) can be applied at the facility level — changing committed amounts, maturity dates, or covenants on the master facility record. modification already has

attributes.name: fraud_case_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fraud.case. Business justification: Loan modification fraud: fraudulent modification requests (employee fraud, unauthorized rate changes, forged borrower consent) are a named fraud typology. Fraud cases are opened against specific modif

attributes.name: gl_journal_entry_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to ledger.journal_entry. Business justification: Loan modifications generate journal entries for TDR classification, modification gain/loss recognition, and principal forgiveness accounting. Required for GAAP/IFRS compliance and regulatory TDR repor

attributes.name: loan_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the loan facility being modified. Links to the core loan master record.

attributes.name: pledge_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to collateral.pledge. Business justification: Loan modifications (forbearance, restructuring, TDR) often require collateral pledge amendments—lien releases, substitutions, or coverage ratio waivers. Workout teams track which pledge was modified a

attributes.name: rate_benchmark_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.rate_benchmark. Business justification: Loan modifications frequently change the rate benchmark (e.g., LIBOR-to-SOFR transition, forbearance restructuring). modified_interest_rate on modification requires a benchmark reference for IBOR tran

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date the modification was formally approved by the designated authority.

attributes.name: approving_authority
attributes.description: The name or title of the credit authority (individual, committee, or board) that approved this modification.
attributes.references: Internal Credit Policy - Delegation of Authority Matrix

attributes.name: approving_authority_level
attributes.description: The hierarchical level of the approving authority. Indicates the escalation tier required for this modification based on risk and materiality.
attributes.references: Internal Credit Policy - Delegation of Authority Matrix

attributes.name: cecl_stage_after
attributes.business_glossary_term: Current Expected Credit Loss (CECL) Stage After Modification
attributes.description: The CECL impairment stage classification of the loan after the modification is applied. Used to track stage migration resulting from the modification.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 326 - Current Expected Credit Losses (CECL)

attributes.name: cecl_stage_before
attributes.business_glossary_term: Current Expected Credit Loss (CECL) Stage Before Modification
attributes.description: The CECL impairment stage classification of the loan immediately prior to the modification (Stage 1: performing, Stage 2: underperforming, Stage 3: credit-impaired).
attributes.references: FASB ASC 326 - Current Expected Credit Losses (CECL)

attributes.name: collateral_adjustment_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this modification involved changes to collateral requirements, pledges, or Loan-to-Value (LTV) ratios. True if collateral terms were adjusted.
attributes.references: Basel III - Credit Risk Mitigation Framework

attributes.name: covenant_waiver_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this modification includes a waiver of one or more financial or operational covenants. True if covenants were waived.

attributes.name: created_by_user
attributes.description: The user ID or name of the individual who created this modification record in the system.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this modification record was first created in the system. Audit trail for data lineage.

attributes.name: execution_date
attributes.description: The date the modification agreement was executed and legally binding documentation was completed.

attributes.name: fee_amount
attributes.description: The fee charged to the borrower for processing and executing the modification. Zero if no fee was assessed.

attributes.name: fee_currency
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the modification fee (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: forbearance_end_date
attributes.description: The date on which the forbearance period ends and normal payment obligations resume. Null if not a forbearance modification.
attributes.references: CARES Act - Forbearance and Deferral Guidance

attributes.name: gain_loss_amount
attributes.description: The accounting gain or loss recognized as a result of the modification, calculated as the difference between the present value of the original and modified cash flows. Positive for gain, negative for loss.

attributes.name: internal_notes
attributes.description: Confidential internal notes and commentary regarding the modification decision, borrower negotiations, and risk considerations. Not shared externally.

attributes.name: is_regulatory_reportable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this modification must be reported to regulatory authorities (e.g., OCC, Fed, FDIC) under applicable reporting frameworks.
attributes.references: FFIEC Call Report - Schedule RC-C Part II

attributes.name: is_tdr
attributes.description: Indicates whether this modification qualifies as a Troubled Debt Restructuring under CECL and regulatory guidance. True if the borrower is experiencing financial difficulty and the lender granted a concession.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 310-40 - Troubled Debt Restructurings by Creditors

attributes.name: legal_documentation_reference
attributes.description: Reference number or identifier for the legal amendment agreement or forbearance letter executed for this modification.

attributes.name: modification_date
attributes.description: The date on which the modification terms become effective and binding. This is the principal business event timestamp for the modification.

attributes.name: modification_number
attributes.description: Business-facing unique reference number assigned to this modification for tracking and reporting purposes.

attributes.name: modification_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the modification request. Tracks the approval and execution workflow.
attributes.references: Internal Credit Policy - Amendment Approval Process

attributes.name: modification_type
attributes.description: Classification of the modification action taken. Determines the nature of the amendment to the original loan terms.
attributes.references: Basel III - Credit Risk Management Framework

attributes.name: modified_interest_rate
attributes.description: The new interest rate applicable to the loan after this modification, expressed as a decimal. Null if rate was not changed.

attributes.name: modified_maturity_date
attributes.description: The new maturity date of the loan after this modification is applied. Null if maturity was not changed.

attributes.name: modified_principal_amount
attributes.description: The principal balance after applying any forgiveness, capitalization, or other principal adjustments. Null if principal was not changed.

attributes.name: npl_status_after
attributes.description: The credit quality classification of the loan after modification. Tracks whether the modification successfully cured the NPL status.
attributes.references: Basel III - Definition of Default and Credit-Impaired Assets

attributes.name: npl_status_before
attributes.description: The credit quality classification of the loan prior to modification. Used to assess whether the modification is part of NPL workout management.
attributes.references: Basel III - Definition of Default and Credit-Impaired Assets

attributes.name: original_interest_rate
attributes.description: The interest rate applicable to the loan prior to this modification, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0525 for 5.25%).

attributes.name: original_maturity_date
attributes.description: The maturity date of the loan prior to this modification. Retained for historical comparison and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: original_principal_amount
attributes.description: The outstanding principal balance of the loan at the time of modification request.

attributes.name: payment_deferral_months
attributes.description: The number of months for which scheduled payments are deferred. Zero if no deferral was granted.
attributes.references: CARES Act - Forbearance and Deferral Guidance

attributes.name: principal_forgiveness_amount
attributes.description: The amount of principal forgiven or written down as part of this modification. Zero if no forgiveness occurred.

attributes.name: rationale
attributes.description: Free-text explanation of the business and credit rationale for granting the modification. Includes borrower circumstances, lender strategy, and expected outcomes.
attributes.references: Internal Credit Policy - Modification Documentation Standards

attributes.name: request_date
attributes.description: The date the borrower or lender initiated the modification request.

attributes.name: updated_by_user
attributes.description: The user ID or name of the individual who last updated this modification record.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this modification record was last updated. Audit trail for data lineage and change tracking.

products.name: collateral_link
products.description: Association entity linking loan facilities to pledged collateral assets managed in the collateral domain. Records lien position (first, second, subordinate), pledged value at origination, current collateral value, LTV ratio at origination and current, collateral coverage ratio, perfection status (UCC filing, mortgage registration), and cross-collateralization flags. This entity owns the loan-side relationship data only; the collateral master record and valuation history remain in the collateral domain.
products.reference: Finastra Fusion Loan IQ — Collateral Linkage

attributes.name: collateral_link_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the collateral link record. Primary key for the association between a loan facility and pledged collateral asset.

attributes.name: collateral_asset_id
attributes.description: Reference to the collateral asset pledged to secure the loan. Links to the collateral master record in the collateral domain.

attributes.name: facility_id
