attributes.name: loan_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the loan facility that is secured by the pledged collateral. Links to the loan master record in the loan domain.

attributes.name: managed_portfolio_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to wealth.managed_portfolio. Business justification: Managed portfolios are pledged as collateral for credit facilities. Collateral perfection process requires linking investment accounts, daily mark-to-market valuation for LTV monitoring, haircut appli

attributes.name: pledge_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to collateral.collateral_pledge. Business justification: The collateral_link table associates loan accounts with collateral; it must reference the legal pledge instrument (perfection, lien position) not just the underlying asset. 'perfection_status', 'lien_

attributes.name: security_instrument_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to security.instrument. Business justification: Collateral_link already has collateral_asset_id (physical/real assets). Securities pledged as collateral require separate instrument reference for market-based valuation, haircut application, and marg

attributes.name: trust_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to wealth.trust_account. Business justification: Trust accounts holding securities or real estate are pledged as collateral for loans. The collateral_link must reference the trust account to support lien perfection, collateral valuation, and regulat

attributes.name: allocation_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage of the collateral asset value allocated to this specific loan facility. Used when a single collateral asset secures multiple loans. Sum of allocation percentages across all links for a collateral asset should equal 1.0000 (100%).

attributes.name: collateral_coverage_ratio
attributes.description: The ratio of current collateral value to outstanding loan balance. Inverse of LTV. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 1.2500 represents 125% coverage). Values above 1.0 indicate over-collateralization.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this collateral link record was first created in the system. Audit trail for data lineage and compliance.

attributes.name: cross_collateralization_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this collateral secures multiple loan facilities under a cross-collateralization agreement. True means the collateral is pledged to secure more than one loan obligation.

attributes.name: cross_default_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a default on this loan triggers default provisions on other loans secured by the same collateral. True means cross-default provisions are in effect.

attributes.name: current_value_as_of_date
attributes.description: The date on which the current collateral value was determined. Indicates the valuation date for the most recent appraisal or market assessment.

attributes.name: eligible_collateral_value_amount
attributes.description: The collateral value after applying regulatory haircuts and eligibility criteria. Used for Risk-Weighted Assets (RWA) calculation and regulatory capital reporting under Basel III.

attributes.name: haircut_percentage
attributes.description: The discount applied to the collateral value for risk management and regulatory capital purposes. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.2000 represents 20% haircut). Reflects potential loss in value during liquidation.

attributes.name: insurance_expiration_date
attributes.description: The date on which the collateral insurance policy expires. Monitored to ensure continuous coverage and covenant compliance.

attributes.name: insurance_policy_number
attributes.description: The policy number for the insurance coverage on the pledged collateral. Used to verify insurance compliance and file claims in the event of loss or damage.

attributes.name: insurance_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the loan agreement requires the borrower to maintain insurance coverage on the pledged collateral. True means insurance is mandatory to protect the lenders security interest.

attributes.name: last_revaluation_date
attributes.description: The date of the most recent collateral revaluation. Used to monitor compliance with revaluation frequency requirements and identify stale valuations.

attributes.name: lender_loss_payee_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the lender is named as loss payee on the collateral insurance policy. True means insurance proceeds will be paid to the lender to protect the security interest.

attributes.name: lien_position
attributes.description: Priority ranking of the lien on the collateral asset. Determines the order of claim in the event of default and liquidation. First lien has highest priority, subordinate has lowest.

attributes.name: link_effective_date
attributes.description: The date on which the collateral was pledged to secure the loan. Marks the beginning of the collateral relationship and the start of lien priority.

attributes.name: link_reference_number
attributes.description: Business-facing reference number for the collateral link relationship. Used in loan documentation and collateral agreements.

attributes.name: link_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the collateral link relationship. Active indicates the collateral is currently securing the loan. Released indicates the lien has been discharged. Impaired indicates collateral value has deteriorated significantly.

attributes.name: link_termination_date
attributes.description: The date on which the collateral lien was released or the collateral relationship ended. Occurs upon loan payoff, collateral substitution, or lien release.

attributes.name: ltv_ratio_at_origination
attributes.description: The ratio of the loan amount to the pledged collateral value at the time of loan origination. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.8000 represents 80%). Key credit risk metric used in underwriting decisions.
attributes.references: Basel III - Standardized Approach for Credit Risk

attributes.name: margin_call_status
attributes.description: Current status of any margin call on this collateral link. None indicates no margin call. Issued indicates a margin call has been sent to the borrower. Cured indicates the borrower has satisfied the margin call.

attributes.name: margin_call_threshold_percentage
attributes.description: The Loan-to-Value (LTV) ratio threshold that triggers a margin call requiring the borrower to pledge additional collateral or pay down the loan. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.8500 represents 85% LTV threshold).

attributes.name: next_revaluation_date
attributes.description: The date on which the next collateral revaluation is scheduled or required. Used for operational planning and compliance monitoring.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional information, special conditions, or exceptions related to the collateral link relationship. Used for documentation and operational context.

attributes.name: perfection_date
attributes.description: The date on which the security interest was perfected through proper filing or registration. Establishes priority over competing claims.

attributes.name: perfection_jurisdiction
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code indicating the jurisdiction where the security interest was perfected. Determines applicable legal framework and enforcement procedures.

attributes.name: perfection_method
attributes.description: The legal mechanism used to perfect the security interest. UCC filing for personal property, mortgage registration for real estate, control agreements for securities, possession for physical assets.

attributes.name: perfection_status
attributes.description: Legal status of the security interest in the collateral. Perfected indicates the lien has been properly filed and recorded (e.g., UCC-1 filing, mortgage registration). Unperfected liens may not be enforceable against third parties.

attributes.name: pledged_value_amount
attributes.description: The monetary value of the collateral pledged at the time of loan origination. Represents the initial collateral valuation used for underwriting and Loan-to-Value (LTV) calculation.

attributes.name: pledged_value_currency
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the pledged value amount. Indicates the currency in which the collateral was valued at origination.

attributes.name: revaluation_frequency
attributes.description: The required frequency for revaluing the pledged collateral. Determined by loan agreement terms, collateral type, and regulatory requirements. Event-driven revaluations occur upon material changes.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Identifier for the operational system that originated this collateral link record. Typically the Loan Origination System or Core Banking System collateral module.

attributes.name: substitution_allowed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the loan agreement permits the borrower to substitute alternative collateral for the currently pledged asset. True means substitution is permitted subject to lender approval.

attributes.name: ucc_expiration_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Uniform Commercial Code (UCC) Filing Expiration Date
attributes.description: The date on which the UCC-1 financing statement expires. Typically five years from filing date. Requires continuation statement to maintain perfection beyond expiration.

attributes.name: ucc_filing_number
attributes.description: The official filing number assigned by the Secretary of State or other filing office for the UCC-1 financing statement. Used to search and verify the perfected security interest.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this collateral link record was last modified. Audit trail for change tracking and data quality monitoring.

products.name: write_off
products.description: Records formal write-off, charge-off, and all subsequent post-charge-off recovery events for uncollectable loan balances. Captures write-off date, written-off principal, accrued interest and fees, write-off approval authority, regulatory classification at write-off, and for each recovery event: recovery date, amount, source (borrower payment, collateral liquidation, guarantor call, debt sale), recovery channel, cumulative recovery to date, net loss after recovery, and GL posting references. Supports CECL reserve release accounting, LGD (Loss Given Default) model calibration, and regulatory net charge-off reporting to OCC/FDIC.

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to loan.loan_ecl_provision. Business justification: When a loan is written off, the associated ECL provision is released. Linking write_off to the specific loan_ecl_provision_id being released enables accurate IFRS 9/CECL accounting entries, provision

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to collateral.pledge. Business justification: Write-offs track which collateral pledge was exhausted or liquidated. Collections teams need pledge reference for recovery pursuit strategy, collateral liquidation proceeds allocation, and LGD calcula

attributes.name: approval_authority
attributes.description: The governance body or individual who approved the write-off: credit committee, chief credit officer, board of directors, or delegated authority per credit policy.
attributes.references: Internal Credit Policy, OCC Comptroller's Handbook

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which the write-off was formally approved by the designated authority.

attributes.name: call_report_schedule
attributes.description: The specific Call Report schedule and line item where this write-off is reported (e.g., Schedule RI-B Part II, Line 6a).

attributes.name: charge_off_reason_code
attributes.description: The primary reason for the charge-off: bankruptcy filing, borrower deceased, fraud, deemed uncollectable, statute of limitations expired, or other.

attributes.name: charge_off_reason_description
attributes.description: Free-text narrative providing additional context and details about the reason for the charge-off.

attributes.name: collateral_liquidation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether collateral was liquidated prior to or as part of the write-off process (True) or not (False).
attributes.references: Internal Credit Policy, Basel III LGD Framework

attributes.name: collateral_liquidation_proceeds
attributes.description: The net proceeds received from liquidation of collateral prior to write-off, applied to reduce the write-off amount.
attributes.references: Basel III LGD Framework, FASB ASC 310-10

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this write-off record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: cumulative_recovery_to_date
attributes.description: The total amount recovered from all sources (borrower payments, collateral liquidation, guarantor calls, debt sales) since the write-off date, updated with each recovery event.

attributes.name: days_past_due_at_write_off
attributes.description: The number of days the loan was past due at the time of write-off, used for delinquency analysis and LGD modeling.

attributes.name: debt_sale_date
attributes.description: The date on which the charged-off debt was sold to a third-party debt buyer, if applicable.

attributes.name: debt_sale_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the charged-off debt was sold to a third-party debt buyer (True) or retained for internal collection (False).

attributes.name: debt_sale_proceeds
attributes.description: The amount received from the sale of the charged-off debt to a third-party buyer, recorded as a recovery.

attributes.name: ead_at_default
attributes.description: The total exposure at the time of default, used as the denominator in LGD calculation. Typically equals the total outstanding balance at default.

attributes.name: ecl_reserve_released_amount
attributes.business_glossary_term: Expected Credit Loss (ECL) Reserve Released Amount
attributes.description: The amount of ECL (Expected Credit Loss) or ALLL (Allowance for Loan and Lease Losses) reserve released upon write-off, reducing the reserve balance.

attributes.name: fees_written_off_amount
attributes.description: The unpaid fees (late fees, penalty fees, servicing fees) that were charged off at the time of write-off.

attributes.name: gl_posting_date
attributes.description: The date the write-off transaction was posted to the general ledger, which may differ from the write-off date due to batch processing.

attributes.name: guarantor_call_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a guarantor was called upon for payment prior to or as part of the write-off process (True) or not (False).

attributes.name: guarantor_recovery_amount
attributes.description: The amount recovered from guarantor(s) prior to write-off, applied to reduce the write-off amount.
attributes.references: Internal Credit Policy, Basel III LGD Framework

attributes.name: interest_written_off_amount
attributes.description: The accrued but unpaid interest that was charged off at the time of write-off.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this write-off record was last updated, capturing any changes to recovery amounts, status, or other fields.

attributes.name: lgd_rate
attributes.description: The calculated Loss Given Default rate for this write-off: net loss after recovery divided by exposure at default (EAD). Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.4500 for 45%).

attributes.name: net_charge_off_amount
attributes.description: The net loss recognized after applying reserve release: total write-off amount minus ECL reserve released. This is the P&L impact of the charge-off.

attributes.name: net_loss_after_recovery
attributes.description: The net loss remaining after all recoveries: total write-off amount minus cumulative recovery to date. Used for final LGD calculation.

attributes.name: npl_classification_date
attributes.description: The date the loan was first classified as non-performing (NPL), typically 90+ days past due, prior to write-off.

attributes.name: principal_written_off_amount
attributes.description: The outstanding principal balance of the loan that was charged off at the time of write-off.

attributes.name: recovery_pursuit_status
attributes.description: Current status of post-charge-off recovery efforts: active pursuit, suspended, closed with no recovery, closed with partial recovery, or closed with full recovery.

attributes.name: regulatory_classification_at_write_off
attributes.description: The regulatory asset classification of the loan at the time of write-off per OCC/FDIC guidelines: substandard, doubtful, or loss.

attributes.name: regulatory_reporting_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this write-off must be included in regulatory net charge-off reporting to OCC, FDIC, or Federal Reserve (True) or is excluded (False).

attributes.name: total_write_off_amount
attributes.description: The total amount written off, including principal, interest, and fees. Sum of all written-off components.

attributes.name: write_off_date
attributes.description: The date on which the loan balance was formally written off and removed from performing assets.

attributes.name: write_off_number
attributes.description: Externally visible business identifier for the write-off transaction, used for audit trails and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: write_off_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the write-off record: pending approval, approved by credit committee, posted to general ledger, reversed due to error or recovery, or closed after final settlement.

attributes.name: write_off_type
attributes.description: Classification of the write-off event: full charge-off (entire balance), partial charge-off (portion of balance), technical write-off (accounting treatment without legal discharge), or regulatory write-off (mandated by regulator).

products.name: credit_review

Supports ongoing portfolio credit quality management.
products.reference: Finastra Fusion Loan IQ — Annual Credit Review

'collateral_coverage_ratio' and 'collateral_reva

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to risk.counterparty_rating. Business justification: Credit reviews explicitly produce updated counterparty ratings. The review should reference the resulting rating record; updated_internal_rating/pd/lgd are denormalized outputs that should be stored i

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to asset.fund. Business justification: Fund finance credit reviews: periodic credit reviews of fund finance facilities require direct fund reference to assess NAV coverage ratio, fund performance, mandate compliance, and investor concentra

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.industry_code. Business justification: Credit reviews assess industry-specific risk and sector outlook as a core component of the review. industry_outlook is a plain-text denormalization of industry_code; linking to industry_code enables s

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to security.issuer. Business justification: Credit reviews of corporate borrowers who are public bond issuers reference the security.issuer profile for public market intelligence, rating agency assessments, and capital markets standing. Relatio

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.kyc_review. Business justification: Annual credit reviews are coordinated with KYC refresh cycles. Banks require that the KYC review is current before completing a credit review. This link supports the annual review process, regulatory

attributes.description: Identifier of the loan facility being reviewed. Links this credit review to the specific loan or credit facility under assessment.

attributes.name: managed_portfolio_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to wealth.managed_portfolio. Business justification: Annual credit reviews for lombard and securities-backed loans require direct assessment of the pledged managed portfolio's current value, composition, and risk profile. The credit_review must referenc

attributes.name: party_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the borrower whose credit is being reviewed. References the customer or corporate entity that holds the loan facility.

attributes.name: security_credit_rating_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to security.credit_rating. Business justification: Annual credit reviews incorporate external instrument/issuer ratings from security.credit_rating for SICR assessment under IFRS 9 and Basel IRB validation. credit_review has counterparty_rating_id→ris

attributes.name: stress_test_run_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to risk.stress_test_run. Business justification: Annual credit reviews for corporate borrowers under ICAAP/SREP explicitly incorporate stress test results to assess borrower resilience. Credit officers reference the latest stress test run when deter

attributes.name: trust_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to wealth.trust_account. Business justification: Credit reviews for trust borrowers require assessment of the trust account's assets, distribution obligations, and fiduciary constraints. Linking credit_review to trust_account enables annual review r

attributes.name: collateral_revaluation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether collateral supporting the facility was revalued as part of this credit review. True if revaluation was performed; false if existing valuations were deemed current.
attributes.references: Collateral Management Policy, Basel III - Credit Risk Mitigation

attributes.name: covenant_compliance_summary
attributes.description: Summary assessment of the borrower's compliance with financial and non-financial covenants. Compliant indicates all covenants met; minor_breach indicates technical violations with no material impact; material_breach indicates significant covenant violations; waived indicates breaches that have been formally waived by the lender; not_applicable indicates no covenants in place.
attributes.references: Loan Agreement - Covenant Schedule, Credit Risk Management Policy

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this credit review record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail and data lineage tracking.
attributes.references: Data Governance Standard, Audit Trail Requirements

attributes.name: credit_committee_date
attributes.description: The date on which the credit committee formally reviewed and approved the credit review findings. Represents the official sign-off timestamp for governance and audit purposes.
attributes.references: Credit Committee Charter, Credit Approval Workflow Standard

attributes.name: credit_committee_decision
attributes.description: Final decision rendered by the credit committee on the review findings and recommended action. Approved indicates acceptance of recommendations; approved_with_conditions indicates acceptance subject to specific requirements; rejected indicates committee disagreement; deferred indicates decision postponed; referred indicates escalation to higher authority.
attributes.references: Credit Committee Charter, Credit Approval Authority Matrix

attributes.name: ecl_amount
attributes.description: The Expected Credit Loss (ECL) provision amount calculated for this facility based on the updated PD, LGD, and EAD estimates from this credit review. Represents the present value of expected credit losses over the relevant time horizon.
attributes.references: IFRS 9 - Expected Credit Loss (ECL), CECL - Current Expected Credit Losses

attributes.name: financial_performance_assessment
attributes.description: Qualitative assessment of the borrower's financial performance since the last review. Considers revenue trends, profitability, cash flow generation, leverage ratios, and liquidity position.

attributes.name: next_review_due_date
attributes.description: The scheduled date for the next periodic credit review. Typically set based on risk rating, with higher-risk credits requiring more frequent review.
attributes.references: Credit Risk Management Policy, Annual Credit Review Schedule

attributes.name: npl_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the loan is classified as non-performing based on this credit review. True if the loan is 90+ days past due or otherwise impaired; false if performing.
attributes.references: Basel III - Definition of Default, IFRS 9 - Impairment

attributes.name: previous_internal_rating
attributes.description: The internal risk rating assigned to the borrower prior to this credit review. Used to track rating migration and credit quality trends.
attributes.references: Basel III - Internal Ratings-Based (IRB) Approach, Internal Credit Rating Scale

attributes.name: previous_lgd
attributes.description: The Loss Given Default (LGD) estimate assigned to the facility prior to this review, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.45 for 45%). LGD represents the expected loss severity in the event of default, net of collateral recovery.
attributes.references: Basel III - Internal Ratings-Based (IRB) Approach, IFRS 9 - Expected Credit Loss (ECL)

attributes.name: previous_pd
attributes.description: The Probability of Default (PD) estimate assigned to the borrower prior to this review, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.025 for 2.5%). PD represents the likelihood of default over a one-year horizon under the IRB approach.
attributes.references: Basel III - Internal Ratings-Based (IRB) Approach, IFRS 9 - Expected Credit Loss (ECL)

attributes.name: recommended_action
attributes.description: Credit analyst's recommended action based on review findings. Maintain indicates no change to risk rating or exposure; upgrade indicates improved credit quality; downgrade indicates deterioration; watchlist indicates heightened monitoring required; exit indicates recommendation to reduce or terminate exposure; restructure indicates need for amended terms.
attributes.references: Credit Risk Management Policy, Credit Committee Charter

attributes.name: regulatory_classification
attributes.description: Regulatory classification of the loan asset based on credit quality, aligned with supervisory standards. Pass indicates performing asset; special_mention indicates potential weakness; substandard indicates well-defined weakness; doubtful indicates collection in full is questionable; loss indicates uncollectible.
attributes.references: Office of the Comptroller of the Currency (OCC) - Loan Classification Standards, Federal Reserve System (Fed) - Supervisory Guidance

attributes.name: review_comments
attributes.description: Free-text field capturing key observations, concerns, mitigating factors, and qualitative insights from the credit review. Provides narrative context to support the quantitative assessment and rating decision.

attributes.name: review_date
attributes.description: The date on which the credit review was formally conducted and documented. This is the principal business event timestamp for the review lifecycle.

attributes.name: review_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the credit review. Draft indicates work in progress; submitted means forwarded to credit committee; under_review indicates active assessment; approved means credit committee sign-off received; rejected means review findings require remediation; deferred means decision postponed pending additional information.

attributes.name: review_type
attributes.description: Classification of the credit review based on its trigger and purpose. Annual reviews are scheduled periodic assessments; interim reviews occur mid-cycle; triggered reviews are event-driven (covenant breach, rating downgrade); special reviews are ad-hoc deep dives; renewal reviews support facility extension decisions; watchlist reviews monitor deteriorating credits.
attributes.references: Basel III - Internal Ratings-Based (IRB) Approach, Credit Risk Management Framework

attributes.name: rwa_amount
attributes.description: The Risk-Weighted Assets (RWA) amount calculated for this facility based on the updated risk parameters from this credit review. Used for regulatory capital adequacy calculations under Basel III.
attributes.references: Basel III - Risk-Weighted Assets (RWA) Calculation, Internal Ratings-Based (IRB) Approach

attributes.name: stage_classification
attributes.description: IFRS 9 impairment stage classification assigned as a result of this credit review. Stage 1 indicates no significant increase in credit risk (12-month ECL); Stage 2 indicates significant increase in credit risk (lifetime ECL); Stage 3 indicates credit-impaired (lifetime ECL with interest revenue on net carrying amount).
attributes.references: IFRS 9 - Financial Instruments, Expected Credit Loss (ECL) Methodology

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this credit review record was last modified. Supports audit trail and change tracking for regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: Data Governance Standard, Audit Trail Requirements

products.name: lc
products.description: Master record for Letters of Credit (Documentary Credits) issued, advised, or confirmed by the bank under ICC Uniform Customs and Practice rules (UCP 600, eUCP). Captures LC type (sight, usance, deferred payment, acceptance, standby, transferable, revolving, back-to-back, red/green clause), applicant and beneficiary references, issuing and confirming bank identifiers (BIC/SWIFT), LC amount and currency (ISO 4217), expiry date and place of expiry, tolerance percentage, partial shipment and transhipment permissions, applicable Incoterm, ports of loading and discharge, latest shipment date, presentation period (default 21 days per UCP 600 Art. 14c), special conditions, reimbursement instructions, and current lifecycle status (draft, issued, advised, confirmed, amended, partially utilized, fully utilized, expired, cancelled). Serves as the central reference entity for all LC-related amendments, drawings, document examinations, and settlements.
products.reference: Letter of Credit — UCP 600 (ICC), SWIFT MT700/MT710

attributes.name: lc_id

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.sanctions_screening_event. Each LC transaction triggers screening events f

attributes.name: advising_bank_bic
attributes.description: SWIFT BIC code of the bank that advises the Letter of Credit to the beneficiary without adding its own undertaking.

attributes.name: amendment_count
attributes.description: Total number of amendments issued to modify the terms and conditions of the Letter of Credit since original issuance.

attributes.name: aml_screening_status
attributes.description: Result of sanctions and anti-money laundering screening for the applicant, beneficiary, and transaction. Cleared: no issues. Flagged: potential match requiring review. Under Review: investigation in progress.
attributes.references: Bank Secrecy Act (BSA), OFAC, FATF Recommendations

attributes.name: amount
attributes.description: Maximum monetary value available under the Letter of Credit. This is the credit limit that can be drawn by the beneficiary upon complying presentation.

attributes.name: applicable_rules
attributes.description: ICC rules governing this Letter of Credit. UCP 600: Uniform Customs and Practice for Documentary Credits. eUCP: electronic presentation supplement. ISP98: International Standby Practices. URDG 758: Uniform Rules for Demand Guarantees.

attributes.name: available_amount
attributes.description: Current remaining credit amount available for drawing under the Letter of Credit after accounting for any utilizations, amendments, or expirations.

attributes.name: confirming_bank_bic
attributes.description: SWIFT BIC code of the bank that adds its confirmation to the Letter of Credit, thereby undertaking to honor complying presentations in addition to the issuing bank.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this Letter of Credit record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which the Letter of Credit expires and after which no presentations will be honored. Must specify both date and place of expiry per UCP 600.

attributes.name: expiry_place
attributes.description: Geographic location (city and country) where the Letter of Credit expires and documents must be presented. Typically the counters of the nominated bank or issuing bank.

attributes.name: goods_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the merchandise or services covered by the Letter of Credit. Must match the description in commercial invoices and other documents.

attributes.name: hs_code
attributes.description: International standardized system of names and numbers for classifying traded products, used for customs and tariff purposes.

attributes.name: incoterm

attributes.name: issue_date
attributes.description: Date on which the Letter of Credit was issued by the issuing bank. This is the effective start date of the LC undertaking.

attributes.name: issuing_bank_bic
attributes.description: SWIFT BIC code of the bank that issued the Letter of Credit. 8 or 11 character ISO 9362 identifier.

attributes.name: last_amendment_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent amendment to the Letter of Credit terms.

attributes.name: latest_shipment_date
attributes.description: Last date by which shipment of goods must occur as stipulated in the Letter of Credit terms. Critical for compliance with transport document requirements.

attributes.name: lc_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique reference number assigned to the Letter of Credit by the issuing bank. This is the business identifier used in SWIFT messages and trade documentation.

attributes.name: lc_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the Letter of Credit. Draft: being prepared. Issued: sent to advising bank. Advised: communicated to beneficiary. Confirmed: confirmed by another bank. Amended: modified after issuance. Utilized: drawings made. Expired: validity period ended. Cancelled: terminated before expiry. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|issued|advised|confirmed|amended|utilized|expired|cancelled — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: lc_type
attributes.description: Classification of the Letter of Credit based on payment terms and transferability. Sight: payable on presentation. Usance: payable at a future date. Deferred Payment: payment deferred without draft. Acceptance: draft accepted for future payment. Standby: guarantee instrument. Transferable: can be transferred to secondary beneficiary.

attributes.name: partial_shipment_allowed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the beneficiary is permitted to ship goods in multiple installments. True if partial shipments are allowed, False if prohibited.

attributes.name: port_of_discharge
attributes.description: Name and country of the port or place where goods are unloaded from the vessel or transport mode at the destination.

attributes.name: port_of_loading
attributes.description: Name and country of the port or place where goods are loaded onto the vessel or transport mode for shipment to the destination.

attributes.name: presentation_period_days
attributes.description: Number of days after shipment date within which documents must be presented to the nominated bank. Defaults to 21 days per UCP 600 Article 14(c) if not specified.

attributes.name: quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of goods specified in the Letter of Credit, expressed in the unit of measure appropriate for the commodity.

attributes.name: regulatory_reporting_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this Letter of Credit transaction must be reported to regulatory authorities for trade finance monitoring, capital adequacy, or sanctions compliance purposes.

attributes.name: reimbursement_bank_bic
attributes.description: SWIFT BIC code of the bank authorized to reimburse the nominated or confirming bank upon receipt of complying documents.

attributes.name: reimbursement_instructions
attributes.description: Detailed instructions specifying how the nominated or confirming bank should claim reimbursement from the issuing or reimbursing bank, including account details and SWIFT message requirements.

attributes.name: revolving_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is a revolving Letter of Credit that automatically reinstates its value after each drawing, allowing multiple shipments under a single LC.

attributes.name: revolving_frequency
attributes.description: For revolving LCs, the period at which the credit amount reinstates. Applicable only when revolving_flag is True.

attributes.name: special_conditions
attributes.description: Additional terms, conditions, or documentary requirements specific to this Letter of Credit beyond standard UCP 600 provisions. May include inspection certificates, insurance requirements, or specific document clauses.

attributes.name: subtype
attributes.description: Additional classification for specialized LC structures. Revolving: automatically renews. Back-to-back: issued against another LC. Red/Green clause: allows advance payment to beneficiary.

attributes.name: tolerance_percentage
attributes.description: Permitted variance (plus or minus) in the LC amount and quantity, typically 10% unless otherwise specified. Allows for minor discrepancies in commercial invoices.

attributes.name: transferable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the beneficiary has the right to transfer all or part of the Letter of Credit to one or more second beneficiaries. Must be explicitly stated as transferable.

attributes.name: transhipment_allowed
attributes.description: Indicates whether goods may be transferred from one vessel to another during transit. True if transhipment is permitted, False if prohibited.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Standard unit in which the quantity is expressed (e.g., metric tons, pieces, liters, barrels, containers).

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this Letter of Credit record was last modified, including amendments, status changes, or utilization updates.

attributes.name: utilized_amount
attributes.description: Cumulative amount that has been drawn or claimed against the Letter of Credit through complying presentations and payments.

products.name: lc_drawing
products.description: Unified transactional record capturing all lifecycle activity against a Letter of Credit, including amendments and drawings/presentations. For amendments: records amendment sequence number, amendment type (amount increase/decrease, expiry extension, condition change, document requirement modification), amended field name and prior/new values, amendment request date, issuing bank approval date, beneficiary acceptance status (accepted/rejected/pending per UCP 600 Art. 10), and amendment compliance flag. For drawings: captures drawing sequence number, presentation date, drawing amount and currency, document set reference, discrepancy flags and descriptions (per ISBP 745 standards), waiver status, honour/negotiation decision, payment due date, and settlement status. Discriminated by transaction_type (amendment/drawing). Tracks partial and full drawings against the LC available balance and maintains full amendment audit trail. Serves as the single source of truth for all LC transactional activity in compliance with UCP 600 and ICC regulatory requirements.

attributes.name: channel_id

attributes.name: correspondent_bank_id

products.name: bank_guarantee
products.description: Master record for Bank Guarantees and Standby Letters of Credit issued or received, with integrated claim lifecycle management. Captures guarantee type (bid bond, performance bond, advance payment guarantee, retention money guarantee, financial guarantee, standby LC, counter-guarantee), applicant and beneficiary references, issuing and counter-guaranteeing bank details (BIC/SWIFT), guarantee amount and currency, effective and expiry dates, claim period, governing law, auto-extension clause, reduction schedule, demand indicator (on-demand vs conditional), and current status (draft, issued, extended, reduced, claimed, expired, cancelled). For claims against the guarantee: records claim sequence number, claim receipt date, claimed amount, claimant identity, claim documents received, URDG 758 Article 20 compliance assessment result, payment decision (honour/reject with extend-or-pay handling), rejection reason and notification timeline, payment date, and residual guarantee balance post-claim. Serves as the single source of truth for the full guarantee and claim lifecycle from issuance through expiry or claim settlement, governed by URDG 758 and ISP98.

Captures document type (bill of lading, commercial invoice, packing list, certificate of origin, insurance certificate, inspection certificate, bill of exchange, draft), document reference number, issuer, issue date, document status (received, examined, compliant, discrepant, waived, rejected), discrepancy codes, and storage reference. Supports UCP 600 Article 14 document examination and eUCP electronic document workflows.
products.reference: Trade Document — UCP 600 Art. 14, eUCP v2.0, ISBP 745

attributes.name: trade_document_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the trade finance document record. Primary key.

attributes.name: currency_id

attributes.name: documentary_collection_id
attributes.description: Reference to the documentary collection transaction associated with this document. Links to collections under URC 522.

attributes.name: fraud_case_id

attributes.name: guarantee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the bank guarantee associated with this document. Links to guarantee transactions requiring documentary support.

attributes.name: lc_drawing_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to loan.lc_drawing. Business justification: Trade documents are presented as part of an LC drawing (presentation of bill of lading, invoice, certificate of origin, etc.). trade_document already has lc_id for the master LC, but lc_drawing_id is

attributes.name: lc_id
attributes.description: Reference to the letter of credit associated with this document. Links to the LC transaction for which this document is presented.

attributes.name: sanctions_screening_event_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.sanctions_screening_event. Business justification: Trade documents (bills of lading, invoices, certificates of origin) are screened for sanctions compliance — dual-use goods, sanctioned ports, sanctioned counterparties. OFAC and BIS require document-l

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, observations, or instructions related to the document examination, handling, or disposition.

attributes.name: compliant_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the document is compliant with the terms and conditions of the LC or guarantee. True if no discrepancies exist, false if discrepancies are present.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the trade document record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: discrepancy_code
attributes.description: Standardized code identifying the type of discrepancy found during document examination. Used for categorization and reporting of non-compliant presentations.

attributes.name: discrepancy_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of any discrepancies identified during document examination. Must clearly state the nature of non-compliance with LC terms or UCP 600 requirements.

attributes.name: document_amount
attributes.description: Monetary amount stated on the document. Applicable to commercial invoices, drafts, bills of exchange, and insurance certificates. Must not exceed LC amount.

attributes.name: document_format
attributes.description: Format in which the document is presented. Identifies whether physical paper or specific electronic format under eUCP. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: paper|pdf|xml|edi|bolero|essdocs|other_electronic — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: document_hash
attributes.description: Cryptographic hash of the document content for integrity verification. Used to detect tampering or alteration of electronic documents.

attributes.name: document_reference_number
attributes.description: Unique external reference number assigned to the trade document by the issuer or presenting party. Used for tracking and reconciliation across parties.

attributes.name: document_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the document in the examination and acceptance workflow. Tracks progression from receipt through compliance review to final disposition. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: received|under_examination|compliant|discrepant|waived|rejected|accepted|returned — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Classification of the trade finance document. Identifies the nature and purpose of the document within the trade transaction. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: bill_of_lading|commercial_invoice|packing_list|certificate_of_origin|insurance_certificate|inspection_certificate|bill_of_exchange|draft|beneficiary_certificate|weight_certificate|quality_certificate|phytosanitary_certificate|customs_declaration|airway_bill|warehouse_receipt — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: electronic_document_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the document is presented in electronic form under eUCP rules. True for electronic presentation, false for paper documents.

attributes.name: examination_date
attributes.description: Date on which the document examination was completed by the bank. Must occur within five banking days of presentation per UCP 600 Article 14(b).

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Expiration or validity date of the document if applicable. Relevant for certificates, insurance policies, and time-sensitive documents.

attributes.name: issue_date
attributes.description: Date on which the trade document was issued by the originating party. Critical for determining compliance with LC presentation deadlines and shipment date requirements.

attributes.name: issuer_identifier
attributes.description: Unique identifier or registration number of the issuing party. May include business registration number, carrier code, or agency license number.

attributes.name: issuer_name
attributes.description: Name of the party or institution that issued the trade document. May be a carrier, inspection agency, chamber of commerce, insurance company, or beneficiary.

attributes.name: number_of_originals
attributes.description: Count of original documents presented when multiple originals are issued. Common for bills of lading issued in sets of three originals.

attributes.name: original_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the document is an original as required by LC terms. True if original, false if copy. Critical for documents like bills of lading where originals are required.

attributes.name: page_count
attributes.description: Total number of pages in the document. Used for completeness verification and audit trail purposes.

attributes.name: presentation_date
attributes.description: Date on which the complete set of documents was presented to the nominated or issuing bank. Used to verify compliance with LC expiry and presentation deadlines.

attributes.name: received_date
attributes.description: Date on which the document was received by the examining bank or presenting party. Marks the start of the examination period under UCP 600 Article 14.

attributes.name: regulatory_reporting_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this document is subject to regulatory reporting requirements such as trade finance exposure reporting or sanctions screening.

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Detailed explanation for rejection of the document or refusal of the presentation. Must cite specific LC terms or UCP 600 articles that are not satisfied.

attributes.name: shipment_date
attributes.description: Date of shipment as evidenced by the transport document. Critical for compliance with latest shipment date specified in the LC.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the operational system from which the trade document record originated. Supports data lineage and reconciliation across trade finance platforms.

attributes.name: storage_location
attributes.description: Physical or electronic storage location reference for the document. May be vault location, document management system path, or cloud storage URI.

attributes.name: storage_reference_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier or key used to retrieve the document from the storage system. Links to document management or imaging system.

attributes.name: swift_message_reference
attributes.business_glossary_term: SWIFT (Society for Worldwide Interbank Financial Telecommunication) Message Reference
attributes.description: Reference number of the SWIFT message (MT700, MT710, MT720, MT734, MT754) associated with the document presentation or discrepancy notification.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the trade document record. Tracks modifications throughout the document lifecycle.

attributes.name: waiver_date
attributes.description: Date on which the applicant granted waiver of discrepancies and authorized the bank to proceed with payment or acceptance.

attributes.name: waiver_granted_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the applicant has waived identified discrepancies and authorized payment despite non-compliance. True if waiver obtained, false otherwise.

products.name: guarantee
products.description: Master record for loan guarantees provided by third parties (personal guarantees, corporate guarantees, government guarantees). Captures guarantor, guarantee type, coverage amount, expiry date, and enforceability status.

attributes.name: guarantee_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the loan guarantee record. Primary key for the guarantee entity.

attributes.name: counterparty_agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to trade.counterparty_agreement. Linking guarantee to counterparty_agreement enables cr

attributes.name: facility_id

attributes.name: gl_account_id

attributes.name: guarantor_kyc_review_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.kyc_review. Business justification: Guarantors must have current KYC reviews before a guarantee is accepted as credit risk mitigation. Role-prefixed 'guarantor_' because guarantee has two party roles (guarantee_party_id and guarantee_gu

attributes.name: guarantor_sanctions_screening_event_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Guarantor Sanctions Screening Event Id (Foreign Key)
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.sanctions_screening_event. Business justification: Guarantors must be screened against OFAC/sanctions lists before a guarantee is accepted. Role-prefixed 'guarantor_' to distinguish from the primary obligor screening. This is a mandatory BSA complianc

attributes.name: jurisdiction_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.jurisdiction. Business justification: Guarantee enforceability depends on governing law jurisdiction — enforceability_opinion_date and enforceability_status require jurisdiction context for legal opinion validity and Basel III credit risk

attributes.name: loan_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the loan account that this guarantee secures. Links the guarantee to the underlying credit exposure.

attributes.name: managed_portfolio_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to wealth.managed_portfolio. Business justification: Blocked investment accounts and cash collateral portfolios serve as guarantee instruments for credit facilities. Guarantee enforceability assessment requires portfolio valuation, collateral coverage r

attributes.name: parent_guarantee_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on guarantee (parent_guarantee_id)

attributes.name: trust_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to wealth.trust_account. Business justification: Trust accounts frequently provide guarantees for related-party borrowings (e.g., trustee guaranteeing a beneficiary's loan). The guarantee must reference the trust account for enforceability assessmen

attributes.name: underlying_security_instrument_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to security.instrument. Business justification: Guarantees collateralized by securities (e.g., standby LCs backed by bond portfolios, cash-collateralized guarantees held in money market funds) require instrument tracking for collateral adequacy mon

attributes.name: amendment_count
attributes.description: Number of amendments made to the original guarantee agreement. Tracks the modification history and may affect enforceability assessment.

attributes.name: call_amount
attributes.description: Monetary amount demanded from the guarantor upon calling the guarantee. May be less than the full coverage amount depending on the outstanding loan balance and guarantee terms.

attributes.name: call_date
attributes.description: Date on which the bank formally demanded payment from the guarantor due to borrower default. Triggers the guarantor's obligation to perform.
attributes.references: Basel III Capital Framework, UCC Article 3

attributes.name: capital_relief_amount
attributes.description: Reduction in Risk-Weighted Assets (RWA) achieved through the guarantee. Calculated based on the difference between the borrower's and guarantor's risk weights.
attributes.references: Basel III Capital Framework, CRR Article 214

attributes.name: coverage_amount
attributes.description: Maximum monetary amount that the guarantor is obligated to pay under the guarantee. Used to calculate Loss Given Default (LGD) and regulatory capital relief.

attributes.name: coverage_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of the loan exposure covered by the guarantee. Used to calculate partial credit risk mitigation for regulatory capital and Expected Credit Loss (ECL) purposes.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the guarantee record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage purposes.

attributes.name: cross_default_clause_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the guarantee includes a cross-default provision that triggers the guarantee if the borrower defaults on other obligations. Strengthens credit risk mitigation.
attributes.references: Basel III Capital Framework, ISDA Master Agreement

attributes.name: data_classification
attributes.description: Sensitivity classification of the guarantee record. Determines access controls, encryption requirements, and data handling procedures.

attributes.name: documentation_type
attributes.description: Legal form of the guarantee documentation. Determines the legal framework, enforceability standards, and regulatory capital treatment.
attributes.references: Basel III Capital Framework, UCC Article 3

attributes.name: ecl_adjustment_amount
attributes.description: Reduction in Expected Credit Loss provision due to the guarantee. Calculated based on the guarantor's creditworthiness and coverage amount under IFRS 9 or CECL.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which the guarantee becomes legally binding and enforceable. Determines when credit risk mitigation can be recognized for regulatory capital purposes.

attributes.name: enforceability_opinion_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent legal opinion confirming the enforceability of the guarantee. Basel III requires periodic legal review of credit risk mitigation instruments.
attributes.references: Basel III Capital Framework, CRR Article 213

attributes.name: enforceability_status
attributes.description: Legal assessment of whether the guarantee can be enforced in the relevant jurisdiction. Only enforceable guarantees qualify for regulatory capital relief under Basel III.
attributes.references: Basel III Capital Framework, CRR Article 213

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which the guarantee obligation terminates. After this date, the guarantee no longer provides credit risk mitigation unless renewed or extended.

attributes.name: guarantee_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the guarantee. Determines whether the guarantee provides credit risk mitigation for regulatory capital purposes.

attributes.name: guarantee_type
attributes.description: Legal structure of the guarantee obligation. Defines the extent and conditions of the guarantor's liability.
attributes.references: Basel III Capital Framework, UCC Article 3

attributes.name: guarantor_type
attributes.description: Classification of the guarantor entity. Determines credit risk treatment, regulatory capital calculation, and enforceability considerations. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: personal|corporate|government|bank|insurance_company|parent_company|third_party — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: issue_date
attributes.description: Date on which the guarantee document was executed and issued. May differ from effective date if the guarantee has a future start date.

attributes.name: last_amendment_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent amendment to the guarantee terms. Triggers the need for updated legal enforceability review.

attributes.name: legal_documentation_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the physical or electronic location of the executed guarantee document. Required for audit, regulatory examination, and enforceability verification.
attributes.references: Basel III Capital Framework, SOX Section 404

attributes.name: payment_received_amount
attributes.description: Actual monetary amount received from the guarantor. Used to calculate recovery rates and reduce net credit losses.

attributes.name: payment_received_date
attributes.description: Date on which payment was received from the guarantor after the guarantee was called. Used to calculate recovery rates and actual Loss Given Default (LGD).

attributes.name: reference_number
attributes.description: External business identifier for the guarantee. Used in legal documentation, correspondence, and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: regulatory_capital_relief_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the guarantee meets Basel III criteria for regulatory capital relief. Requires enforceability, guarantor creditworthiness, and proper documentation.
attributes.references: Basel III Capital Framework, CRR Article 213

attributes.name: rwa_after_guarantee
attributes.description: Risk-Weighted Assets of the loan exposure after applying the guarantee credit risk mitigation. Reflects the substitution of the guarantor's risk weight.

attributes.name: rwa_before_guarantee
attributes.description: Risk-Weighted Assets of the loan exposure before applying the guarantee credit risk mitigation. Used to calculate the capital relief benefit.

attributes.name: substitution_allowed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the guarantee terms permit the guarantor to be replaced with another party. Affects the permanence of credit risk mitigation.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the guarantee record was last modified. Used for audit trail, change tracking, and data quality monitoring.

attributes.name: destination_account_name

attributes.name: disbursement_method

attributes.name: disbursement_status

attributes.name: exchange_rate

attributes.name: exchange_rate_date

attributes.name: fee_amount
attributes.description: Total fees charged for processing this disbursement (e.g., wire transfer fees, processing fees).

attributes.name: fee_currency

attributes.name: gl_account_code

attributes.name: gl_posting_date

attributes.name: net_disbursement_amount
attributes.description: Net amount received by the borrower after deducting fees and charges from the gross disbursement amount.

attributes.name: partial_disbursement_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this disbursement represents a partial release of the total approved loan amount.

attributes.name: purpose
attributes.description: Business purpose or intended use of the disbursed funds as declared by the borrower (e.g., working capital, equipment purchase, refinancing).

attributes.name: reference_number

attributes.name: regulatory_reporting_category
attributes.description: Classification of the disbursement for regulatory reporting purposes (e.g., CTR, SAR, FATCA, CRS).

attributes.name: regulatory_reporting_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this disbursement must be included in regulatory reports (e.g., large cash transactions, cross-border transfers).

attributes.name: reversal_date
attributes.description: Date when the disbursement reversal was processed.

attributes.name: reversal_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this disbursement has been reversed due to error, fraud, or other reasons.

attributes.name: reversal_reason
attributes.description: Explanation for why the disbursement was reversed. Populated only if reversal_flag is true.

attributes.name: sequence_number
attributes.description: Sequential number indicating the order of this disbursement within a multi-tranche or construction loan facility.

attributes.name: settlement_date

attributes.name: swift_message_reference

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when the disbursement record was last modified.

attributes.name: value_date
attributes.description: Effective date when funds become available to the borrower for interest calculation and accounting purposes.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: The date on which this pricing structure ceases to be effective. Null for open-ended pricing arrangements.

attributes.name: floor_rate

attributes.name: margin_rate
attributes.description: Additional margin or adjustment rate applied on top of the base rate and spread, often used for risk-based pricing adjustments. Expressed as a decimal.

attributes.name: model_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the pricing model or methodology used to determine the rate structure (e.g., cost-plus, risk-based, relationship, competitive).

attributes.name: pricing_status

attributes.name: pricing_tier

attributes.name: rate_type

attributes.name: reference_number

attributes.name: regulatory_reporting_flag

attributes.name: relationship_discount_bps
attributes.description: Discount in basis points granted based on the overall banking relationship value. Null if no relationship discount applies.

attributes.name: security_instrument_id

attributes.name: assigned_queue
attributes.description: Name of the exception handling queue to which this event was routed for manual resolution (e.g., Sanctions Review Queue, Format Validation Queue, High Value Queue). Null for non-exception events or auto-resolved exceptions.

attributes.name: audit_trail_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier linking this event to the broader audit trail or compliance log. Used for regulatory audit and forensic investigation.

attributes.name: correspondent_bank_bic
attributes.description: SWIFT BIC (Bank Identifier Code) of the correspondent or intermediary bank involved in routing this payment. Null for domestic payments not requiring correspondent banking. Format: 8 or 11 alphanumeric characters.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this event record was created and persisted in the payment hub database. Distinct from event_timestamp which represents the business event time. Used for technical audit and data lineage.

attributes.name: event_source_module
attributes.description: Specific module or component within the payment hub that generated this event (e.g., Payment Validation Engine, Routing Engine, Settlement Engine, Exception Handler, Sanctions Filter). More granular than originating_system.

attributes.name: event_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when this status transition or exception event occurred in the payment processing lifecycle. Recorded in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset.

attributes.name: event_type
attributes.description: Classification of the event: STATUS_CHANGE (normal lifecycle transition), EXCEPTION (business rule violation or data issue), STP_FAILURE (Straight-Through Processing failure requiring manual intervention), MANUAL_INTERVENTION (operator action), RETRY (automated retry attempt), RESOLUTION (exception resolved).
attributes.references: ACI Worldwide Payment Hub Event Taxonomy

attributes.name: exception_severity
attributes.description: Severity level of the exception for prioritization and SLA management. CRITICAL (regulatory or high-value payment), HIGH (material impact), MEDIUM (standard exception), LOW (informational). Null for non-exception events.

attributes.name: exception_type
attributes.description: Classification of the exception when event_type is EXCEPTION or STP_FAILURE. FORMAT_ERROR (message format or field validation failure), SANCTIONS_HIT (AML/sanctions screening match), DUPLICATE_DETECTION (duplicate payment detected), ROUTING_FAILURE (unable to determine payment route), INSUFFICIENT_FUNDS (payer account balance insufficient), BENEFICIARY_VALIDATION_FAILURE (beneficiary account validation failed). Null for non-exception events.
attributes.references: ACI Worldwide Exception Management Framework, FATCA, AML

attributes.name: max_retry_limit
attributes.description: Maximum number of automated retries allowed for this payment type before manual intervention is required. Configured per payment channel and exception type.

attributes.name: new_status_code

attributes.name: originating_system
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the system component that generated this event (e.g., ACI Payment Engine, Volante Routing Module, SWIFT Gateway, Exception Management Module, Sanctions Screening Engine).

attributes.name: payment_amount
attributes.description: The monetary value of the payment transaction associated with this event. Recorded in the payment currency.

attributes.name: payment_channel
attributes.description: The payment rail or channel through which the payment is being processed: ACH (Automated Clearing House), WIRE (wire transfer), RTGS (Real-Time Gross Settlement), SWIFT (Society for Worldwide Interbank Financial Telecommunication), SEPA (Single Euro Payments Area), FASTER_PAYMENTS (UK Faster Payments), CARD (card payment network), INTERNAL_TRANSFER (intra-bank transfer). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: ACH|WIRE|RTGS|SWIFT|SEPA|FASTER_PAYMENTS|CARD|INTERNAL_TRANSFER — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: payment_direction
attributes.description: Direction of the payment flow relative to the bank: OUTBOUND (payment sent from bank to external party), INBOUND (payment received from external party).

attributes.name: prior_status_code
attributes.description: The payment status immediately before this event. Uses ISO 20022 external payment status codes: INIT (Initiated), PNDG (Pending), ACCP (Accepted Customer Profile), ACSC (Accepted Settlement Completed), ACSP (Accepted Settlement In Process), ACTC (Accepted Technical Validation), ACWC (Accepted With Change), RJCT (Rejected), CANC (Cancelled), PDNG (Pending), PART (Partially Accepted), ACCC (Accepted Settlement Completed Creditor Account). attributes.name: reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code explaining why the status transition or exception occurred. Aligns with ISO 20022 reason codes for payment status (e.g., AC01 for incorrect account number, AM05 for duplication, NARR for narrative reason).

attributes.name: reason_description
attributes.description: Human-readable narrative explaining the reason for the status change or exception. Provides additional context beyond the standardized reason code.

attributes.name: resolution_action
attributes.description: Action taken to resolve the exception: APPROVED (exception cleared, payment proceeds), REJECTED (payment rejected), CORRECTED (data corrected and resubmitted), ESCALATED (escalated to higher authority), CANCELLED (payment cancelled), RESUBMITTED (resubmitted for processing). Null for unresolved exceptions or non-exception events.

attributes.name: resolution_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the exception was resolved. Null for unresolved exceptions or non-exception events. Used to calculate exception handling duration and SLA compliance.

attributes.name: retry_count
attributes.description: Number of automated retry attempts made for this payment after an STP failure. Zero for first-time processing. Used to track retry logic and prevent infinite loops.

attributes.name: sanctions_screening_result
attributes.description: Result of AML and sanctions screening for this payment event: CLEAR (no match found), HIT (potential match requiring review), PENDING_REVIEW (screening in progress). Critical for regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: settlement_date
attributes.description: The date on which the payment is scheduled to settle or has settled. Follows T+1 or same-day settlement cycles depending on payment channel.

attributes.name: sla_actual_minutes
attributes.description: The actual time in minutes taken to resolve this event, calculated from event_timestamp to resolution_timestamp. Null for unresolved events. Used for SLA compliance analysis.

attributes.name: sla_breach_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this event resulted in a breach of the defined SLA for payment processing or exception resolution. True if SLA was breached, False otherwise. Used for SLA compliance monitoring and reporting.

attributes.name: sla_target_minutes
attributes.description: The target resolution time in minutes defined by the SLA for this event type and severity. Used to calculate SLA breach status.

attributes.name: transaction_reference
attributes.description: End-to-end transaction reference provided by the payment originator. Used for reconciliation and customer inquiry. Also known as UETR (Unique End-to-End Transaction Reference) in SWIFT context.

products.name: return

Covers ACH returns (R01–R85), SWIFT returns (MT192/MT196), and RTGS reversals. SSOT for return and reversal lifecycle.

attributes.name: addenda_information
attributes.description: Additional free-form information or notes provided with the return, such as detailed explanation of the return reason or instructions for resubmission.

attributes.name: amount
attributes.description: Monetary amount being returned to the originator. Typically matches the original payment amount but may differ in partial return scenarios.

attributes.name: beneficiary_account_number
attributes.description: Account number of the intended beneficiary from which the funds are being returned.

attributes.name: clearing_house_name
attributes.description: Name of the clearing house or payment network through which the return was processed (e.g., Federal Reserve ACH, The Clearing House, SWIFT, local RTGS system).

attributes.name: clearing_house_reference
attributes.description: Unique reference number assigned by the clearing house to this return transaction for tracking and reconciliation purposes.

attributes.name: contested_return_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the return has been contested or disputed by the originating bank.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this payment return record was first created in the payment processing system.

attributes.name: dishonored_return_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is a dishonored return (return of a return), which occurs when the originating bank contests the return.

attributes.name: fee_amount
attributes.description: Fee charged by the receiving bank or clearing house for processing the return transaction.
attributes.references: NACHA Operating Rules, Federal Reserve Fee Schedules

attributes.name: fee_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the return fee amount.

attributes.name: fraud_indicator_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the return is associated with suspected fraudulent activity or unauthorized transactions.

attributes.name: notification_date
attributes.description: Date on which notification of the return was sent to the originator.

attributes.name: notification_sent_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether notification of the return has been sent to the payment originator or relevant parties.

attributes.name: original_payment_date
attributes.description: Business date of the original payment transaction that is being returned.

attributes.name: original_payment_reference
attributes.description: Business reference number or transaction identifier of the original payment being returned.

attributes.name: originator_account_number
attributes.description: Account number of the payment originator to which the returned funds will be credited.

attributes.name: reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the reason for the payment return. For ACH: R01-R85 codes (e.g., R01=Insufficient Funds, R02=Account Closed, R03=No Account/Unable to Locate). For SWIFT: return reason codes per MT192/MT196 standards. For RTGS: system-specific reversal codes.
attributes.references: NACHA Operating Rules (ACH Return Reason Codes R01-R85), SWIFT MT192/MT196 Standards, Federal Reserve RTGS Guidelines

attributes.name: reason_description
attributes.description: Human-readable description of the return reason providing additional context beyond the standardized code.

attributes.name: reconciliation_status
attributes.description: Status of nostro/vostro account reconciliation for this return transaction.

attributes.name: reference_number
attributes.description: Unique business reference number assigned to this return transaction by the payment processing system or clearing house.

attributes.name: regulatory_reporting_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this return requires regulatory reporting (e.g., for suspicious activity, fraud patterns, or compliance monitoring).

attributes.name: resubmission_count
attributes.description: Number of times this payment has been resubmitted after previous returns. NACHA rules limit resubmissions to two attempts for certain return codes.

attributes.name: resubmission_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the returned payment is eligible for resubmission based on the return reason code. Certain return codes (e.g., R01 NSF) allow resubmission while others (e.g., R02 Account Closed) do not.

attributes.name: return_date
attributes.description: Business date on which the return was initiated or processed by the receiving bank or clearing house.
attributes.references: NACHA Operating Rules, Federal Reserve Guidelines

attributes.name: return_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the return transaction indicating its processing state.

attributes.name: return_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the return transaction was created or received in the payment processing system.

attributes.name: return_type
attributes.description: Classification of the return transaction based on the payment rail or system through which it was processed.
attributes.references: NACHA Operating Rules, SWIFT Standards, Federal Reserve Guidelines

attributes.name: settlement_date
attributes.description: Date on which the return amount is settled and funds are credited back to the originator's account. Follows T+1 or same-day settlement cycles depending on payment rail.
attributes.references: Federal Reserve Settlement Guidelines, NACHA Operating Rules

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the source payment processing system or platform from which this return record originated (e.g., ACI Worldwide, Volante, internal payment hub).

attributes.name: swift_message_type
attributes.description: SWIFT message type code for returns processed through SWIFT network (e.g., MT192 for request for cancellation, MT196 for answers to requests). Null for non-SWIFT returns.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this payment return record was last modified or updated.

attributes.name: window_days
attributes.description: Number of days from the original payment date within which the return was initiated. Different return reason codes have different allowable return windows (e.g., 2 banking days for R01, 60 days for unauthorized debits).

products.name: clearing_record

Bridges payment instructions through clearing to final funds movement. SSOT for the complete clearing-to-settlement lifecycle including CLS for FX settlement.
