attributes.name: business_day_convention
attributes.description: The convention used for adjusting payment dates that fall on non-business days. Following moves to next business day; modified_following moves to next unless it crosses month-end; preceding moves to prior business day.
attributes.references: International Swaps and Derivatives Association (ISDA) Definitions

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: The city where the institution or branch is located. Used for correspondent banking and payment routing.

attributes.name: connectivity_status
attributes.description: The current operational status of the BIC code in the SWIFT network. Live indicates active production use; test indicates sandbox environment; inactive indicates decommissioned; suspended indicates temporarily disabled.

attributes.name: correspondent_banking_role
attributes.description: The role this institution plays in correspondent banking relationships. Nostro indicates the institution holds accounts at other banks; vostro indicates other banks hold accounts here; both indicates bidirectional relationships; none indicates no correspondent banking.
attributes.references: Basel Committee on Banking Supervision - Correspondent Banking Guidelines

attributes.name: cut_off_time_local
attributes.description: The local time (HH:MM format) by which payment instructions must be received for same-day value. Used by payment processing hubs for scheduling.
attributes.references: SWIFT Payment Market Practice Group Guidelines

attributes.name: data_quality_score
attributes.description: A calculated score (0.00 to 100.00) representing the completeness and accuracy of this BIC record. Based on presence of optional fields, validation against SWIFT directory, and recency of updates.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date from which this BIC code became active in the SWIFT directory. Used for historical payment routing validation.

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: The date on which this BIC code was or will be deactivated. Null for currently active BIC codes. Used for payment routing validation and historical analysis.

attributes.name: iban_supported
attributes.description: Indicates whether the institution supports IBAN format for account identification. Mandatory in SEPA countries; optional elsewhere.

attributes.name: institution_name
attributes.description: The legal name of the financial institution associated with this BIC code. Used for correspondent banking identification and payment processing.

attributes.name: institution_type
attributes.description: The classification of the institution holding this BIC code. Determines the types of SWIFT services and message types available.

attributes.name: is_active
attributes.description: Indicates whether this BIC code is currently active and should be used for payment routing. Derived from connectivity_status and expiry_date. False indicates the BIC should not be used for new transactions.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this BIC directory record was last modified. Used for change data capture and synchronization with upstream SWIFT directory feeds.

attributes.name: national_identifier_code
attributes.description: The national registration or license number assigned by the domestic banking regulator. Format varies by jurisdiction (e.g., FDIC Certificate Number in USA, Financial Conduct Authority (FCA) number in UK).

attributes.name: payment_services_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether this BIC is enabled for payment processing services including wire transfers, Automated Clearing House (ACH), and Real-Time Gross Settlement (RTGS).

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.description: The postal or ZIP code for the institution address. Organizational contact data classified as confidential.

attributes.name: regulatory_status
attributes.description: The regulatory standing of the institution for cross-border transactions. Sanctioned indicates Office of Foreign Assets Control (OFAC) or other sanctions apply; restricted indicates regulatory limitations; under_review indicates pending regulatory action.
attributes.references: OFAC Sanctions List, Financial Action Task Force (FATF) Guidelines

attributes.name: routing_number
attributes.description: The domestic routing or sort code used for local payment clearing. Examples include American Bankers Association (ABA) routing number (USA), sort code (UK), Bankleitzahl (Germany). Null for institutions without domestic clearing participation.

attributes.name: securities_services_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether this BIC is enabled for securities settlement, custody, and clearing services. Relevant for broker-dealers and custodian banks.

attributes.name: sepa_participant
attributes.description: Indicates whether the institution is a participant in the Single Euro Payments Area for euro-denominated payments. Applicable to European Economic Area (EEA) institutions.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The name of the system or feed that provided this BIC record. Typically SWIFT BIC Directory feed, but may include manual entries or third-party data providers.

attributes.name: state_province
attributes.description: The state, province, or administrative region where the institution is located. Applicable for countries with sub-national divisions.

attributes.name: swift_service_profile
attributes.business_glossary_term: Society for Worldwide Interbank Financial Telecommunication (SWIFT) Service Profile
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of SWIFT service types supported by this BIC. Examples include FIN (financial messaging), FileAct (file transfer), InterAct (real-time messaging), and Browse (information retrieval).

attributes.name: time_zone
attributes.description: The IANA time zone identifier for the institution location. Used for cut-off time calculations and same-day value dating in payment processing.

attributes.name: trade_finance_services_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether this BIC is enabled for trade finance services including letters of credit, guarantees, and documentary collections.

products.name: lei_registry
products.description: Legal Entity Identifier (LEI) registry — authoritative source for LEI codes assigned to legal entities under the GLEIF framework. Captures LEI code, legal entity name, legal address, headquarters country, registration authority, LEI status, renewal date, and ultimate parent LEI. Required for MiFID II, EMIR, and Dodd-Frank regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: lei_registry_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the LEI registry record. Primary key for the LEI registry data product.

attributes.name: jurisdiction_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.jurisdiction. Business justification: LEI entities are registered in specific legal jurisdictions. The jurisdiction_code STRING column should be replaced with a proper FK to jurisdiction.jurisdiction_id. This enables JOIN to retrieve juri

attributes.name: legal_address_country_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.country. Business justification: LEI entities have legal addresses in specific countries. The legal_address_country_code STRING column should be replaced with a proper FK to country.country_id. This is the first of two FKs from lei_r

attributes.name: bic_code
attributes.description: The ISO 9362 Business Identifier Code (BIC), also known as SWIFT code, assigned to the entity if it is a financial institution participating in the SWIFT network. Used for international payment routing and messaging.

attributes.name: data_source
attributes.description: The source system or data provider from which this LEI registry record was obtained or synchronized (e.g., GLEIF API, LOU direct feed, regulatory reporting platform).

attributes.name: entity_category
attributes.description: The category classification of the entity as defined by GLEIF, indicating the type of legal entity (e.g., BRANCH for branch offices, FUND for investment funds, GENERAL for standard legal entities). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: BRANCH|FUND|SOLE_PROPRIETOR|RESIDENT_GOVERNMENT_ENTITY|NON_RESIDENT_GOVERNMENT_ENTITY|INTERNATIONAL_ORGANIZATION|GENERAL — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: entity_expiration_date
attributes.description: The date on which the legal entity is scheduled to expire, dissolve, or terminate, if applicable. This is relevant for entities with a defined lifespan such as special purpose vehicles, project companies, or entities in liquidation.

attributes.name: entity_expiration_reason
attributes.description: The reason for the entitys expiration or termination, if applicable. Indicates the business or legal event that led to the entitys cessation.

attributes.name: entity_registration_number
attributes.description: The unique registration number or identifier assigned to the entity by the registration authority in its jurisdiction of incorporation or registration.

attributes.name: entity_status
attributes.description: The operational status of the legal entity as reported by the registration authority. ACTIVE indicates the entity is currently operating; INACTIVE indicates the entity has ceased operations, been dissolved, or is otherwise non-operational.

attributes.name: headquarters_address_city
attributes.description: The city or municipality component of the headquarters address.

attributes.name: headquarters_address_country_code
attributes.description: The ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 two-letter country code representing the country of the headquarters address.

attributes.name: headquarters_address_line_1
attributes.description: The first line of the headquarters address where the entity conducts its primary business operations, which may differ from the legal address.

attributes.name: headquarters_address_line_2
attributes.description: The second line of the headquarters address, containing additional address details.

attributes.name: headquarters_address_postal_code
attributes.description: The postal code or ZIP code component of the headquarters address.

attributes.name: headquarters_address_region
attributes.description: The region, state, province, or administrative subdivision component of the headquarters address.

attributes.name: initial_registration_date
attributes.description: The date when the LEI was first issued to the entity by a Local Operating Unit (LOU). This represents the original registration date in the GLEIF system.

attributes.name: last_update_date
attributes.description: The date when the LEI record was last updated in the GLEIF system, reflecting changes to entity information, status, or other attributes.

attributes.name: legal_address_city
attributes.description: The city or municipality component of the legal address.

attributes.name: legal_address_line_1
attributes.description: The first line of the legal address of the entity as registered with the relevant registration authority. This is the official address for legal and regulatory purposes.

attributes.name: legal_address_line_2
attributes.description: The second line of the legal address, typically containing additional address details such as suite, floor, or building information.

attributes.name: legal_address_postal_code
attributes.description: The postal code or ZIP code component of the legal address.

attributes.name: legal_address_region
attributes.description: The region, state, province, or administrative subdivision component of the legal address.

attributes.name: legal_entity_name
attributes.description: The official legal name of the entity as registered with the relevant registration authority. This is the primary legal name under which the entity operates and is recognized in legal and regulatory contexts.

attributes.name: legal_entity_name_local
attributes.description: The legal name of the entity in the local language and script of the jurisdiction of registration, if different from the transliterated or English version.

attributes.name: legal_form_code
attributes.description: The code representing the legal form of the entity (e.g., corporation, partnership, trust) as defined by the Entity Legal Forms (ELF) code list maintained by GLEIF.
attributes.references: GLEIF Entity Legal Forms (ELF) Code List

attributes.name: legal_form_name
attributes.description: The descriptive name of the legal form corresponding to the legal form code (e.g., Public Limited Company, Limited Liability Company).
attributes.references: GLEIF Entity Legal Forms (ELF) Code List

attributes.name: lei_code
attributes.description: The 20-character alphanumeric ISO 17442 Legal Entity Identifier code assigned to the legal entity by a Local Operating Unit (LOU) under the Global Legal Entity Identifier Foundation (GLEIF) framework. Required for MiFID II, EMIR, and Dodd-Frank regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 17442, GLEIF, MiFID II, EMIR, Dodd-Frank

attributes.name: lei_status
attributes.description: The current status of the LEI code itself within the GLEIF system. ISSUED indicates an active LEI; LAPSED indicates the LEI has not been renewed; MERGED, RETIRED, ANNULLED, CANCELLED indicate various termination states; TRANSFERRED and PENDING_TRANSFER indicate LEI management changes between LOUs. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: ISSUED|LAPSED|MERGED|RETIRED|ANNULLED|CANCELLED|TRANSFERRED|PENDING_TRANSFER|PENDING_ARCHIVAL — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: managing_lou_code
attributes.description: The code identifying the Local Operating Unit (LOU) that currently manages and maintains the LEI record. LOUs are accredited organizations authorized by GLEIF to issue and manage LEIs.

attributes.name: managing_lou_name
attributes.description: The name of the Local Operating Unit (LOU) that currently manages the LEI record (e.g., London Stock Exchange, Bloomberg Finance L.P., DTCC).

attributes.name: next_renewal_date
attributes.description: The date by which the LEI must be renewed to maintain its ISSUED status. LEIs must be renewed annually; failure to renew results in a LAPSED status.

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this LEI registry record was first created in the enterprise data lakehouse. Represents the initial load or ingestion time.

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this LEI registry record was last updated in the enterprise data lakehouse. Reflects the most recent synchronization or modification.

attributes.name: registration_authority_code
attributes.description: The identifier of the registration authority (business registry) where the entity is officially registered. This is typically a code from the Registration Authorities Code List (RAL) maintained by GLEIF.

attributes.name: registration_authority_name
attributes.description: The name of the registration authority or business registry where the entity is officially registered (e.g., Companies House UK, Delaware Division of Corporations).

attributes.name: relationship_last_update_date
attributes.description: The date when the parent-child relationship information (direct parent and ultimate parent LEIs) was last updated or validated in the GLEIF system.

attributes.name: relationship_status
attributes.description: The status of the parent-child relationship data reported to GLEIF. ACTIVE indicates current, valid relationship information; INACTIVE indicates the relationship data is no longer current or has been superseded.

attributes.name: successor_lei
attributes.description: The LEI code of the successor entity, if this entity has been merged, acquired, or otherwise succeeded by another legal entity. Used to maintain continuity in regulatory reporting and relationship tracking.

attributes.name: ultimate_parent_lei
attributes.description: The LEI code of the ultimate parent entity at the top of the corporate ownership hierarchy. This represents the highest-level parent entity that is not itself owned or controlled by another entity, as reported under GLEIF Level 2 relationship data. Required for consolidated regulatory reporting and risk assessment.

attributes.name: validation_source
attributes.description: The level of validation and corroboration applied to the relationship data. FULLY_CORROBORATED indicates both parent and child have confirmed the relationship; PARTIALLY_CORROBORATED indicates one party has confirmed; ENTITY_SUPPLIED_ONLY indicates self-reported data without external validation; PENDING indicates validation is in progress.

products.name: product_type
products.description: Enterprise-wide banking product type taxonomy — authoritative classification of all financial products offered by the bank (term loans, revolving credit, demand deposits, time deposits, interest rate swaps, FX forwards, letters of credit, guarantees, etc.). Captures product type code, product family, asset class, sub-product type, regulatory product category (Basel, IFRS 9), line of business ownership, booking model, and applicable fee schedule type. Used for regulatory reporting bucketing, risk aggregation, product catalog management, and cross-domain product identification.
products.reference: ISDA Product Taxonomy / EBA Product Classification

attributes.name: product_type_id
attributes.description: Primary key for product_type

attributes.name: currency_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.currency. Business justification: Banking product types have default currencies. The currency_code STRING column should be replaced with a proper FK to currency.currency_id. This enables JOIN to retrieve currency_name, iso_code, and o

attributes.name: aml_monitoring_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether transactions for this product type require anti-money laundering transaction monitoring, suspicious activity report (SAR) screening, and currency transaction report (CTR) filing.
attributes.references: Bank Secrecy Act (BSA) / USA PATRIOT Act / FinCEN Regulations

attributes.name: asset_class
attributes.description: Financial asset class to which this product type belongs (loan, deposit, equity, fixed income, derivative, foreign exchange, commodity, other). Used for risk aggregation and capital allocation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: loan|deposit|equity|fixed_income|derivative|fx|commodity|other — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: benchmark_rate_type
attributes.description: The interest rate benchmark or reference rate typically used for pricing this product type (e.g., SOFR, LIBOR legacy, Prime Rate, Fed Funds Rate, Treasury Yield). Applicable for interest-bearing products.
attributes.references: ARRC SOFR Transition / ISDA Fallback Protocol

attributes.name: booking_model
attributes.description: Accounting treatment and valuation methodology applied to this product type (accrual, fair value, amortized cost, held for trading, available for sale). Determines how the product is measured and reported in the general ledger.

attributes.name: ccar_dfast_category
attributes.business_glossary_term: Comprehensive Capital Analysis and Review (CCAR) / Dodd-Frank Act Stress Testing (DFAST) Category
attributes.description: Product classification used in CCAR and DFAST stress testing scenarios for capital planning and regulatory submissions to the Federal Reserve.

attributes.name: cecl_portfolio_segment
attributes.business_glossary_term: Current Expected Credit Losses (CECL) Portfolio Segment
attributes.description: Portfolio segment assignment for CECL expected credit loss calculation and allowance for credit losses (ACL) estimation under FASB ASC 326.

attributes.name: collateral_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this product type typically requires collateral or security (true for secured lending products, false for unsecured products).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this product type reference record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: credit_risk_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this product type carries credit risk exposure requiring probability of default (PD), loss given default (LGD), and exposure at default (EAD) calculations for capital adequacy purposes.

attributes.name: crs_reportable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether accounts or transactions under this product type are subject to Common Reporting Standard (CRS) reporting for automatic exchange of financial account information between jurisdictions.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: The date on which this product type was discontinued or retired from the product catalog. Null for currently active products. Used for temporal validity and product lifecycle management.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: The date from which this product type became available for booking and customer origination. Used for temporal validity and historical product analysis.

attributes.name: fatca_reportable_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Foreign Account Tax Compliance Act (FATCA) Reportable Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether accounts or transactions under this product type are subject to FATCA reporting requirements for U.S. tax compliance.

attributes.name: fee_schedule_type
attributes.description: Reference to the applicable fee schedule or pricing model for this product type (e.g., Standard Commercial Lending Fees, Wealth Management Advisory Fees, Transaction Banking Fees). Used to link product types to fee structures.
attributes.references: Internal Pricing and Fee Management Policy

attributes.name: gl_account_mapping
attributes.description: Reference to the general ledger account code(s) or chart of accounts segment used for booking transactions of this product type. Enables financial reporting and reconciliation.
attributes.references: Internal Chart of Accounts / GAAP / IFRS

attributes.name: interest_bearing_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this product type accrues or pays interest (true for interest-bearing products like loans and deposits, false for non-interest products like guarantees and advisory services).

attributes.name: kyc_requirement_level
attributes.description: The level of customer due diligence and KYC documentation required for this product type (standard, enhanced for high-risk products, simplified for low-risk, or not required for non-customer-facing products).

attributes.name: liquidity_risk_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this product type contributes to liquidity risk metrics such as Liquidity Coverage Ratio (LCR) and Net Stable Funding Ratio (NSFR).
attributes.references: Basel III Liquidity Coverage Ratio (LCR) / Net Stable Funding Ratio (NSFR)

attributes.name: lob_ownership
attributes.description: The primary line of business or business unit responsible for managing, marketing, and servicing this product type (e.g., Commercial Banking, Investment Banking, Wealth Management, Treasury).

attributes.name: market_risk_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this product type is subject to market risk (interest rate, foreign exchange, equity, commodity price movements) requiring Value at Risk (VaR) and stress testing.
attributes.references: Basel III Market Risk Framework / FRTB

attributes.name: maximum_amount
attributes.description: The maximum transaction or account balance amount allowed for this product type, expressed in the bank's base currency. Used for product eligibility, risk limits, and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: minimum_amount
attributes.description: The minimum transaction or account balance amount required for this product type, expressed in the bank's base currency. Used for product eligibility and origination controls.

attributes.name: multi_currency_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this product type supports multiple currencies (true for multi-currency accounts and foreign exchange products, false for single-currency products).

attributes.name: operational_risk_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this product type is subject to operational risk capital requirements under the Standardized Measurement Approach (SMA) or Advanced Measurement Approach (AMA).

attributes.name: product_family
attributes.description: High-level grouping of product types into major business lines (lending, deposit, investment, trading, advisory, payment, guarantee, custody, other). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: lending|deposit|investment|trading|advisory|payment|guarantee|custody|other — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: product_lifecycle_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the product type in the bank's product catalog (active for current offerings, inactive for temporarily unavailable, discontinued for retired products, pending approval for new products under review, sunset for products being phased out).

attributes.name: product_type_code
attributes.description: Short alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the product type across all bank systems. Used as the business key for product classification in regulatory reporting and internal systems.

attributes.name: product_type_description
attributes.description: Detailed business description of the product type, including key features, typical use cases, target customer segments, and distinguishing characteristics.

attributes.name: product_type_name
attributes.description: Full business name of the product type as recognized by business users and customers (e.g., Term Loan, Revolving Credit Facility, Demand Deposit Account, Interest Rate Swap).

attributes.name: regulatory_product_category_basel
attributes.description: Product classification according to Basel III regulatory framework for capital adequacy and risk-weighted asset (RWA) calculation (e.g., Corporate Exposure, Retail Exposure, Sovereign Exposure).

attributes.name: regulatory_product_category_ifrs9
attributes.business_glossary_term: Regulatory Product Category - International Financial Reporting Standard 9 (IFRS 9)
attributes.description: Product classification according to IFRS 9 accounting standard for financial instruments, determining measurement basis (amortized cost, fair value through other comprehensive income, fair value through profit or loss) and expected credit loss (ECL) calculation approach.

attributes.name: regulatory_reporting_category
attributes.description: Standardized category code used for regulatory reporting submissions to Federal Reserve, OCC, FDIC, SEC, or other governing bodies (e.g., Call Report schedule codes, FR Y-9C line items).
attributes.references: Federal Reserve FR Y-9C / FFIEC Call Report

attributes.name: rwa_approach
attributes.description: The Basel III approach used to calculate risk-weighted assets for this product type (standardized approach, foundation internal ratings-based, advanced internal ratings-based, or not applicable for non-credit products).

attributes.name: sla_service_level
attributes.description: The service level commitment associated with this product type, defining response times, processing speeds, and support availability (standard, priority, premium, or not applicable for non-service products).

attributes.name: sub_product_type
attributes.description: Granular sub-classification within the product type (e.g., for Term Loan: Senior Secured, Subordinated; for Deposit: Savings, Checking, Money Market).

attributes.name: tax_reporting_category
attributes.description: Tax classification for this product type used for IRS Form 1099 reporting, withholding tax calculations, and tax compliance (e.g., interest income, dividend income, capital gains).

attributes.name: typical_term_months
attributes.description: The standard or most common term length in months for this product type (e.g., 60 months for a 5-year term loan, 12 months for a 1-year certificate of deposit). Null for demand or perpetual products.

attributes.name: updated_by_user
attributes.description: The user ID or system identifier of the person or process that last updated this product type record. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this product type reference record was last modified. Used for audit trail, change tracking, and data quality monitoring.

products.name: jurisdiction
products.description: Legal and regulatory jurisdiction master covering national, sub-national (state/province), and supranational (EU, Basel Committee) jurisdictions relevant to banking operations. Captures jurisdiction code, jurisdiction name, jurisdiction level (national, state, supranational), governing law system (common law, civil law, Sharia), applicable regulatory frameworks (Basel III/IV, MiFID II, Dodd-Frank, MAS), close-out netting enforceability flag, insolvency regime type, data privacy regime (GDPR, CCPA), and withholding tax treaty status. Used by compliance, legal, collateral (netting opinions), tax, and cross-border transaction processing.
products.reference: ISDA Netting Opinion / FATF / FSB Jurisdiction List

attributes.name: jurisdiction_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the jurisdiction record. Primary key.

attributes.name: currency_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.currency. Business justification: jurisdiction has currency_code as a STRING attribute representing the primary/official currency of the jurisdiction (e.g., USD for US jurisdiction, EUR for Eurozone). This should be a FK to the curren

attributes.name: holiday_calendar_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.holiday_calendar. Business justification: jurisdiction has holiday_calendar_code as a STRING attribute representing the default business day calendar for the jurisdiction. This should be a FK to the holiday_calendar golden source. Normalizing

attributes.name: parent_jurisdiction_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent jurisdiction for hierarchical relationships (e.g., New York State's parent is United States). Null for top-level jurisdictions.

attributes.name: accounting_standard
attributes.description: Primary accounting standard required for financial reporting in this jurisdiction: International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS), United States Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (US GAAP), local GAAP, or mixed.
attributes.references: International Accounting Standards Board (IASB), Financial Accounting Standards Board (FASB), International Financial Reporting Standard 9 (IFRS 9)

attributes.name: aml_authority
attributes.description: Name of the primary anti-money laundering and financial crime enforcement authority in this jurisdiction (e.g., Financial Crimes Enforcement Network, Financial Intelligence Unit).
attributes.references: Financial Crimes Enforcement Network (FinCEN), Financial Action Task Force (FATF), Bank Secrecy Act (BSA)

attributes.name: basel_implementation_status
attributes.description: Status of Basel III/IV capital and liquidity framework implementation in this jurisdiction. Critical for Risk-Weighted Assets (RWA) and capital adequacy calculations.
attributes.value_regex: basel III compliant|basel IV compliant|partial|non-compliant|not applicable
attributes.references: Basel Committee on Banking Supervision (BCBS), Bank for International Settlements (BIS)

attributes.name: bic_country_code
attributes.description: Two-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code used in Bank Identifier Codes (BIC) and International Bank Account Numbers (IBAN) for this jurisdiction.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1, Society for Worldwide Interbank Financial Telecommunication (SWIFT), Bank Identifier Code (BIC), International Bank Account Number (IBAN)

attributes.name: business_day_convention
attributes.description: Standard business day convention used in this jurisdiction for financial calculations (e.g., following, modified following, preceding). Critical for interest accrual and settlement date calculations.
attributes.references: International Swaps and Derivatives Association (ISDA), International Capital Market Association (ICMA)

attributes.name: capital_adequacy_framework
attributes.description: The approach to capital adequacy calculation permitted or mandated in this jurisdiction: Standardized Approach (SA), Internal Ratings-Based (IRB) Approach, Advanced IRB, or other.
attributes.references: Basel Committee on Banking Supervision (BCBS), Common Equity Tier 1 (CET1)

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this jurisdiction record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: credit_loss_methodology
attributes.description: Required methodology for credit loss provisioning: Current Expected Credit Losses (CECL), IFRS 9 Expected Credit Loss (ECL), incurred loss model, or other.
attributes.references: Current Expected Credit Losses (CECL), International Financial Reporting Standard 9 (IFRS 9), Financial Accounting Standards Board (FASB)

attributes.name: crs_status
attributes.description: Classification of the jurisdiction's participation in the OECD Common Reporting Standard for automatic exchange of financial account information.
attributes.references: Common Reporting Standard (CRS), Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development (OECD)

attributes.name: data_privacy_regime
attributes.description: Primary data protection and privacy regulatory framework applicable in this jurisdiction (e.g., General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA), Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA)).
attributes.references: General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA), Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA)

attributes.name: effective_from_date
attributes.description: Date from which this jurisdiction record is effective and valid for use in banking operations and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: effective_to_date
attributes.description: Date until which this jurisdiction record is effective. Null for currently active jurisdictions with no planned end date.

attributes.name: fatca_status
attributes.business_glossary_term: Foreign Account Tax Compliance Act (FATCA) Status
attributes.description: Classification of the jurisdiction's participation in FATCA: Model 1 Intergovernmental Agreement (IGA), Model 2 IGA, non-IGA compliant, or not applicable.
attributes.references: Foreign Account Tax Compliance Act (FATCA), Internal Revenue Service (IRS)

attributes.name: high_risk_jurisdiction_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this jurisdiction is classified as high-risk for Anti-Money Laundering (AML) or Counter-Terrorist Financing (CTF) purposes by international bodies such as the Financial Action Task Force (FATF).
attributes.references: Financial Action Task Force (FATF), Financial Crimes Enforcement Network (FinCEN), Anti-Money Laundering (AML)

attributes.name: iban_supported_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Bank Account Number (IBAN) Supported Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this jurisdiction uses the International Bank Account Number (IBAN) standard for bank account identification.
attributes.references: International Bank Account Number (IBAN), ISO 13616, Society for Worldwide Interbank Financial Telecommunication (SWIFT)

attributes.name: insolvency_regime_type
attributes.description: Classification of the insolvency and bankruptcy framework in this jurisdiction (e.g., debtor-friendly, creditor-friendly, administrative, judicial). Impacts Loss Given Default (LGD) and recovery rate assumptions.
attributes.references: Basel Committee on Banking Supervision (BCBS), International Financial Reporting Standard 9 (IFRS 9)

attributes.name: jurisdiction_code
attributes.description: Standardized code identifying the jurisdiction. Uses ISO 3166-1 alpha-2/alpha-3 for national jurisdictions, with optional subdivision codes (e.g., US-NY for New York State, EU for European Union).

attributes.name: jurisdiction_level
attributes.description: Hierarchical level of the jurisdiction: national (country-level), sub-national (state/province/region), supranational (multi-country bodies like EU or Basel Committee), or territorial (dependent territories).
attributes.references: Basel Committee on Banking Supervision (BCBS), Financial Stability Board (FSB)

attributes.name: jurisdiction_name
attributes.description: Full legal name of the jurisdiction (e.g., United States of America, State of New York, European Union).
attributes.references: ISO 3166, Basel Committee on Banking Supervision (BCBS)

attributes.name: jurisdiction_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the jurisdiction record: active (currently in use), inactive (no longer used for new transactions), historical (archived), or pending (under review for activation).

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this jurisdiction record was most recently updated.

attributes.name: legal_system_type
attributes.description: The foundational legal system governing the jurisdiction: common law (precedent-based), civil law (code-based), Sharia law (Islamic principles), mixed (combination), customary law, or other.
attributes.references: International Swaps and Derivatives Association (ISDA), Basel Committee on Banking Supervision (BCBS)

attributes.name: netting_enforceability_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether close-out netting provisions in derivative contracts are legally enforceable in this jurisdiction under insolvency or default scenarios. Critical for collateral and credit risk management.
attributes.references: International Swaps and Derivatives Association (ISDA), Basel Committee on Banking Supervision (BCBS)

attributes.name: netting_opinion_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent legal opinion confirming netting enforceability in this jurisdiction. Used to track currency of legal assessments.

attributes.name: primary_regulator
attributes.description: Name of the primary banking regulatory authority in this jurisdiction (e.g., Federal Reserve System, Office of the Comptroller of the Currency, European Central Bank, Prudential Regulation Authority).
attributes.references: Federal Reserve System (Fed), Office of the Comptroller of the Currency (OCC), European Banking Authority (EBA), Prudential Regulation Authority (PRA)

attributes.name: regulatory_framework
attributes.description: Primary banking and financial regulatory frameworks applicable in this jurisdiction (e.g., Basel III, Basel IV, Dodd-Frank Act, MiFID II, MAS Notice 637). Multiple frameworks separated by semicolons.
attributes.references: Basel Committee on Banking Supervision (BCBS), Financial Stability Board (FSB), Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC), European Banking Authority (EBA), Monetary Authority of Singapore (MAS)

attributes.name: rtgs_system_name
attributes.description: Name of the Real-Time Gross Settlement (RTGS) payment system operated in this jurisdiction (e.g., Fedwire, CHAPS, TARGET2). Null if no RTGS system exists.
attributes.references: Real-Time Gross Settlement (RTGS), Society for Worldwide Interbank Financial Telecommunication (SWIFT), Bank for International Settlements (BIS)

attributes.name: sanctions_regime_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this jurisdiction is subject to international economic sanctions or embargoes that restrict banking and financial transactions.
attributes.references: Office of Foreign Assets Control (OFAC), United Nations Security Council, European Union Sanctions

attributes.name: securities_regulator
attributes.description: Name of the primary securities and capital markets regulatory authority in this jurisdiction (e.g., Securities and Exchange Commission, Financial Conduct Authority, European Securities and Markets Authority).
attributes.references: Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC), Financial Industry Regulatory Authority (FINRA), International Organization of Securities Commissions (IOSCO)

attributes.name: short_name
attributes.description: Abbreviated or commonly used name for the jurisdiction (e.g., USA, New York, EU).

attributes.name: sovereign_credit_rating
attributes.description: Most recent sovereign credit rating for this jurisdiction from a major rating agency (e.g., AAA, AA+, BBB-). Used for country risk assessment and Probability of Default (PD) modeling.
attributes.references: Basel Committee on Banking Supervision (BCBS), International Organization of Securities Commissions (IOSCO)

attributes.name: sovereign_rating_agency
attributes.description: Name of the rating agency that issued the sovereign credit rating (e.g., Standard & Poor's, Moody's, Fitch Ratings).

attributes.name: sovereign_rating_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent sovereign credit rating assessment.

attributes.name: stress_testing_requirement
attributes.description: Mandatory stress testing framework applicable in this jurisdiction: Comprehensive Capital Analysis and Review (CCAR), Dodd-Frank Act Stress Testing (DFAST), European Banking Authority (EBA) stress test, local framework, or none.
attributes.references: Comprehensive Capital Analysis and Review (CCAR), Dodd-Frank Act Stress Testing (DFAST), European Banking Authority (EBA), Federal Reserve System (Fed)

attributes.name: tax_haven_classification
attributes.description: Classification of the jurisdiction's tax regime: tax haven (minimal or no taxation), low-tax (preferential tax rates), standard (typical tax rates), or not classified.
attributes.references: Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development (OECD), Financial Stability Board (FSB)

attributes.name: tax_treaty_network_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this jurisdiction participates in international tax treaty networks for withholding tax relief and double taxation avoidance.
attributes.references: Foreign Account Tax Compliance Act (FATCA), Common Reporting Standard (CRS), Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development (OECD)

attributes.name: time_zone
attributes.description: Primary time zone for this jurisdiction in IANA Time Zone Database format (e.g., America/New_York, Europe/London, Asia/Tokyo). Used for trade settlement and market hours.
attributes.references: IANA Time Zone Database, Society for Worldwide Interbank Financial Telecommunication (SWIFT)

domains.name: fraud
domains.description: Operational fraud case management covering fraud detection alerts, investigation workflows, case disposition, chargeback management, loss recovery, and SAR escalation. Manages fraud typologies, rule configurations, and case outcomes for retail, card, and wire fraud. Distinct from compliance AML monitoring.
domains.references: FinCEN SAR, FDIC Fraud Guidance, PCI DSS, AML/BSA

products.name: case
products.description: Core master entity representing an operational fraud case opened against a customer, account, or transaction. Captures the full lifecycle from initial alert escalation through investigation, disposition, and closure. Key attributes include case type (card fraud, wire fraud, identity theft, account takeover, check fraud), case status and status history, assigned investigator, priority/severity, channel of occurrence, estimated and confirmed loss amounts, recovery amount, disposition outcome, and regulatory escalation flags. Serves as the central hub linking alerts, incidents, investigations, chargebacks, claims, SARs, evidence, and loss records. Managed within NICE Actimize or Oracle Financial Crime case management platforms.
products.reference: Fraud Case Management — NICE Actimize / Oracle Financial Crime

products.name: investigation
products.description: Operational entity tracking the investigation workflow associated with a fraud case within the bank's case management platform (NICE Actimize, Oracle Financial Crime). Captures investigation phase (initial review, deep investigation, legal referral, SAR escalation), assigned investigator employee ID, investigation start and end dates, methodology applied (transaction analysis, device forensics, customer interview, surveillance review), evidence items gathered, interview records, findings narrative, recommended disposition (confirmed fraud, no fraud, inconclusive, referred to compliance), and escalation flags. Supports multi-phase investigations where a single case may require sequential investigation stages with different investigators or skill sets. Feeds SAR narrative generation and law enforcement referral packages.

products.name: chargeback
products.description: Master entity managing the full lifecycle of payment card chargebacks initiated in response to disputed or fraudulent transactions. Captures chargeback reason code (per Visa/Mastercard/Amex network rules), dispute amount, original transaction reference, chargeback stage (first chargeback, representment, pre-arbitration, arbitration), network case number, merchant ID, acquirer BIN, response deadlines, and final resolution outcome. Includes the complete audit trail of lifecycle events: network messages, representment filings, arbitration submissions, and resolution events with timestamps and responsible parties. Supports merchant fraud risk assessment including chargeback ratios and network monitoring program enrollment. Linked to fraud cases where chargebacks arise from confirmed fraud.

products.name: loss_recovery
products.description: Transactional entity tracking the complete fraud loss lifecycle from initial loss recognition through recovery activities for confirmed fraud cases. Captures loss event details (loss date, loss category, Basel event type code, gross loss amount, business line, GL account reference) and recovery activities (recovery method — insurance, merchant, network, legal judgment, write-off; recovery amount, recovery date, recovery status). Calculates net loss after recovery. Supports financial reconciliation against the general ledger, regulatory loss reporting under Basel III SMA framework, CCAR/DFAST stress testing loss history, operational risk loss data collection, and internal management reporting on fraud financial impact.

products.name: claim
products.description: Master entity representing a customer-initiated fraud claim or dispute submitted through any channel (branch, contact center, digital banking, written notice). Captures claim receipt date, channel, type (unauthorized transaction, identity theft, account takeover, card fraud), claimed amount, customer attestation status, and final resolution. Distinct from chargeback — a claim is the customer-facing intake record; a chargeback is the network-level dispute.

attributes.description: 20-character alphanumeric code that uniquely identifies the legal entity managing or issuing the fund class. Required for regulatory reporting under MiFID II and EMIR.

attributes.name: management_fee_rate
attributes.description: Annual management fee charged by the fund manager, expressed as a decimal percentage of Assets Under Management (AUM). Accrued daily and deducted from NAV.

attributes.name: minimum_initial_investment
attributes.description: Minimum amount required for an investor to make an initial subscription into the fund class, expressed in the class currency. Used to enforce eligibility and operational thresholds.

attributes.name: minimum_subsequent_investment
attributes.description: Minimum amount required for additional subscriptions after the initial investment. May be lower than the initial minimum to encourage ongoing contributions.

attributes.name: nav_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which the Net Asset Value (NAV) is calculated and published for the fund class. Daily is most common for liquid funds; less frequent for alternative or illiquid strategies.

attributes.name: ongoing_charges_figure
attributes.description: Annual charges taken from the fund class excluding transaction costs and performance fees, expressed as a decimal percentage of AUM. Required disclosure metric under UCITS regulations.

attributes.name: performance_fee_rate
attributes.description: Performance-based fee charged when the fund class exceeds a specified benchmark or hurdle rate, expressed as a decimal percentage of outperformance. Common in hedge funds and alternative investment funds.

attributes.name: prospectus_url
attributes.description: Web address (URL) where the current prospectus or offering document for the fund class can be accessed. Required for investor disclosure and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: sedol
attributes.business_glossary_term: Stock Exchange Daily Official List (SEDOL) Code
attributes.description: 7-character alphanumeric code used to identify the fund class in UK and Irish markets. Required for trading on London Stock Exchange and other European venues.

attributes.name: settlement_period_days
attributes.description: Number of business days between trade date and settlement date for subscriptions and redemptions. Typically T+1 to T+3 for liquid funds, longer for alternative funds.

attributes.name: sfdr_classification
attributes.description: Classification under EU SFDR indicating the fund class sustainability profile. Article 8 funds promote environmental or social characteristics; Article 9 funds have sustainable investment as their objective; Article 6 funds do not integrate sustainability.

attributes.name: tax_reporting_status
attributes.description: Classification of the fund class for tax reporting purposes. Reporting funds provide annual tax information to investors; non-reporting funds may have different tax treatment. Relevant for UK and other jurisdictions.

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: Date on which the fund class was closed or liquidated. Null if the class is still active. Used for lifecycle management and historical reporting.

attributes.name: total_expense_ratio
attributes.description: Aggregate of all annual operating expenses (management fees, administrative costs, custody fees) expressed as a decimal percentage of average Assets Under Management (AUM). Key metric for investor cost comparison.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this fund class record was last modified. Used for change tracking and audit purposes.

products.name: nav_record
products.description: Authoritative Net Asset Value (NAV) calculation record for each fund class at each valuation date. Captures gross asset value, total liabilities, net asset value, NAV per unit/share, number of units outstanding, total subscriptions and redemptions processed, accrued income, accrued expenses, management fee accrual, performance fee accrual, valuation frequency (daily, weekly, monthly), pricing basis (forward/historic), and NAV publication timestamp. Serves as the SSOT for fund pricing used in investor transactions and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: nav_record_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the NAV calculation record. Primary key for the nav_record product.

attributes.name: accounting_period_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to ledger.accounting_period. Business justification: NAV calculations must align with accounting period close for consolidated financial statements and regulatory reporting. Critical for period-end reconciliation between fund accounting and general ledg

attributes.name: currency_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.currency. Business justification: NAV must be expressed in a specific currency for valuation, pricing, and investor reporting. Core requirement for fund accounting and transfer agency operations.

attributes.name: fund_class_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific share class or unit class within the fund for which this NAV applies.

attributes.name: fund_id
attributes.description: Reference to the fund for which this NAV is calculated.

attributes.name: holiday_calendar_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.holiday_calendar. Business justification: NAV calculation occurs only on valid dealing days per fund calendar. Business day validation is critical for pricing accuracy, investor dealing, and regulatory compliance (UCITS dealing frequency rule

attributes.name: party_id
attributes.description: Reference to the fund accountant or transfer agent responsible for calculating and certifying this NAV.

attributes.name: previous_nav_record_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Previous Net Asset Value (NAV) Record Identifier
attributes.description: Reference to the prior NAV record for this fund class, enabling time-series analysis and change tracking. Null for the first NAV record.

attributes.name: yield_curve_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to security.yield_curve. Business justification: Fixed income fund NAV calculation uses a specific yield curve for bond pricing on each valuation date. Fund accountants and auditors require this link to reproduce NAV calculations, satisfy IFRS 13 fa

attributes.name: accrued_expenses
attributes.description: Expenses incurred but not yet paid by the fund, including accrued management fees, performance fees, custody fees, audit fees, and other operating expenses as of the valuation date.

attributes.name: accrued_income
attributes.description: Income earned but not yet received by the fund, including accrued interest, dividends declared but not paid, and other receivable income as of the valuation date.

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this NAV calculation was formally approved by an authorized signatory.

attributes.name: calculation_method
attributes.description: The valuation methodology used for calculating NAV. Amortized cost is used for money market funds; mark-to-market uses current market prices; fair value uses estimated values when market prices unavailable.

attributes.name: distribution_per_unit
attributes.description: The amount of income or capital distribution declared per unit/share on this valuation date, if any. Zero if no distribution declared.

attributes.name: ex_distribution_date
attributes.description: The date on which the fund begins trading without the value of its next distribution payment. Investors purchasing on or after this date are not entitled to the declared distribution.

attributes.name: gross_asset_value
attributes.description: Total market value of all fund assets before deducting liabilities. Represents the sum of all portfolio holdings valued at market prices as of the valuation date.

attributes.name: is_audited
attributes.description: Indicates whether this NAV calculation has been subject to external audit verification. True if audited, false otherwise.
attributes.references: SEC Investment Company Act, SOX Section 404

attributes.name: management_fee_accrual
attributes.description: Accrued management fee owed to the fund manager for the period up to and including the valuation date, calculated based on the management fee rate and fund assets.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 946, SEC Investment Company Act

attributes.name: nav_calculation_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time when the NAV calculation was completed and finalized.

attributes.name: nav_change_amount
attributes.description: The absolute change in NAV per unit compared to the previous valuation date, expressed in currency units.

attributes.name: nav_change_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage change in NAV per unit compared to the previous valuation date. Expressed as a percentage (e.g., 2.5000 represents 2.50%).

attributes.name: nav_per_unit
attributes.description: The NAV divided by the number of units outstanding. This is the price at which investors buy and sell fund units. Also known as NAV per share for share-based funds.

attributes.name: nav_publication_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the NAV was officially published and made available to investors and distribution channels.

attributes.name: nav_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this NAV calculation. Preliminary indicates initial calculation pending review; final indicates approved and published; restated indicates correction of previously published NAV; suspended indicates NAV calculation halted.

attributes.name: net_asset_value
attributes.description: The net value of the fund calculated as gross asset value minus total liabilities. This is the authoritative NAV figure used for all investor transactions and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: performance_fee_accrual
attributes.description: Accrued performance fee or incentive fee owed to the fund manager based on fund performance relative to benchmark or high-water mark as of the valuation date.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 946, SEC Investment Company Act

attributes.name: pricing_basis
attributes.description: The pricing methodology used for investor transactions. Forward pricing uses the next calculated NAV after order receipt; historic pricing uses the most recent NAV; swing pricing adjusts NAV for dilution.
attributes.references: UCITS Directive, SEC Investment Company Act

attributes.name: realized_gain_loss
attributes.description: The realized gain or loss from investment sales and maturities during the period ending on the valuation date.

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this NAV record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this NAV record was last modified in the system.

attributes.name: restatement_reason
attributes.description: Explanation for why this NAV was restated, if applicable. Null for original NAV calculations. Populated when nav_status is restated.
attributes.references: SEC Investment Company Act, FASB ASC 946

attributes.name: total_expense_ratio
attributes.description: The annualized percentage of fund assets used to cover operating expenses, calculated as total expenses divided by average net assets. Expressed as a percentage (e.g., 1.5000 represents 1.50%).

attributes.name: total_liabilities
attributes.description: Sum of all fund liabilities including accrued expenses, payables, borrowings, and other obligations as of the valuation date.

attributes.name: total_redemptions
attributes.description: Total monetary value of investor redemptions (sales) processed and settled on this valuation date.

attributes.name: total_subscriptions
attributes.description: Total monetary value of new investor subscriptions (purchases) processed and settled on this valuation date.

attributes.name: units_outstanding
attributes.description: Total number of fund units or shares currently issued and held by investors as of the valuation date.

attributes.name: unrealized_gain_loss
attributes.description: The cumulative unrealized gain or loss on fund investments as of the valuation date, calculated as the difference between current market value and original cost basis.

attributes.name: valuation_date
attributes.description: The business date for which this NAV calculation was performed. This is the principal business event timestamp for the NAV record.

attributes.name: valuation_frequency
attributes.description: The regular schedule on which NAV is calculated for this fund class (daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly, or annual).

products.name: fund_holding
products.description: Point-in-time portfolio holding record for each security or asset position held within a fund at a specific valuation date. Captures instrument identifier, asset class, quantity held, market price, market value in local and base currency, percentage of NAV, cost basis, unrealized gain/loss, accrued income, country of risk, sector classification, credit rating, duration (for fixed income), and liquidity classification. Drives NAV calculation, regulatory reporting (UCITS, AIFMD), and portfolio analytics.

attributes.name: fund_holding_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the fund holding record. Primary key for the fund holding entity.

attributes.name: accounting_period_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to ledger.accounting_period. Business justification: Fund holdings are snapshotted at period-end for NAV calculation, financial statement disclosure, and regulatory reporting (UCITS, AIFMD). Linking holdings to accounting_period enables period-over-peri

attributes.name: corporate_action_id

attributes.name: counterparty_rating_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to risk.counterparty_rating. Business justification: Fund holdings of debt instruments require counterparty credit ratings for risk monitoring and regulatory reporting (UCITS 5/10/40 rules, AIFMD risk management). Real process: credit risk assessment of

attributes.name: country_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.country. Business justification: Geographic risk exposure reporting for UCITS 5/10/40 rules, concentration limits, and country risk monitoring. Regulatory requirement for diversification compliance and risk management.

attributes.name: debt_issuance_id

attributes.name: derivative_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to security.derivative. Business justification: When holding is derivative, direct link enables margin calculation, counterparty exposure aggregation, regulatory reporting (EMIR, Dodd-Frank), and derivatives usage compliance (UCITS commitment appro

attributes.name: equity_id

attributes.name: exchange_rate_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.exchange_rate. Business justification: FX rates for currency conversion in portfolio valuation. Links to official rates (ECB, Fed) for NAV calculation, audit trail, and fair value hierarchy compliance (IFRS 13).

attributes.name: factor_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to risk.risk_factor. Business justification: Market risk positions in funds are decomposed into risk factors (equity indices, interest rate curves, FX rates) for VaR calculation, stress testing, and FRTB compliance. Real process: market risk fac

attributes.name: fixed_income_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to security.fixed_income. Business justification: When holding is fixed income, direct link enables coupon accrual calculation, credit rating monitoring, duration/convexity analytics, and yield-to-maturity tracking. Essential for bond portfolio manag

attributes.name: fund_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the fund that holds this position. Links to the fund master data.

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to ledger.gl_account. Business justification: Investment holdings map to specific GL accounts (e.g., equity securities, fixed income) for trial balance and financial statement preparation. Essential for subledger-to-GL reconciliation and SOX cont

attributes.name: instrument_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to security.instrument. Business justification: Fund holdings must reference the master security instrument for portfolio valuation, risk analytics, corporate action processing, and regulatory reporting (UCITS diversification, AIFMD transparency).

attributes.name: issuer_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to security.issuer. Business justification: Holdings require issuer reference for concentration risk monitoring (UCITS 5/10/40 rules), credit risk aggregation, sector exposure analysis, and regulatory reporting. Critical for investment complian

attributes.name: issuer_lei_registry_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.lei_registry. Business justification: Issuer LEI for concentration limits (UCITS 5% single issuer rule), counterparty risk aggregation, and regulatory reporting (SFTR, EMIR). Critical for issuer-level risk management.

attributes.name: listing_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to security.listing. Business justification: Holdings track specific exchange listings for liquidity classification (MiFID II liquid/illiquid), trading venue selection, best execution compliance, and swing pricing threshold determination.

attributes.name: market_price_currency_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.currency. Business justification: Holdings priced in local currencies (JPY equity, EUR bond) require FX conversion to fund base currency. Fundamental to portfolio valuation and NAV calculation.

attributes.name: previous_fund_holding_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on fund_holding (previous_fund_holding_id)

attributes.name: price_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to security.price. Business justification: Holdings require specific price record reference for NAV calculation audit trail, pricing source verification, fair value hierarchy compliance (IFRS 13), and pricing challenge resolution.

attributes.name: rate_benchmark_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.rate_benchmark. Business justification: Floating rate fixed income and derivative holdings in a fund are valued using specific benchmark rates (SOFR, EURIBOR). Daily mark-to-market valuation, accrued income calculation, and risk reporting r

attributes.name: sector_industry_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.industry_code. Business justification: Sector exposure reporting (GICS, ICB) for risk analytics, concentration monitoring, and investment mandate compliance. Essential for sector allocation analysis and style drift detection.

attributes.name: security_credit_rating_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to security.credit_rating. Business justification: Holdings require credit rating reference for investment mandate compliance (investment-grade only), UCITS eligibility (rated debt), risk weighting, and credit risk reporting. Essential for fixed incom

attributes.name: yield_curve_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to security.yield_curve. Business justification: Fixed income holdings require yield curve reference for mark-to-market valuation, duration calculation, scenario analysis, and interest rate risk reporting. Essential for bond portfolio analytics.

attributes.name: accrued_income
attributes.description: The amount of income (interest, dividends, or other distributions) that has been earned but not yet received on this holding as of the valuation date, expressed in base currency.

attributes.name: acquisition_date
attributes.description: The date on which the fund first acquired this holding. Used for holding period analysis and tax reporting.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 550, HMRC Capital Gains Manual

attributes.name: asset_class
attributes.description: High-level classification of the asset type: equity, fixed income, cash and cash equivalents, derivatives, commodities, real estate, or alternative investments.
attributes.references: GICS (Global Industry Classification Standard), UCITS Directive

attributes.name: base_currency
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code representing the fund base currency in which NAV is calculated (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: cost_basis
attributes.description: The original acquisition cost of the holding in the fund base currency. Used to calculate unrealized gain or loss. May be calculated using FIFO, LIFO, or average cost method.

attributes.name: counterparty_lei
attributes.description: The 20-character ISO 17442 Legal Entity Identifier of the counterparty for derivative or collateralized transactions. Required for regulatory reporting under EMIR and Dodd-Frank.

attributes.name: counterparty_name
attributes.description: The name of the counterparty for derivative instruments or securities lending transactions. Applicable to OTC derivatives, swaps, and collateralized positions.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this holding record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: custodian_account_number
attributes.description: The account number or identifier at the custodian institution where this holding is held. Used for reconciliation and settlement.

attributes.name: custodian_name
attributes.description: The name of the custodian bank or depository institution holding the physical or electronic custody of the asset on behalf of the fund.

attributes.name: data_source_system
attributes.description: The name or identifier of the upstream source system from which this holding record was extracted (e.g., SimCorp Dimension, BlackRock Aladdin, internal portfolio management system).

attributes.name: duration_years
attributes.description: The modified duration or effective duration of the fixed income instrument, expressed in years. Measures the sensitivity of the instrument price to changes in interest rates. Applicable to bonds and other fixed income securities.

attributes.name: fair_value_level
attributes.description: The IFRS 13 fair value hierarchy level used to determine the market price: Level 1 (quoted prices in active markets), Level 2 (observable inputs other than quoted prices), or Level 3 (unobservable inputs).

attributes.name: holding_status
attributes.description: The current lifecycle status of the holding. Indicates whether the position is active, pending settlement, restricted from trading, pledged as collateral, or liquidated.

attributes.name: investment_strategy
attributes.description: The investment strategy or mandate under which this holding was acquired (e.g., Growth, Value, Income, Hedging, Tactical Allocation). Used for performance attribution and strategy analysis.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this holding record was last updated in the system. Used for data lineage, audit trail, and change tracking.

attributes.name: liquidity_classification
attributes.description: Classification of the holding based on its liquidity profile and the ease with which it can be converted to cash without significant price impact. Used for liquidity risk management and regulatory reporting under UCITS and AIFMD.

attributes.name: market_value_base
attributes.description: The total market value of the holding converted to the fund base currency using the FX rate at the valuation date. This is the value used in NAV calculation.
attributes.references: IFRS 13 Fair Value Measurement, Investment Company Act of 1940

attributes.name: market_value_local
attributes.description: The total market value of the holding in the local currency of the instrument, calculated as quantity held multiplied by market price.

attributes.name: maturity_date
attributes.description: The date on which the principal amount of a fixed income instrument is due to be repaid. Applicable to bonds, notes, and other debt securities. Null for perpetual instruments or equities.

attributes.name: percentage_of_nav
attributes.description: The market value of this holding expressed as a percentage of the total fund NAV at the valuation date. Used for concentration risk analysis and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: pricing_source
attributes.description: The source or vendor from which the market price was obtained (e.g., Bloomberg, Reuters, IDC, internal valuation model). Used for audit trail and price verification.
attributes.references: IFRS 13, IOSCO Principles for Financial Benchmarks

attributes.name: quantity_held
attributes.description: The number of units, shares, or nominal amount of the instrument held in the fund at the valuation date. For bonds, this may represent face value; for equities, share count.

attributes.name: regulatory_classification
attributes.description: Classification of the holding for regulatory reporting purposes under UCITS, AIFMD, or other applicable frameworks. May include categories such as transferable securities, money market instruments, derivatives, or other assets.
attributes.references: UCITS Directive Annex II, AIFMD Annex IV

attributes.name: settlement_date
attributes.description: The date on which the most recent transaction affecting this holding was settled. Used for trade lifecycle tracking and reconciliation.
attributes.references: CSDR (Central Securities Depositories Regulation), T+2 Settlement

attributes.name: unrealized_gain_loss
attributes.description: The difference between the current market value in base currency and the cost basis, representing the unrealized profit or loss on the holding. Positive values indicate gains, negative values indicate losses.

attributes.name: valuation_date
attributes.description: The specific date on which this holding position and valuation are recorded. Critical for point-in-time portfolio snapshots and NAV calculation.

products.name: fund_transaction

Captures transaction type, trade date, settlement date, instrument, quantity, price, gross amount, net amount, currency, FX rate, broker, settlement status, and accounting treatment. Feeds fund accounting subledger and NAV calculation.

attributes.name: managed_portfolio_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the portfolio within the fund where this transaction occurred. Links to portfolio master entity.

attributes.name: settlement_date

attributes.name: settlement_method
attributes.description: Method used for settling the transaction: Delivery versus Payment (DVP), Receive versus Payment (RVP), Free of Payment (FOP), or Cash.

attributes.name: settlement_status

attributes.name: tax_amount

attributes.name: trade_confirmation_number
attributes.description: Confirmation number received from the broker or exchange confirming the trade execution.

attributes.name: trade_date

attributes.name: transaction_notes

attributes.name: transaction_reference_number
