products.name: investor_account
products.description: Master record for each investor account registered in the fund's transfer agency system. Captures investor type (retail, institutional, nominee), account status, registration details, tax residency, FATCA/CRS classification, AML status, distribution preference (reinvestment vs cash), bank account for distributions, preferred currency, account opening date, and relationship manager. Serves as the SSOT for investor identity within the fund administration and transfer agency function.

attributes.name: investor_account_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the investor account in the transfer agency system. Primary key.

attributes.name: channel_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to channel.channel. Business justification: Investor account origination channel is required for AML source-of-business reporting, channel attribution analytics, and regulatory audit. Banks must record through which channel (branch, digital, ad

attributes.name: legal_entity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to ledger.legal_entity. Business justification: Investor accounts are opened under a specific legal entity (fund management company or custodian). Required for CRS/FATCA regulatory reporting, AML compliance, and legal entity-level financial reporti

attributes.name: onboarding_case_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.onboarding_case. Business justification: Investor account opening is the direct outcome of a customer onboarding case (onboarding_case.product_applied_for). Fund administrators must trace each investor account back to its originating onboard

attributes.name: opening_session_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to channel.session. Business justification: Digital onboarding compliance and fraud prevention require capturing the exact session during which an investor account was opened online. Role-prefix 'opening_' distinguishes this from any future ses

attributes.name: party_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.party. Business justification: Investor accounts must link to customer.party for KYC/AML compliance, regulatory reporting (FATCA/CRS), beneficial ownership verification, and consolidated customer view across banking and asset manag

attributes.name: settlement_deposit_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to account.deposit_account. Business justification: Fund subscription/redemption settlement and distribution payments require linking the investor account to its designated deposit account. Regulatory AML/KYC and operational settlement processes depend

attributes.name: tax_residency_country_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.country. Business justification: Tax residency determines FATCA, CRS reporting obligations, withholding tax rates, and treaty benefits. Regulatory mandate for tax compliance and investor classification.

attributes.name: tax_residency_jurisdiction_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.jurisdiction. Business justification: CRS and FATCA regulatory reporting obligations are determined at jurisdiction level, not just country level. investor_account.crs_reportable_flag and fatca_status require the authoritative jurisdictio

attributes.name: account_closure_date
attributes.description: Date when the account was formally closed. Null for active accounts. Closed accounts retain historical data for regulatory retention periods.

attributes.name: account_number
attributes.description: Externally visible account number assigned to the investor account. Used for client communications and statements.

attributes.name: account_opening_date
attributes.description: Date when the investor account was first opened and activated in the transfer agency system. Marks the start of the account lifecycle.

attributes.name: account_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the investor account. Controls transaction permissions and servicing activities.

attributes.name: aml_risk_rating
attributes.description: Risk classification assigned by AML screening and monitoring processes. Determines enhanced due diligence requirements and transaction monitoring thresholds.
attributes.references: BSA (Bank Secrecy Act), FinCEN Guidance, FINRA Rule 3310

attributes.name: beneficial_owner_count
attributes.description: Number of underlying beneficial owners represented by this account. Applicable for omnibus and nominee accounts. Null for direct retail accounts.

attributes.name: closure_reason
attributes.description: Reason code for account closure. Used for operational analytics and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when the investor account record was first created in the transfer agency database. Audit trail field.
attributes.references: SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act) Section 404, Data Governance Standards

attributes.name: crs_reportable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the account is reportable under CRS automatic exchange of information requirements. True if reportable to foreign tax authorities.

attributes.name: distribution_preference
attributes.description: Investor election for handling fund distributions (dividends, capital gains). Reinvest purchases additional shares; cash pays to bank account.
attributes.references: Investment Company Act Section 2(a)(35), Transfer Agency Standards

attributes.name: dormancy_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the account has been classified as dormant due to prolonged inactivity. Triggers escheatment and outreach processes.

attributes.name: escheatment_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the account is eligible for escheatment to state unclaimed property authorities. Based on dormancy period and jurisdiction rules.
attributes.references: Uniform Unclaimed Property Act, State Escheatment Laws

attributes.name: fatca_status
attributes.business_glossary_term: Foreign Account Tax Compliance Act (FATCA) Status
attributes.description: FATCA classification of the account holder. Determines US tax reporting requirements under FATCA regulations.
attributes.references: FATCA (Foreign Account Tax Compliance Act), IRS Publication 5124

attributes.name: investor_type
attributes.description: Classification of the investor account holder. Determines servicing model, fee structure, and regulatory treatment.

attributes.name: kyc_next_review_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Know Your Customer (KYC) Next Review Date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next periodic KYC review. Typically based on risk rating and regulatory requirements.

attributes.name: kyc_status
attributes.description: Current status of KYC verification and documentation. Must be verified before account activation and transactions.
attributes.references: KYC (Know Your Customer) Standards, FINRA Rule 4512

attributes.name: kyc_verification_date
attributes.description: Date when KYC verification was last completed successfully. Used to determine refresh requirements per regulatory timelines.

attributes.name: last_transaction_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent transaction activity on the account. Used to identify dormant accounts and trigger escheatment reviews.
attributes.references: Uniform Unclaimed Property Act, Transfer Agency Standards

attributes.name: mailing_address_line1
attributes.description: First line of the postal mailing address for account correspondence and statements.

attributes.name: mailing_address_line2
attributes.description: Second line of the postal mailing address (apartment, suite, building number). Optional field.

attributes.name: mailing_city
attributes.description: City or municipality component of the mailing address.

attributes.name: mailing_country
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code for the mailing address. Determines postal routing and regulatory jurisdiction.

attributes.name: mailing_postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code component of the mailing address. Format varies by country.

attributes.name: mailing_state_province
attributes.description: State, province, or region component of the mailing address. Format varies by country.

attributes.name: omnibus_account_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is an omnibus account holding positions on behalf of multiple underlying beneficial owners. True for intermediary and nominee accounts.
attributes.references: SEC Investment Company Act, Transfer Agency Standards

attributes.name: preferred_currency
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO currency code for account statements, distributions, and client communications. May differ from fund base currency.

attributes.name: registration_type
attributes.description: Legal structure of the account registration. Determines ownership rights, tax treatment, and beneficiary rules. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: individual|joint_tenants|tenants_in_common|trust|corporate|partnership|ira|401k|ugma|utma — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: restricted_trading_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether trading restrictions are in place on this account. True if the account is subject to market timing controls, redemption fees, or regulatory holds.

attributes.name: restricted_trading_reason
attributes.description: Explanation for trading restrictions. Examples include excessive trading pattern detection, regulatory hold, or pending investigation.

attributes.name: statement_delivery_method
attributes.description: Investor preference for receiving account statements and confirmations. Electronic delivery reduces costs and environmental impact.
attributes.references: SEC Rule 30e-3, Transfer Agency Best Practices

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when the investor account record was last modified. Audit trail field for change tracking.
attributes.references: SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act) Section 404, Data Governance Standards

products.name: subscription
products.description: Transactional record of investor subscription (purchase) orders for fund units or shares. Captures investor account, fund class, order date, settlement date, subscription amount or units requested, dealing NAV applied, gross subscription amount, entry load, net investment amount, units allotted, payment method, payment status, source of funds declaration, and AML clearance status. Represents the primary investor inflow event in the fund lifecycle.

attributes.name: subscription_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the subscription transaction record. Primary key for the subscription entity.

attributes.name: branch_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to channel.branch. Business justification: Branch-level fund sales reporting and regulatory origination tracking require knowing which branch originated each subscription. Banks must report fund distribution by branch for sales performance man

attributes.name: channel_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to channel.channel. Business justification: Subscriptions are placed through specific banking channels (digital, branch, contact center). Essential for channel attribution, performance tracking, and commission calculation. Replaces denormalized

attributes.name: currency_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.currency. Business justification: Subscription payment currency for settlement, FX conversion, and unit allocation. Essential for multi-currency dealing and cash reconciliation.

attributes.name: dealing_price_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to security.price. Business justification: The specific price record used to calculate dealing NAV for unit allotment is a mandatory audit trail item for trade confirmation, investor statements, and regulatory reporting (UCITS/AIFMD). Role-pre

attributes.name: fund_class_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific share class of the fund being subscribed to (e.g., Class A, Class I, Institutional). Different classes may have different fee structures and minimum investment requirements.

attributes.name: fund_id
attributes.description: Reference to the fund being subscribed to. Links to the fund master record.

attributes.name: instrument_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to security.instrument. Business justification: Subscriptions in kind (securities as payment) require instrument reference for valuation, settlement, and tax lot creation. Real business scenario for institutional share classes and seed capital.

attributes.name: investor_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the investor account placing the subscription order. Links to the investor account master record.

attributes.name: journal_entry_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to ledger.journal_entry. Business justification: Subscriptions generate journal entries for cash receipt and unit issuance (debit cash, credit equity). Required for daily cash reconciliation, NAV calculation, and financial statement preparation.

attributes.name: kyc_record_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.kyc_record. Business justification: Subscription AML clearance (subscription.aml_clearance_status/date) must reference the specific KYC record version active at order time. Regulators require fund administrators to evidence which KYC re

attributes.name: listing_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to security.listing. Business justification: ETF subscription orders are executed on a specific exchange listing, determining settlement currency, settlement cycle, tick size, and regulatory reporting venue. Order management and settlement syste

attributes.name: nav_record_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to asset.nav_record. Business justification: A subscription is priced at a specific published NAV. Linking nav_record_id to the authoritative nav_record used for unit allotment pricing creates a direct audit trail from the subscription order to

attributes.name: party_id
attributes.description: Reference to the financial intermediary, broker-dealer, or registered investment advisor (RIA) through whom the subscription was placed. Null if direct investor order.

attributes.name: reversal_subscription_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on subscription (reversal_subscription_id)

attributes.name: session_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to channel.session. Business justification: AML audit trail and digital fraud detection require linking each fund subscription order to the exact digital session in which it was placed. Regulators and compliance teams use session-level data to

attributes.name: settlement_holiday_calendar_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.holiday_calendar. Business justification: Subscription settlement on valid business days per fund calendar. Critical for dealing deadline enforcement, NAV application, and transfer agency SLA compliance.

attributes.name: aml_clearance_date
attributes.description: Date when the subscription transaction received Anti-Money Laundering (AML) clearance and was approved to proceed.
attributes.references: Bank Secrecy Act (BSA), USA PATRIOT Act

attributes.name: aml_clearance_status
attributes.description: Status of Anti-Money Laundering (AML) screening and clearance for this subscription transaction. Pending = screening in progress, Cleared = passed AML checks, Flagged = requires manual review, Rejected = failed AML checks and transaction blocked.
attributes.references: Bank Secrecy Act (BSA), USA PATRIOT Act

attributes.name: commission_amount
attributes.description: Dollar amount of commission payable to the intermediary or advisor on this subscription. Calculated from commission_rate and gross_subscription_amount.

attributes.name: commission_rate
attributes.description: Percentage rate of commission payable to the intermediary or advisor on this subscription. Expressed as a decimal. May be zero for direct orders or fee-based accounts.

attributes.name: confirmation_number
attributes.description: Unique confirmation number issued to the investor upon successful processing of the subscription. Used for investor communication and record-keeping.

attributes.name: confirmation_sent_date
attributes.description: Date when the trade confirmation was sent to the investor. Required by SEC regulations to be sent promptly after settlement.

attributes.name: cost_basis_per_unit
attributes.description: Tax cost basis per unit for this subscription lot. Calculated as net_investment_amount / units_allotted. Used for future capital gains/loss calculations upon redemption.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this subscription record was first created in the system. Part of audit trail for data lineage and compliance.

attributes.name: dealing_nav
attributes.description: The Net Asset Value per unit/share applied to this subscription transaction. Determined based on the trade date and fund valuation rules (forward pricing).

attributes.name: entry_load_amount
attributes.description: Dollar amount of the front-end sales load or entry fee deducted from the gross subscription amount. Calculated as gross_subscription_amount * entry_load_rate.

attributes.name: entry_load_rate
attributes.description: Percentage rate of the front-end sales load or entry fee charged on the subscription. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0575 for 5.75%). May be zero for no-load funds or certain share classes.

attributes.name: gross_subscription_amount
attributes.description: Total dollar amount of the subscription before deducting entry loads or fees. Calculated as requested_amount or (requested_units * dealing_nav).

attributes.name: minimum_investment_waived
attributes.description: Indicates whether the fund minimum investment requirement was waived for this subscription (e.g., for systematic investment plans, employer-sponsored plans, or discretionary waivers).

attributes.name: nav_date
attributes.description: The valuation date of the NAV (Net Asset Value) used for pricing this subscription. Typically matches trade_date for forward-priced funds.

attributes.name: net_investment_amount
attributes.description: Net dollar amount actually invested in the fund after deducting entry loads and fees. Calculated as gross_subscription_amount - entry_load_amount. This is the amount used to calculate units allotted.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-form text field for operational notes, special instructions, or comments related to this subscription transaction. Used for exception handling and audit trail.

attributes.name: order_date
attributes.description: Date when the subscription order was received and accepted by the transfer agent or fund administrator. This is the business event date for the subscription request.

attributes.name: order_method
attributes.description: Indicates whether the investor specified a dollar amount to invest or a specific number of units/shares to purchase.

attributes.name: order_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise timestamp when the subscription order was received. Critical for determining applicable NAV (Net Asset Value) pricing based on cut-off times.

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: Method by which the investor is funding the subscription. Wire = wire transfer, ACH = Automated Clearing House (ACH) electronic transfer, Check = paper check, Debit_card = debit card payment, Internal_transfer = transfer from another account within the same institution.

attributes.name: payment_received_date
attributes.description: Date when the subscription payment was received by the transfer agent or fund custodian. Critical for determining good order status and settlement timing.

attributes.name: payment_status
attributes.description: Current status of the payment for this subscription. Pending = awaiting receipt, Received = payment received but not cleared, Cleared = payment fully cleared and available, Failed = payment failed or rejected, Reversed = payment reversed or returned.

attributes.name: requested_amount
attributes.description: Gross dollar amount the investor intends to invest before any fees or loads are applied. Populated when order_method is amount.

attributes.name: requested_units
attributes.description: Number of fund units or shares the investor requests to purchase. Populated when order_method is units.

attributes.name: settlement_date
attributes.description: Date when the subscription transaction settles, payment is received, and units are officially allotted to the investor account. Typically T+1 or T+2 depending on fund rules.

attributes.name: source_of_funds
attributes.description: Investor declaration or classification of the source of funds for this subscription (e.g., salary, savings, inheritance, business income, investment proceeds). Required for Anti-Money Laundering (AML) compliance and Know Your Customer (KYC) due diligence.

attributes.name: subscription_number
attributes.description: Business-facing unique order number for the subscription transaction. Used for investor communication and operational tracking.

attributes.name: subscription_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the subscription order. Pending = order received awaiting validation, Accepted = order validated and accepted, Processing = order being processed for settlement, Settled = units allotted and transaction complete, Cancelled = order cancelled by investor or system, Rejected = order rejected due to validation failure or compliance issue.

attributes.name: subscription_type
attributes.description: Classification of the subscription order type. Initial = first investment in fund, Additional = subsequent investment, Systematic = recurring automatic investment, Reinvestment = dividend/capital gain reinvestment, Exchange_in = transfer from another fund.

attributes.name: tax_lot_method
attributes.description: Cost basis accounting method elected by the investor for this subscription and future redemptions. FIFO = First In First Out, LIFO = Last In First Out, Average_cost = average cost basis, Specific_identification = investor specifies lots to redeem.

attributes.name: trade_date
attributes.description: Date on which the subscription transaction is executed and the applicable NAV (Net Asset Value) is determined. Typically T+0 for mutual funds if order received before cut-off time.

attributes.name: units_allotted
attributes.description: Number of fund units or shares allotted to the investor account as a result of this subscription. Calculated as net_investment_amount / dealing_nav.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this subscription record was last modified. Part of audit trail for data lineage and compliance.

attributes.name: waiver_reason
attributes.description: Business reason or code explaining why minimum investment or other requirements were waived for this subscription (e.g., systematic plan, employer plan, relationship pricing).

products.name: redemption
products.description: Transactional record of investor redemption (sale) orders for fund units or shares. Captures investor account, fund class, order date, settlement date, redemption units or amount requested, dealing NAV applied, gross redemption proceeds, exit load, net proceeds payable, payment destination account, redemption type (full/partial), lock-up period compliance check, gate restriction flag, and settlement status. Represents the primary investor outflow event in the fund lifecycle.

attributes.description: Unique identifier for the redemption transaction. Primary key for the redemption record.

attributes.name: branch_id

attributes.name: broker_id
attributes.description: Reference to the broker, distributor, or financial advisor who submitted the redemption order on behalf of the investor.

attributes.name: channel_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to channel.channel. Business justification: Redemptions are processed through banking channels. Critical for operational routing, SLA management, channel performance measurement, and regulatory reporting. Replaces denormalized order_channel cod

attributes.name: currency_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.currency. Business justification: Redemption proceeds currency for payment processing, FX conversion, and investor settlement. Required for multi-currency redemption handling and cash management.

attributes.name: dealing_price_id

attributes.name: fund_class_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific share class or unit class within the fund being redeemed (e.g., Class A, Class I, Institutional).

attributes.name: fund_id
attributes.description: Reference to the mutual fund, ETF, hedge fund, or pension fund from which redemption is requested.

attributes.name: investor_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the investor account from which units or shares are being redeemed.

attributes.name: journal_entry_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to ledger.journal_entry. Business justification: Redemptions generate journal entries for cash payment and unit cancellation (debit equity, credit cash). Required for daily cash reconciliation, NAV calculation, and financial statement preparation.

attributes.name: listing_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to security.listing. Business justification: ETF redemption orders are executed on a specific exchange listing, determining settlement currency, settlement cycle, and regulatory reporting venue. Settlement and compliance systems require this FK

attributes.name: nav_record_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to asset.nav_record. Business justification: A redemption is settled at a specific published NAV. Linking nav_record_id to the authoritative nav_record used for unit redemption pricing provides a direct audit trail. dealing_nav is retained as an

attributes.name: reversal_redemption_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on redemption (reversal_redemption_id)

attributes.name: session_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to channel.session. Business justification: AML monitoring and fraud detection for fund redemptions require the exact digital session context. Compliance teams must verify authentication level and device fingerprint at time of redemption order,

attributes.name: settlement_holiday_calendar_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.holiday_calendar. Business justification: Redemption settlement on valid business days per fund calendar. Critical for payment timing, liquidity management, and transfer agency SLA compliance.

attributes.name: aml_check_status
attributes.description: Status of Anti-Money Laundering screening performed on the redemption transaction to detect suspicious activity.

attributes.name: amount_requested
attributes.description: Monetary amount requested for redemption when the investor specifies a dollar amount rather than units.

attributes.name: confirmation_number
attributes.description: Unique confirmation number issued to the investor upon successful processing of the redemption order.

attributes.name: confirmation_sent_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the redemption confirmation was sent to the investor.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the redemption record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: dealing_nav
attributes.description: The Net Asset Value per unit or share applied to calculate the redemption proceeds, typically the NAV as of the trade date.

attributes.name: exit_load_amount
attributes.description: Monetary value of the exit load or redemption fee deducted from gross proceeds.
attributes.references: SEC Investment Company Act, SEBI Mutual Fund Regulations

attributes.name: exit_load_rate
attributes.description: Percentage rate of the exit load or redemption fee charged to the investor, typically applied if redemption occurs within a specified holding period.
attributes.references: SEC Investment Company Act, SEBI Mutual Fund Regulations

attributes.name: gate_percentage_applied
attributes.description: Percentage of the requested redemption that is fulfilled when a gate restriction is in effect, with the remainder deferred.

attributes.name: gate_restriction_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the redemption is subject to fund-level gate restrictions limiting total redemptions in a period (True = gate applied, False = no gate).

attributes.name: gross_redemption_proceeds
attributes.description: Total proceeds calculated before deducting exit loads, redemption fees, or other charges (redemption_units × dealing_nav).

attributes.name: kyc_verification_status
attributes.description: Status of Know Your Customer verification for the investor at the time of redemption, ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements.
attributes.references: FATCA, CRS, SEC Customer Identification Program

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the redemption record was last updated, capturing any status changes or corrections.

attributes.name: lock_in_compliance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the redemption complies with any lock-in period requirements (True = compliant, False = early redemption).
attributes.references: SEC Investment Company Act, SEBI Mutual Fund Regulations

attributes.name: lock_in_period_end_date
attributes.description: Date on which any mandatory lock-in or holding period for the redeemed units expires, used to validate early redemption restrictions.
attributes.references: SEC Investment Company Act, SEBI Mutual Fund Regulations

attributes.name: net_redemption_proceeds
attributes.description: Final amount payable to the investor after deducting exit load, fees, and taxes from gross proceeds.

attributes.name: order_date
attributes.description: Date on which the investor submitted the redemption order.

attributes.name: order_number
attributes.description: Externally visible business identifier for the redemption order, used for investor communication and reconciliation.

attributes.name: order_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the redemption order was received by the transfer agent or fund administrator, used for cut-off time validation.

attributes.name: payment_account_number
attributes.description: Bank account number or International Bank Account Number (IBAN) to which redemption proceeds are transferred.

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: Method by which redemption proceeds are paid to the investor (e.g., ACH, wire transfer, check, RTGS, SWIFT).

attributes.name: payment_routing_number
attributes.description: Bank routing number, SWIFT Bank Identifier Code (BIC), or other routing identifier for the payment destination.

attributes.name: payment_sent_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the redemption proceeds payment was initiated to the investor account.

attributes.name: redemption_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the redemption order (pending, confirmed, settled, cancelled, rejected, suspended).

attributes.name: redemption_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether the redemption is a full liquidation of the investor position or a partial withdrawal.

attributes.name: regulatory_reporting_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this redemption transaction must be reported to regulatory authorities (True = reportable, False = not reportable).
attributes.references: SEC Form N-PORT, EMIR, MiFID II

attributes.name: rejection_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the reason for redemption rejection (e.g., insufficient units, lock-in violation, gate restriction, KYC incomplete).

attributes.name: rejection_reason_description
attributes.description: Detailed explanation of why the redemption order was rejected, provided to the investor or intermediary.

attributes.name: settlement_date
attributes.description: Date on which the redemption proceeds are paid to the investor, typically T+1 or T+2 depending on fund rules.

attributes.name: tax_withheld_amount
attributes.description: Amount of tax withheld at source on redemption proceeds, if applicable under jurisdiction tax rules (e.g., capital gains tax, withholding tax).

attributes.name: trade_date
attributes.description: Date on which the redemption transaction is executed and the Net Asset Value (NAV) is applied.

attributes.name: units
attributes.description: Number of fund units or shares requested for redemption by the investor.

attributes.name: payment_transaction_id

Fund administrators reconcile distribution payments against payment_transaction records for regulatory reporting (Form 1099-D

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to security.price. Business justification: The specific price record used for dividend reinvestment unit allotment is required for tax lot tracking, Form 1099-DIV reporting, and investor cost basis calculations. distribution_event.reinvestment

attributes.name: reversal_distribution_event_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on distribution_event (reversal_distribution_event_id)

attributes.name: accrual_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the period during which the income or capital gains distributed were earned or realized by the fund. Used for fund accounting and performance attribution.

attributes.name: accrual_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the period during which the income or capital gains distributed were earned or realized by the fund. Used for fund accounting and performance attribution.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the individual or committee that approved the distribution, such as the board of trustees, investment committee, or authorized officer.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the distribution event record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: declaration_date

attributes.name: distribution_approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which the distribution was formally approved by the fund's board of directors or trustees, or by authorized fund management under delegated authority.

attributes.name: distribution_calculation_method
attributes.description: Description of the methodology used to calculate the distribution amount, such as percentage of Net Asset Value (NAV), fixed rate, or based on net investment income and realized gains.

attributes.name: distribution_frequency
attributes.description: Scheduled frequency of distributions for the fund class. Monthly, quarterly, semi-annual, and annual represent regular distribution schedules. Special indicates a one-time or non-recurring distribution event such as a liquidating distribution or special capital gain distribution.

attributes.name: distribution_notice_date
attributes.description: Date on which the distribution notice was sent to shareholders, intermediaries, and regulatory authorities. Used to track compliance with notice requirements.

attributes.name: distribution_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the distribution event, typically assigned by the fund administrator or transfer agent.

attributes.name: distribution_rate_per_unit
attributes.description: Gross distribution amount per fund share or unit before any withholding taxes or adjustments.

attributes.name: distribution_sequence_number
attributes.description: Sequential number of the distribution within the tax year or fund fiscal year, used to track and order multiple distributions for the same fund class.

attributes.name: distribution_source_description
attributes.description: Narrative description of the source of the distribution, such as net investment income, realized capital gains, or return of capital. Provides additional context for investor communications and regulatory disclosures.

attributes.name: distribution_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the distribution event. Declared indicates the distribution has been announced. Pending approval indicates awaiting regulatory or board approval. Approved indicates ready for payment processing. Paid indicates distribution has been processed and paid to shareholders. Cancelled indicates the distribution was revoked before payment.

attributes.name: distribution_type
attributes.description: Classification of the distribution for tax and accounting purposes. Income dividend represents ordinary income distributions from interest and dividends earned by the fund. Short-term capital gain represents gains from securities held one year or less. Long-term capital gain represents gains from securities held more than one year. Return of capital represents distributions that exceed the fund's earnings and profits. Qualified dividend represents dividends eligible for preferential tax treatment. Non-qualified dividend represents ordinary income dividends taxed at regular rates.

attributes.name: ex_dividend_date
attributes.description: Date on which the fund begins trading without the distribution value. Investors purchasing shares on or after this date are not entitled to the declared distribution.

attributes.name: foreign_tax_credit_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of the distribution eligible for foreign tax credit pass-through to U.S. shareholders, representing foreign taxes paid by the fund on foreign-source income. Expressed as a decimal.

attributes.name: form_1099_div_reportable
attributes.description: Indicates whether the distribution must be reported to the Internal Revenue Service (IRS) on Form 1099-DIV for U.S. tax purposes. True for most distributions to U.S. taxable investors.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the distribution event record was last modified in the system.

attributes.name: net_distribution_per_unit
attributes.description: Net distribution amount per share after applying default withholding tax rate. Represents the cash amount paid to investors subject to standard withholding.

attributes.name: payment_date
attributes.description: Date on which the distribution is paid to eligible shareholders or reinvested in additional fund shares.

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: Default payment method for the distribution. Cash indicates distribution paid in cash to investor accounts. Reinvestment indicates automatic reinvestment in additional fund shares at the reinvestment NAV. Mixed indicates the fund supports both options based on individual investor elections.

attributes.name: qualified_dividend_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of the distribution that qualifies for preferential tax treatment as qualified dividends under Internal Revenue Code Section 1(h)(11). Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.85 for 85%).

attributes.name: record_date
attributes.description: Date on which the fund determines which shareholders are entitled to receive the distribution. Only shareholders of record as of this date will receive the payment.

attributes.name: regulatory_filing_reference
attributes.description: Reference number or identifier for the regulatory filing associated with the distribution, such as Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) Form N-CSR or Form N-PORT filing number.

attributes.name: reinvestment_nav
attributes.description: Net Asset Value per share used to calculate the number of additional shares issued to investors who elect to reinvest their distribution. Typically the NAV as of the ex-dividend date or payment date per fund prospectus.

attributes.name: section_199a_dividend_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of the distribution that qualifies as Section 199A dividends eligible for the qualified business income deduction. Expressed as a decimal. Applicable to Real Estate Investment Trust (REIT) and certain other fund distributions.

attributes.name: shares_outstanding_at_record
attributes.description: Total number of fund shares outstanding as of the record date, used to calculate the total distribution amount and determine eligible shareholders.

attributes.name: tax_year
attributes.description: Calendar or fiscal tax year to which the distribution is attributed for tax reporting purposes. Typically the year in which the distribution is paid, but may differ for distributions declared in December and paid in January.

attributes.name: total_distribution_amount
attributes.description: Total gross distribution amount declared for all eligible shares of the fund class, calculated as distribution rate per unit multiplied by total shares outstanding as of record date.

attributes.name: withholding_tax_rate
attributes.description: Default withholding tax rate applied to the distribution for non-exempt investors, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.15 for 15%). Actual withholding may vary by investor tax status and jurisdiction.

products.name: unit_register
products.description: Authoritative unit/share register record maintaining the current and historical unit holdings for each investor account in each fund class. Captures investor account, fund class, units held, average cost per unit, total cost basis, unrealized gain/loss, first investment date, last transaction date, and register status. Serves as the legal record of fund ownership and is the SSOT for investor unit balances used in redemption processing and distribution calculations.

attributes.name: unit_register_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the unit register record. Primary key for the authoritative unit/share register.

attributes.name: accounting_period_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to ledger.accounting_period. Business justification: The unit register is closed and snapshotted at each accounting period-end for unitholder reporting, CRS/FATCA regulatory filings, and financial statement disclosure of units outstanding. Period-end un

attributes.name: currency_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.currency. Business justification: Unit holdings valued in specific currency for position keeping, investor statements, and unrealized gain/loss calculation. Core transfer agency requirement.

attributes.name: fund_class_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific fund class in which the investor holds units. Each fund may have multiple share classes with different fee structures and minimum investments.

attributes.name: investor_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the investor account that holds these units. Links to the investor master record in the transfer agency system.

attributes.name: previous_asset_unit_register_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on asset_unit_register (previous_asset_unit_register_id)

attributes.name: aml_risk_rating
attributes.description: Anti-Money Laundering risk classification assigned to this investor position based on KYC due diligence, transaction patterns, and jurisdiction risk. Used for enhanced monitoring and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: average_cost_per_unit
attributes.description: Weighted average cost basis per unit calculated across all purchase transactions. Used for tax reporting and capital gains calculations.

attributes.name: beneficial_owner_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the registered account holder is the beneficial owner of the units. False indicates the account is held by a nominee or intermediary on behalf of underlying beneficial owners.

attributes.name: crs_reportable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this account is reportable under the OECD Common Reporting Standard for automatic exchange of financial account information. Used for international tax compliance.

attributes.name: current_market_value
attributes.description: Current market value of the investor's holdings calculated as units held multiplied by current NAV per unit. Represents the liquidation value at current market prices.

attributes.name: current_nav_per_unit
attributes.business_glossary_term: Current Net Asset Value (NAV) Per Unit
attributes.description: Most recent Net Asset Value per unit for the fund class. Used to calculate current market value of the investor's holdings.

attributes.name: distribution_option
attributes.description: Investor's election for handling fund distributions and dividends. Reinvest automatically purchases additional units, cash pays distributions to the investor's bank account, partial reinvest applies a percentage to each option.

attributes.name: escheatment_due_date
attributes.description: Date by which the position must be escheated to the appropriate state authority if the investor cannot be located. Calculated based on dormancy period and state-specific regulations.

attributes.name: escheatment_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this position is eligible for escheatment to state unclaimed property authorities due to prolonged dormancy and inability to contact the investor.

attributes.name: fatca_status
attributes.business_glossary_term: Foreign Account Tax Compliance Act (FATCA) Status
attributes.description: FATCA classification status of the investor account. Determines US tax withholding and IRS reporting obligations for the fund.

attributes.name: first_investment_date
attributes.description: Date of the investor's first purchase transaction in this fund class. Used for holding period calculations and investor tenure analysis.

attributes.name: holding_period_days
attributes.description: Number of days since the first investment date. Used for long-term vs short-term capital gains classification and investor tenure analysis.

attributes.name: last_statement_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent investor statement that included this position. Used for statement generation tracking and investor servicing.

attributes.name: last_transaction_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent transaction (purchase, redemption, or exchange) affecting this unit register position. Used for dormancy monitoring and investor activity tracking.

attributes.name: last_transaction_type
attributes.description: Type of the most recent transaction that affected this position. Used for operational tracking and investor behavior analysis.

attributes.name: omnibus_account_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is an omnibus account holding units on behalf of multiple underlying investors. True for broker-dealer and platform accounts that aggregate multiple client positions.

attributes.name: record_closed_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this unit register position was closed due to full redemption or account closure. Null for active positions.

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this unit register record was first created in the system. Represents the initial establishment of the investor's position in this fund class.

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this unit register record. Updated whenever any transaction or data correction affects the position.

attributes.name: register_status
attributes.description: Current status of the unit register position. Active indicates normal holdings, closed indicates fully redeemed, suspended indicates temporary restrictions, pending closure indicates redemption in progress, restricted indicates regulatory or compliance holds.

attributes.name: registration_type
attributes.description: Legal registration type of the account holding these units. Determines ownership rights, tax treatment, and distribution handling. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: individual|joint_tenants|tenants_in_common|trust|corporate|custodial|retirement — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: restriction_code
attributes.description: Code indicating any restrictions on the investor's ability to transact in this position. Examples include regulatory holds, legal restrictions, compliance blocks, or voluntary locks. Empty if no restrictions apply.

attributes.name: restriction_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date when the current restriction will automatically expire and normal transaction processing will resume. Null if restriction is indefinite or no restriction applies.

attributes.name: restriction_reason
attributes.description: Detailed explanation of why the position is restricted, if applicable. Provides context for operational staff and compliance teams.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Name of the transfer agency or fund accounting system that is the authoritative source for this unit register record. Examples include SimCorp Dimension, BlackRock Aladdin, SS&C GlobeOp.

attributes.name: source_system_record_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier for this unit register record in the source transfer agency system. Used for reconciliation and audit trail back to the operational system of record.

attributes.name: tax_lot_method
attributes.description: Method used to determine cost basis when units are redeemed. FIFO (First In First Out), LIFO (Last In First Out), average cost, specific identification, or highest cost first.

attributes.name: total_cost_basis
attributes.description: Total amount invested by the investor in this fund class, calculated as units held multiplied by average cost per unit. Represents the investor's original investment value for tax purposes.

attributes.name: total_distributions_received
attributes.description: Cumulative amount of all distributions (dividends, capital gains, return of capital) received by the investor since first investment. Used for tax reporting and investor statements.

attributes.name: total_distributions_reinvested
attributes.description: Cumulative amount of distributions that were reinvested to purchase additional units. Subset of total distributions received.

attributes.name: units_held
attributes.description: Current number of fund units or shares held by the investor in this fund class. Represents the investor's ownership stake and is used to calculate distributions and redemption proceeds.

attributes.name: unrealized_gain_loss
attributes.description: Unrealized gain or loss on the position calculated as current market value minus total cost basis. Positive values indicate gains, negative values indicate losses.

attributes.name: unrealized_gain_loss_percentage
attributes.description: Unrealized gain or loss expressed as a percentage of the total cost basis. Calculated as (unrealized gain/loss / total cost basis) * 100.

products.name: fund_mandate

Captures investment objective, permitted asset classes, geographic restrictions, sector limits, issuer concentration limits, credit quality minimums, duration range, liquidity requirements, leverage limits, derivative usage policy, ESG/SRI constraints, benchmark, and mandate review date. Serves as the compliance reference for portfolio construction and investment restriction monitoring.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the mandate was formally approved by the designated authority.

attributes.name: breach_tolerance_policy

attributes.name: compliance_monitoring_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which portfolio holdings are monitored for compliance with mandate restrictions.

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: credit_quality_minimum

attributes.name: currency_hedging_policy
attributes.description: Policy regarding foreign exchange risk management (e.g., fully hedged, partially hedged, unhedged, discretionary).

attributes.name: derivative_usage_policy
attributes.description: Policy governing the use of derivative instruments (e.g., prohibited, hedging only, efficient portfolio management, speculative trading allowed).

attributes.name: document_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier or file path to the formal mandate document or Investment Policy Statement (IPS).

attributes.name: duration_range_max_years

attributes.name: duration_range_min_years

attributes.name: effective_date

attributes.name: esg_constraints
attributes.description: Environmental, Social, and Governance criteria or exclusions applied to the investment universe (e.g., exclude tobacco, weapons, fossil fuels; require minimum ESG rating).
attributes.references: UN Principles for Responsible Investment (PRI), SFDR (Sustainable Finance Disclosure Regulation)

attributes.name: geographic_restrictions
attributes.description: Geographic regions or countries where investments are permitted or restricted (e.g., developed markets only, exclude sanctioned countries).

attributes.name: high_water_mark_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether a high water mark mechanism is used for performance fee calculation to ensure fees are only charged on net new profits.

attributes.name: investment_objective
attributes.description: Primary investment goal of the fund such as capital appreciation, income generation, capital preservation, or balanced growth.

attributes.name: investment_strategy

attributes.name: issuer_concentration_limit_pct

attributes.name: leverage_limit_pct

attributes.references: UCITS Directive, AIFMD (Alternative Investment Fund Managers Directive)

attributes.name: liquidity_requirement_pct

attributes.references: Basel III Liquidity Coverage Ratio (LCR), SEC Liquidity Risk Management Rule

attributes.name: mandate_name

attributes.name: mandate_type

attributes.name: prohibited_asset_classes

attributes.name: sri_constraints

attributes.name: termination_date

attributes.name: version_number

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.rate_benchmark. Business justification: Sharpe ratio, Sortino ratio, and GIPS-compliant performance reporting require identifying the specific risk-free rate benchmark used (e.g., SOFR, Fed Funds). risk_free_rate_pct is a denormalized value

attributes.name: stress_scenario_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to risk.stress_scenario. Business justification: Performance attribution under stress scenarios measures risk-adjusted returns and worst-case performance. Required for AIFMD stress testing disclosure and investor reporting. Real process: stressed pe

attributes.name: yield_curve_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to security.yield_curve. Business justification: Performance attribution for fixed income funds requires yield curve data for return decomposition (carry, rolldown, spread, curve shift). Essential for explaining bond portfolio returns to investors.

attributes.name: active_return_pct
attributes.description: Excess return of the fund relative to the benchmark (fund return minus benchmark return), also known as alpha. Measures the value added by active management.

attributes.name: average_aum
attributes.description: Average total net assets of the fund during the performance period, used for expense ratio and turnover calculations.
attributes.references: SEC Investment Company Act, GIPS Standards

attributes.name: beginning_nav
attributes.description: Net Asset Value per share at the start of the performance period.
attributes.references: SEC Investment Company Act, FASB ASC 946

attributes.name: benchmark_return_pct
attributes.description: Return of the benchmark index over the same performance period, expressed as a percentage.

attributes.name: beta
attributes.description: Measure of the fund's sensitivity to benchmark movements. Beta of 1.0 indicates the fund moves in line with the benchmark; >1.0 indicates higher volatility; <1.0 indicates lower volatility.
attributes.references: CFA Institute, Capital Asset Pricing Model (CAPM)

attributes.name: calculation_date
attributes.description: Date on which the performance metrics were calculated.

attributes.name: calculation_methodology
attributes.description: Specific mathematical method used to calculate the performance return: Modified Dietz (approximation), True TWR (daily valuation), Simple TWR (periodic valuation), IRR (money-weighted).

attributes.name: capital_appreciation_pct
attributes.description: Portion of total return attributable to capital gains (price appreciation), expressed as a percentage.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this performance record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: ending_nav
attributes.description: Net Asset Value per share at the end of the performance period.
attributes.references: SEC Investment Company Act, FASB ASC 946

attributes.name: expense_ratio_pct
attributes.description: Total annual operating expenses as a percentage of average net assets during the performance period. Includes management fees, administrative costs, and other fund expenses.

attributes.name: gips_compliant_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Global Investment Performance Standards (GIPS) Compliant Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the performance calculation and presentation comply with Global Investment Performance Standards established by CFA Institute.

attributes.name: income_return_pct
attributes.description: Portion of total return attributable to income (dividends, interest, distributions), expressed as a percentage.

attributes.name: information_ratio
attributes.description: Risk-adjusted active return metric calculated as active return / tracking error. Measures excess return per unit of active risk.

attributes.name: maximum_drawdown_pct
attributes.description: Largest peak-to-trough decline in fund value during the performance period, expressed as a percentage. Measures downside risk and worst-case loss scenario.

attributes.name: mwr_return_pct
attributes.business_glossary_term: Money-Weighted Return (MWR) / Internal Rate of Return (IRR) Percentage
attributes.description: Money-weighted return (also known as Internal Rate of Return or IRR) that accounts for the timing and magnitude of cash flows. Reflects the actual investor experience including contribution and withdrawal timing effects.

attributes.name: number_of_holdings
attributes.description: Total count of distinct securities held in the fund portfolio at the end of the performance period.

attributes.name: performance_attribution_available_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether detailed performance attribution analysis (sector allocation, security selection effects) is available for this performance record.

attributes.name: performance_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the performance measurement period.

attributes.name: performance_period_type
attributes.description: Standard reporting period for the performance calculation. ITD = Inception-to-Date (since inception). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: 1M|3M|6M|YTD|1Y|3Y|5Y|ITD — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: performance_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the performance measurement period.

attributes.name: performance_status
attributes.description: Current status of the performance record in its lifecycle: preliminary (initial calculation), final (confirmed), restated (corrected after finalization), audited (verified by external auditor).

attributes.name: r_squared
attributes.description: Statistical measure (0 to 1) indicating how much of the fund's movements can be explained by benchmark movements. Higher values indicate greater correlation with the benchmark.

attributes.name: regulatory_reporting_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this performance record is used for regulatory reporting purposes (SEC filings, prospectus updates, factsheet disclosures).

attributes.name: reporting_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code in which performance metrics are reported to investors. May differ from base fund currency for multi-currency share classes.

attributes.name: sharpe_ratio
attributes.description: Risk-adjusted return metric calculated as (fund return - risk-free rate) / standard deviation of returns. Measures excess return per unit of total risk.

attributes.name: sortino_ratio
attributes.description: Risk-adjusted return metric similar to Sharpe ratio but using downside deviation instead of total standard deviation. Focuses on downside risk only.

attributes.name: total_return_amount
attributes.description: Absolute dollar amount of return generated during the performance period, calculated as ending NAV minus beginning NAV plus distributions.

attributes.name: tracking_error_pct
attributes.description: Standard deviation of the difference between fund returns and benchmark returns, expressed as a percentage. Measures the consistency of active return.

attributes.name: turnover_ratio_pct
attributes.description: Measure of how frequently assets within the fund are bought and sold, expressed as a percentage of average net assets. Higher turnover may indicate more active trading.

attributes.name: twr_gross_return_pct
attributes.description: Time-weighted return before deduction of fees, expressed as a percentage. TWR eliminates the effect of cash flows and measures the compound growth rate of the portfolio.

attributes.name: twr_net_return_pct
attributes.description: Time-weighted return after deduction of all fees and expenses, expressed as a percentage. This is the return actually realized by investors.
attributes.references: GIPS Standards, SEC Investment Company Act

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this performance record was last modified.

attributes.name: volatility_pct
attributes.description: Annualized standard deviation of fund returns over the performance period, expressed as a percentage. Measures total risk and return variability.

  dimensions:
